title: Hybrid Cloud Architecture for Enterprise SAP Workloads: A Reference Model for Public-Sector Digital Transformation

detail.title: Hybrid Cloud Architecture for Enterprise SAP Workloads: A Reference Model for Public-Sector Digital Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or institutional conflicts of interest. The paper is an independent research contribution authored outside any employer-sponsored programme and is informed by professional architectural practice without reproducing any proprietary client material.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is an architectural and conceptual contribution and does not involve human subjects, patients, or participant data.

keywords: National Strategy for Data and AI

detail.abstract: Public-sector enterprises in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia operate large SAP estates that act as systems of record for finance, human capital, supply chain, and reporting. These platforms carry sovereignty, data residency, audit, and continuity obligations that pure public-cloud and pure on-premises deployment models do not satisfy in isolation. Hybrid cloud, as defined by the National Institute of Standards and Technology, offers a defensible target state, but the literature lacks a consolidated reference model that maps SAP S/4HANA workloads, identity and integration services, and resilience tiers to a hybrid topology suitable for national-level public-sector use. This paper proposes a nine-layer hybrid cloud reference architecture for enterprise SAP workloads, anchored on SAP S/4HANA as the system of record and Amazon Web Services as the principal cloud plane, with on-premises and partner-managed components retained where residency, classification, or continuity constraints demand them. The model is synthesised from the AWS Well-Architected Framework and its SAP Lens, official SAP architectural documentation, the NIST cloud reference architecture, Saudi cybersecurity and cloud regulatory guidance, and patterns observed during sustained delivery on enterprise SAP platforms in the Kingdom. The paper presents the nine layers, discusses the operating model and governance envelope, and identifies open questions for future work. The contribution is intended to support digital transformation programmes pursued under Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Strategy for Data and Artificial Intelligence, and to provide a vocabulary that architects, auditors, and programme sponsors can share when evaluating cloud target states for SAP.

AI.tldr: 本文为沙特阿拉伯公共部门基于SAP S/4HANA的企业级工作负载设计了一个九层混合云参考架构，结合AWS云、本地部署和合作伙伴管理组件，以满足主权、数据驻留、审计和连续性等合规要求，服务于沙特2030愿景和人工智能战略。
AI.research_question: 如何为沙特公共部门的大型SAP S/4HANA企业系统构建一个满足主权、数据驻留、审计和连续性等多重合规要求的混合云参考架构？
AI.motivation: 纯公有云和纯本地部署都无法单独满足沙特公共部门SAP系统的主权、数据驻留、审计和连续性义务，而现有文献缺乏一个针对国家级公共部门SAP混合云拓扑的整合参考模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: NIST混合云定义、AWS Well-Architected Framework及其SAP Lens、SAP官方架构文档、NIST云参考架构、沙特网络安全与云监管指南。
AI.method: 综合架构设计方法：基于AWS Well-Architected Framework、SAP官方文档、NIST参考架构、沙特监管指南等多元来源，结合在沙特企业SAP平台的持续交付实践进行综合与提炼。
AI.findings: 提出了一个九层混合云参考架构，涵盖SAP S/4HANA负载、身份与集成服务、弹性层级等，明确了各层在AWS云、本地和合作伙伴管理组件之间的分布，并讨论了运营模型、治理边界及待解决的关键问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了公共部门SAP混合云参考模型的文献空白，为NIST混合云概念在特定行业（公共部门SAP企业系统）的应用提供了可操作化的架构映射。
AI.practical_contributions: 为沙特2030愿景和国家数据与人工智能战略下的数字化转型项目提供可参考的架构蓝本，为架构师、审计师和项目赞助方提供评估SAP云目标状态的共同语言。

title: The Internet At War: An Empirical And Legal Analysis Of Harmful Narratives On Social Media During Armed Conflict
affiliations: Stanford University, Law School and Stanford University - Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies

detail.title: The Internet At War: An Empirical And Legal Analysis Of Harmful Narratives On Social Media During Armed Conflict

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper is forthcoming in the Michigan Technology Law Review.

detail.abstract: This Article empirically investigates the connection between harmful narratives on social media and violent acts perpetrated against persons protected under international humanitarian law (IHL) during armed conflict, and then examines the legal implications of such a relationship. First, examining comprehensive datasets from two interstate armed conflicts (Russia-Ukraine and Armenia-Azerbaijan) as case studies, this Article documents patterns in Telegram data indicating that more violent acts are preceded by increases in harmful narratives than decreases in such content. This suggests that harmful narratives on social media platforms may plausibly contribute to the incidence of real-world violence committed against protected persons during armed conflict. Assuming such a relationship exists, this Article then identifies the legal implications under three relevant bodies of law, arguing that creators and disseminators of such narratives may be in violation of international or domestic law because such content can foreseeably lead to violence. The Article concludes with several policy recommendations for stakeholders, including belligerents, regulating states, social media companies, and humanitarian actors, mapping out a series of actionable steps that could reduce harm against protected persons in conflict settings. Scholars and policymakers must do more to minimize the potential for harm that social media content presents in armed conflict settings.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究了社交媒体上的有害叙事与武装冲突中针对受国际人道法保护人员的暴力行为之间的关系，并探讨了相关法律影响。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体上的有害叙事与武装冲突中针对受国际人道法保护人员的暴力行为之间存在怎样的关系？这种关系有何法律影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管社交媒体在武装冲突中的作用日益受到关注，但有害叙事与实际暴力行为之间的实证联系及其法律后果尚未被充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际人道法、国际刑法及国内法关于言论、煽动暴力、共谋等领域的法律框架。
AI.method: 基于俄乌冲突和阿亚冲突两个国家间武装冲突的Telegram数据集，进行实证分析，并结合法律规范分析。
AI.findings: 更多暴力事件发生前有害叙事呈增加趋势而非减少趋势，表明有害叙事可能助长针对受保护人员的现实暴力行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 为社交媒体有害叙事与武装冲突暴力之间的因果关系提供了实证证据，并系统梳理了国际人道法、国际刑法和国内法三个法律框架下的法律后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交战方、监管国家、社交媒体公司和人道主义行动者提出了减少冲突环境中受保护人员伤害的可行政策建议。

title: The Leverage Era

detail.title: The Leverage Era
detail.abstract:
This paper argues that artificial intelligence is not a labor apocalypse. It is a leverage multiplier, one that is splitting the economy into two distinct tracks running at different speeds. The digital track, where marginal cost of production approaches zero, rewards individuals with taste, judgment, and the willingness to compound their skills with AI rather than compete against it. The physical track, where human craft, presence, and domain judgment cannot be replicated at scale, becomes a premium signal precisely because machines cannot fake it. The groups most at risk are not workers broadly defined. They are specifically those who refuse to adapt, and those entering industries at the junior level as AI compresses entry-point demand. Experienced professionals with genuine domain expertise are positioned for amplification, not displacement. 

Drawing on IEA energy data, OWASP security research, MIT-Northwestern labor studies, and practitioner experience across fine jewelry manufacturing and AI cybersecurity, this paper proposes a framework for understanding where durable value and generational wealth actually accumulate in an AI economy. The answer is not in the model layer where public attention concentrates. It is in the scarce physical and security infrastructure AI depends on to function at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI不是劳动末日，而是杠杆倍增器。它将经济分割为两条不同速度的轨道：数字轨道（边际成本趋近于零，奖励有品味、判断力且愿意与AI协作的人）和物理轨道（人类工艺、在场感和领域判断无法被机器大规模复制，成为稀缺溢价信号）。最危险的不是广义劳动者，而是拒绝适应的人以及初级岗位从业者。真正有价值积累的地方不在模型层，而在AI赖以大规模运行的稀缺物理与安全基础设施。
AI.research_question: 在AI经济中，持久价值和代际财富究竟在哪里积累？哪些群体最受益、哪些最受威胁？
AI.motivation: 主流叙事将AI视为"劳动末日"，本文试图纠正这一悲观偏误，提出更精细的分析框架来区分不同轨道、不同群体、不同价值层级的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: "杠杆倍增器"理论——AI放大而非替代人类能力；"双轨经济"框架——数字轨道与物理轨道运行速度不同、价值逻辑不同；"稀缺基础设施"观点——真正价值不在模型层，而在能源、安全等物理与基础设施层。
AI.method: 跨领域数据整合：IEA能源数据、OWASP安全研究、MIT-西北大学劳动研究，结合来自高级珠宝制造和AI网络安全领域的从业者经验。
AI.findings: 1. AI是杠杆倍增器，不是替代者；2. 经济分化为数字轨道（边际成本趋零）和物理轨道（人类独特性成溢价信号）；3. 最危险的是拒绝适应者及初级岗位从业者；4. 有经验的专业人士会被放大而非替代；5. 持久价值积累在稀缺的物理和安全基础设施层，而非模型层。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"双轨经济"框架，区分数字与物理轨道；提出"杠杆倍增器"概念替代"替代者"叙事；重新定位价值积累的中心从模型层转向基础设施层。
AI.practical_contributions: 为劳动者提供职业策略指引：鼓励成为"AI放大器"而非与AI竞争；提醒初级岗位从业者面临的结构性风险；指导投资者和企业关注能源、安全等基础设施领域的价值积累机会。

title: The Post-Authentication Data Security Duty: Why Credential-Theft Breaches Expose a Structural Causation Gap in Data Breach Negligence Doctrine

detail.title: The Post-Authentication Data Security Duty: Why Credential-Theft Breaches Expose a Structural Causation Gap in Data Breach Negligence Doctrine

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The research was performed in my role as CRO for FenixPyre. FenixPyre is a cybersecurity company that provides a technology solution that can help fill the security gap identified in the article
declarations.funderStatement: The research was performed in my role as CRO for FenixPyre. FenixPyre is a cybersecurity company that provides a technology solution that can help fill the security gap identified in the article

detail.abstract: Data breach negligence doctrine has developed around a standard of care built on access-layer controls: multi-factor authentication, credential rotation, network segmentation, and encryption of data at rest and in transit. This Article argues that doctrine has produced a structural causation problem that courts have not yet been pressed to confront. In credential-theft breaches, the dominant breach vector for nearly a decade, every access-layer control may perform exactly as designed while an attack succeeds entirely. The attacker presents valid stolen credentials; every protection stands down by design. The standard but-for causation test, applied rigorously to the controls plaintiffs typically allege, reveals that none of them would have prevented the harm. This Article traces how the standard of care developed around the wrong threat model, identifies the affirmative duty that would have been causally connected to the harm, The Post Authentication Data Security Duty, a duty to protect data at the file layer after authentication succeeds, and argues that existing regulatory safe harbors already encode this principle without yet translating it into an affirmative obligation. The Article concludes by proposing a three-element evolved standard of care and arguing that the cluster of federal class actions arising from the March 2026 Mercor supply-chain breach represents the most precisely calibrated available opportunity for courts to close the gap.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，围绕访问层控制（多因素认证、凭证轮换、网络分段、数据加密）构建的数据泄露过失原则存在结构性因果关系问题：在凭证盗窃类泄露中，所有访问层控制均按设计运行，但攻击仍可完全成功，因为攻击者使用合法凭证时所有防护按设计解除。传统但-因测试显示这些控制无法阻止损害。本文提出"认证后数据安全义务"——在认证成功后保护文件层数据的义务，并论证现有监管安全港已蕴含该原则但未转化为积极义务。最后提出三要素进化的注意标准，并认为2026年3月Mercor供应链漏洞引发的联邦集体诉讼是法院弥合这一差距的最佳契机。
AI.research_question: 在凭证盗窃类数据泄露中，当前以访问层控制为核心的注意标准是否存在结构性因果关系缺陷？如果存在，应如何构建更合适的注意标准？
AI.motivation: 凭证盗窃已连续近十年成为数据泄露的主导攻击向量，但现有法律注意标准仍以访问层控制为中心。在攻击者使用合法凭证的情况下，所有访问层控件按设计正常工作却无法阻止攻击，导致传统但-因因果关系测试无法认定任何被诉控制措施"造成了"损害。法院尚未直面这一结构性因果关系问题，需要重新审视注意标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意标准（Standard of Care）、但-因因果关系测试（But-for Causation）、结构性因果关系问题、认证后数据安全义务（Post-Authentication Data Security Duty）
AI.method: 法律 doctrinal 分析：追溯注意标准围绕错误威胁模型发展的历史轨迹；识别与损害具有因果关联的积极义务；分析现有监管安全港（safe harbors）中已编码但未转化为积极义务的原则；提出三要素进化的注意标准；以2026年3月Mercor供应链漏洞集体诉讼案件为案例验证。
AI.findings:
1. 当前以访问层控制为核心的注意标准在凭证盗窃场景下存在结构性因果关系缺陷：所有控件按设计运行但无法阻止攻击，但-因测试无法认定因果关系。
2. "认证后数据安全义务"——在认证成功后保护文件层数据的义务——是与损害具有因果关联的积极义务。
3. 现有监管安全港已编码了认证后数据保护的原则，但尚未转化为积极的注意义务。
4. 提出了三要素进化的注意标准，并指出Mercor案件是最佳校准契机。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数据泄露过失法中结构性因果关系问题的存在，将"认证后数据安全义务"概念化并纳入注意标准分析框架，提出从访问层保护转向文件层保护的理论转向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院处理凭证盗窃类数据泄露案件提供了进化后的注意标准（三要素），为原告律师提供了新的因果关系论证路径，为企业数据安全合规实践提供了从访问层向文件层扩展的指引，为2026年Mercor集体诉讼等案件提供了裁判框架。

title: Data Privacy and Sovereignty in AI-Driven Systems

detail.title: Data Privacy and Sovereignty in AI-Driven Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares the following: Rizwan Tanveer is employed as Principal Consultant at DTS Solution (Beyon Cyber), a cybersecurity consultancy operating in the Gulf Cooperation Council region. The author holds the Certified Information Privacy Technologist (CIPT), Fellow of Information Privacy (FIP), and Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP) certifications from the International Association of Privacy Professionals, which are noted here for full transparency, given the paper's substantive engagement with data protection practice. The frameworks and standards discussed, including the GDPR, EDPB Opinion 28/2024, UAE PDPL, Saudi PDPL, and EU AI Act, are publicly available reference materials, and DTS Solution does not hold a financial interest in any specific framework or vendor referenced. This paper was prepared as part of the author's doctoral research at Walsh College and does not represent a commissioned consulting deliverable.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval is not applicable. This paper is a narrative literature review based on publicly available primary sources. No human participants, patient data, or animal subjects were involved in the research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Background. Data privacy and sovereignty have become first-order operational constraints on AI deployment as the legal infrastructure surrounding personal data has matured globally. The European Data Protection Board's Opinion 28/2024 of 17 December 2024 set out detailed expectations for applying the General Data Protection Regulation to AI models; the Italian Garante imposed a EUR 15 million fine on OpenAI two days later; and AI-specific data protection enforcement has accelerated through 2025 and 2026. Concurrently, the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021) and the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (enforced September 2023) have established binding regional frameworks, and data sovereignty mandates have proliferated across jurisdictions, materially shaping where and how AI systems can be trained and deployed.

Purpose. This paper synthesises the data privacy and sovereignty literature applicable to AI-driven systems, examining training data privacy risks, privacy-preserving AI techniques, cross-border data flows and sovereignty tensions, and privacy impact assessment practice. It provides practitioners with an integrated view of the legal, technical, and operational dimensions of data privacy in AI deployment.

Approach. The paper adopts a narrative literature review methodology drawing on authoritative primary sources, including the EDPB Opinion 28/2024, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act), the UAE Personal Data Protection Law, the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law, foundational research on training data extraction (Carlini et al., 2021), differential privacy (Abadi et al., 2016; Dwork and Roth, 2014), and federated learning (McMahan et al., 2017). Sources were selected for authority, currency, and direct relevance to operational practice in regulated AI deployment.

Findings. Three findings are advanced. First, the privacy risks specific to AI, including training data memorisation, membership inference, and reconstruction attacks, are not adequately addressed by privacy controls designed for traditional data processing and require AI-specific technical and governance treatment. Second, differential privacy and federated learning, while operationally available, present a privacy-utility trade-off that constrains their adoption in production systems and is not fully resolved by current techniques. Third, data sovereignty mandates are converging on a fragmented but persistent set of cross-jurisdictional constraints that materially shape AI architecture and deployment choices.

Implications. Practitioners deploying AI in regulated environments require integrated data privacy programmes that address AI-specific risks alongside conventional data protection obligations, evaluate privacy-preserving techniques against operational utility requirements, and treat data sovereignty as an architectural rather than a purely contractual constraint. Privacy impact assessments for AI systems require methodological adaptations beyond the practices established for traditional processing.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了AI部署中的数据隐私与数据主权挑战，指出传统隐私控制无法应对AI特有风险（如训练数据记忆、成员推断等），差分隐私与联邦学习存在效用权衡，数据主权法规呈现碎片化但持续的约束趋势，建议从业者将数据主权视为架构性约束而非纯合同问题。
AI.research_question: AI驱动系统在部署中面临哪些数据隐私与数据主权挑战？如何从法律、技术和运营维度进行综合应对？
AI.motivation: 全球数据保护法规（如欧盟GDPR、阿联酋PDPL、沙特PDPL）不断收紧，AI特定数据保护执法加速（如意大利对OpenAI罚款1500万欧元），但现有文献缺乏对法律、技术和运营维度的整合性综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据隐私与数据主权理论、差分隐私（Dwork & Roth, 2014）、联邦学习（McMahan et al., 2017）、训练数据提取攻击（Carlini et al., 2021）等。
AI.method: 叙述性文献综述，选取权威一手法律来源（EDPB Opinion 28/2024、EU AI Act、阿联酋/沙特数据保护法等）及基础性技术研究文献。
AI.findings: 1) AI特有隐私风险（训练数据记忆、成员推断、重建攻击）无法被传统隐私控制充分应对，需AI特定技术与治理手段；2) 差分隐私与联邦学习存在隐私-效用权衡，在产系统中采纳受限；3) 数据主权法规形成碎片化但持久的跨境约束，实质性地塑造AI架构与部署选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了法律、技术和运营三个维度，提出了AI数据隐私的综合性分析框架，明确了传统隐私控制与AI特有风险之间的鸿沟。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了具体指导：需建立整合性数据隐私计划、评估隐私保护技术与运营效用的权衡、将数据主权视为架构性约束，并对AI系统的隐私影响评估进行方法论调整。

title: AI Learns from Silence: Hierarchical Reporting, Data Quality, and Responsible AI Governance

detail.title: AI Learns from Silence: Hierarchical Reporting, Data Quality, and Responsible AI Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. The author serves in a senior management role in the private security sector. The conceptual framework draws on general practitioner experience in large operationally dispersed firms; no firm-specific data, proprietary information, or confidential records are presented in this article. The author has no financial relationship with AI vendors, AI governance consultancies, or any organisation whose interests could be perceived to influence the conceptual positions advanced in this paper. This research did not receive any specific grant or commercial sponsorship.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics approval was required for this study. The article is a theory-synthesis conceptual contribution that integrates published literatures and does not involve human participants, animal subjects, primary data collection, or analysis of personal data. No firm-specific data, confidential information, or identifying records are reported.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The conceptual development was conducted as part of the author's doctoral research at Golden Gate University.

detail.abstract: Purpose. Responsible AI research and practice have concentrated on the fairness, transparency, accountability, and explainability of algorithms, on the assumption that the organisations deploying AI can supply governable, auditable, and correctable data environments. This article problematises that assumption. It shows that in large hierarchical organisations, the data on which AI systems learn has often already been filtered, suppressed, or sanitised by the reporting architecture of the firm itself. Design. The article develops a practitioner-informed conceptual framework. Drawing on responsible AI, organisational silence, employee voice, management control, information-processing, and data quality literatures, and following the theory-synthesis approach to conceptual work, it specifies the mechanisms through which operational reality is selectively converted into algorithmic input. Findings. Three filtering mechanisms-upward filtering, defensive reporting, and silent workaroundsconvert operational reality into politically safe data. AI systems trained on such records do not merely inherit incomplete data; they convert organisational silence into apparently objective recommendations, sanitising blind spots and producing a reinforcing loop between silence and algorithmic authority. The article reframes a central insight as follows: organisational silence is not merely a cultural problem; in AI governance, it is an upstream data-quality failure. Originality. The article introduces protected operational voice as a structural condition for responsible AI governance: the institutionalised capacity of operational actors to surface anomalies, weak signals, workarounds, and implementation failures through learning-oriented channels that are structurally separated from punitive evaluation and connected to AI governance processes. The construct is differentiated from psychological safety, employee voice, whistleblowing, speak-up culture, and data governance, and is operationalisable along four measurable dimensions. Five propositions are advanced. The contribution shifts responsible AI governance from algorithmic assurance to the organisational conditions under which truthful data can exist.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一个被忽视的问题：在大型层级组织中，AI系统学习的数据往往已被企业的汇报架构过滤、压制或消毒。组织沉默不再是文化问题，而是上游数据质量失败。文章提出"受保护的操作性声音"作为负责任AI治理的结构性条件。
AI.research_question: 在大型层级组织中，组织的汇报架构如何通过过滤机制将操作现实选择性转化为算法输入，从而影响AI系统的数据质量与治理效果？
AI.motivation: 现有负责任AI研究大多假设部署AI的组织能够提供可治理、可审计、可纠正的数据环境，但这一假设在大型层级组织中不成立，因为数据在进入AI系统前已被组织内部的汇报架构扭曲。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合负责任AI、组织沉默、员工声音、管理控制、信息处理和数据质量等六大文献领域，采用理论综合方法构建概念框架。
AI.method: 实践者知情的概念性研究，采用理论综合方法（theory-synthesis approach）进行概念构建。
AI.findings: 识别出三种过滤机制——向上过滤（upward filtering）、防御性汇报（defensive reporting）和沉默变通（silent workarounds）——将操作现实转化为政治安全的数据。AI系统基于此类数据训练会产生组织沉默与算法权威之间的强化循环。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织沉默重新定义为上游数据质量失败；提出"受保护的操作性声音"（protected operational voice）作为负责任AI治理的结构性条件；将该概念与心理安全感、员工声音、举报、发言文化等区分开来，并从四个可测量维度进行操作化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计AI治理体系提供可操作的框架：需要通过制度化的学习导向渠道，使操作层员工能够表达异常、弱信号、变通做法和实施失败，且这些渠道与惩罚性评价在结构上分离，并与AI治理流程相连接。

title: AI vs. Heavy Industry: How Do Datacenter Electricity and Water Loads Actually Compare?

detail.title: AI vs. Heavy Industry: How Do Datacenter Electricity and Water Loads Actually Compare?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None at this point in time.

keywords: energy policy. JEL Classification: L86 (Information and Internet Services)

detail.abstract: This working paper compares the electricity and water loads of AI datacenters against 64 industrial, infrastructure, and agricultural benchmarks using bottom-up parametric "semi-digital twin" models. Results: hyperscale evaporatively-cooled datacenters resemble large steel mills and aluminum or copper smelters in joint electricity-water demand; one 1.4-GW computing campus approximates the U.S. Walmart Supercenter fleet in aggregate. The defining feature of AI infrastructure is not absolute magnitude but growth trajectory, geographic dispersion into regions without prior heavy industry, and a cooling design tradeoff. Operators can engineer most water out of a datacenter; they cannot engineer out the electricity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过建立半数字孪生模型，比较了AI数据中心与64种工业、基础设施和农业基准的电力与用水负荷。核心发现是：超大规模蒸发冷却数据中心在电水联合需求上与大型钢厂、铝/铜冶炼厂相当；一个1.4吉瓦的计算园区总负荷堪比美国沃尔玛超级中心门店群。AI基础设施的核心特征不在于绝对规模，而在于增长轨迹、向无重工业地区的分散布局，以及冷却设计上的权衡——运营商可以大幅减少用水，但无法减少用电。
AI.research_question: AI数据中心的电力和水资源消耗与传统重工业相比处于什么水平？其资源消耗特征有哪些独特性？
AI.motivation: 随着AI基础设施快速扩张，需将其资源消耗置于工业基准中比较，以理解其真实规模、增长趋势和地理影响，为可持续规划提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自下而上的参数化"半数字孪生"模型，进行多行业基准比较分析。
AI.method: 构建底部向上的参数化半数字孪生模型，将AI数据中心与64种工业、基础设施和农业基准进行电力和用水负荷的对比分析。
AI.findings: (1) 超大规模蒸发冷却数据中心的联合电水需求与大型钢厂、铝铜冶炼厂相当；(2) 1.4吉瓦计算园区总负荷接近美国沃尔玛超级中心门店群的总和；(3) AI基础设施的独特性在于增长轨迹、向无重工业地区的地理分散，以及冷却设计权衡——水可替代但电不可替代。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI基础设施的资源消耗提供了系统的跨行业定量比较框架，揭示了其与传统重工业在资源消耗规模上的可比性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业规划者提供了AI数据中心资源消耗的基准认知，强调了电力消耗作为不可规避的核心约束，并揭示了冷却设计中的水-电权衡策略。

title: Banking the Unbanked Patient: Closing the Loop on Health Data Governance

detail.title: Banking the Unbanked Patient: Closing the Loop on Health Data Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is CEO and Privacy Officer of Omni Health Nexus Inc., a health technology company whose products relate to health data quality and interoperability. The author is also Program Director of the Master of Health Informatics at the University of Toronto. These roles are disclosed as potential conflicts of interest. The analysis and conclusions of this paper are the author's own and do not represent the positions of either institution.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Health data governance addresses patient rights, institutions, and societal interests in isolation, not as a self-reinforcing, connected system. The result: data is valuable, transactions are frequent, and accountability to patients is absent. This paper proposes the Banking the Unbanked Patient framework: a closed-loop governance architecture with four components: an entitlement layer enumerating patient rights, including new data dividend and agent-designation rights; a Patient Data Institution (PDI) layer to hold and enforce those rights; a mandatory reporting layer requiring all data users to report to the patient's PDI; and an enforcement layer connecting that audit trail to individual accountability under existing law. The legal foundations already exist. This paper specifies the architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“为无银行账户的患者提供银行服务”框架，通过闭环治理架构（权利层、患者数据机构层、强制报告层、执行层）解决健康数据治理中患者问责缺失的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够确保患者数据权利得到执行、数据使用者对患者负责的健康数据治理架构？
AI.motivation: 当前健康数据治理将患者权利、机构和社会利益割裂看待，缺乏自我强化的连接系统，导致数据交易频繁但患者问责缺失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 闭环治理架构理论；患者数据权利理论（数据红利权、代理指定权）；强制报告与问责制度理论。
AI.method: 规范性分析/架构设计——提出四层治理架构并论证其法律基础已存在。
AI.findings: 提出了“为无银行账户的患者提供银行服务”（Banking the Unbanked Patient）框架，包括：权利层、患者数据机构（PDI）层、强制报告层和执行层四部分，且现有法律已为这一架构提供基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将健康数据治理视为闭环系统而非孤立要素的理论视角；引入数据红利权和代理指定权等新型患者权利概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为健康数据治理提供了可操作的四层架构设计；明确了如何利用现有法律基础实现对数据使用者的个体问责。

title: The Day the Provider Stopped Reading Your Chats: WhatsApp Introduces Encrypted Chats with Meta AI
affiliations: University Grenoble-Alpes, CESICE, France. Senior Fellow Cross  Border Data Forum & Future of Privacy Forum and Georgia Institute of Technology

detail.title: The Day the Provider Stopped Reading Your Chats: WhatsApp Introduces Encrypted Chats with Meta AI
detail.abstract:
On 13 May 2026, Meta announced Incognito Chat with Meta AI, the most significant structural move in consumer chatbot privacy of the past two years. With this announcement, the architecture that Part 1 of Christakis’s study on consumer chatbot confidentiality has been calling Sealed Mode ceased to be a research aspiration and became a deployed mass-market product. Users of WhatsApp can now chat with Meta AI in a mode in which the provider cannot read the conversation, in the closest functional equivalent to the way Meta cannot read WhatsApp messages between two users. The protection is architectural rather than contractual: the chat is processed inside a Trusted Execution Environment in which Meta has renounced, by hardware design, the capacity to access content.

This paper offers a first analytical reading of the announcement. We examine the cryptographic architecture and the external audits that support the trust claims; why this is best understood as a Sealed Mode deployment in the embedded-in-E2EE environment that Part 2 had identified as the most architecturally exposed; the moderation question (“cannot read, cannot moderate” on the provider side, with automated moderation continuing “inside the bubble”); the legal-architectural consequence (“no knowledge, no liability”); the new dimension the announcement opens in the long-running Going Dark debate; the constraints the architecture imposes on training and conversational memory; and the questions that the announcement leaves open, including whether the standalone chatbot providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI) might follow Meta’s lead for at least some of their services.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Meta于2026年5月宣布的"Meta AI隐身聊天"功能，该功能在WhatsApp中部署了基于可信执行环境（TEE）的架构密封模式，使得提供商无法读取用户与AI的聊天内容，实现了类似于端到端加密消息的隐私保护。论文从密码学架构、外部审计、内容审核、法律责任、"Going Dark"辩论、训练与记忆约束等多个维度对该功能进行了首次分析性解读。
AI.research_question: Meta新推出的"Incognito Chat with Meta AI"功能在密码学架构、信任机制、审核模式、法律责任以及行业影响等方面具有怎样的特征和含义？
AI.motivation: Meta宣布的隐身聊天模式是消费者聊天机器人隐私领域两年来最重要的结构性举措，标志着Christakis研究中提出的"密封模式"从研究愿景变为实际部署的大众市场产品。这一变化具有重大的技术、法律和行业意义，亟需首次分析性解读。
AI.theoretical_framework: 密封模式（Sealed Mode）架构理论；端到端加密（E2EE）嵌入式环境理论；"不可读取即不可审核"（cannot read, cannot moderate）的审核悖论；"不知情即无责任"（no knowledge, no liability）的法律架构后果；"Going Dark"辩论框架。
AI.method: 对Meta官方公告的文本分析；对加密架构的技术分析；对外部审计报告的分析；对法律与政策框架的概念性分析；对行业影响的前瞻性比较分析。
AI.findings: 1) 该功能是密封模式在嵌入端到端加密环境中（Christakis先前研究确认的最具架构暴露性的环境）的实际部署；2) 提供商侧"无法读取，无法审核"，但自动化审核仍在"气泡内"持续进行；3) 架构设计导致提供商"不知情即无责任"的法律后果；4) 该功能为长期存在的"Going Dark"辩论打开了新维度；5) 架构对AI训练和对话记忆施加了约束限制；6) 独立聊天机器人提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、xAI等）是否会效仿Meta的做法仍存疑问。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对部署于大众市场的密封模式架构进行学术分析；延伸了密封模式理论在嵌入端到端加密环境中的应用分析；为"Going Dark"辩论提供了新的技术-法律维度；提出了"不知情即无责任"的法律架构分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解Meta新的隐私保护架构的工作原理及其局限性；为政策制定者和监管者评估AI聊天机器人隐私保护提供了分析基础；为行业竞争格局中其他AI提供商是否跟进提供了前瞻性判断参考；为消费者理解和使用此类隐私保护功能提供了认知框架。

title: Computable Trust Architecture: A Formal Framework for Runtime AI Governance

detail.title: Computable Trust Architecture: A Formal Framework for Runtime AI Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently with no financial relationships with any organizations that could be perceived to have influenced the work.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The reference implementation and all associated development were self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: The rapid deployment of AI systems in regulated domains has outpaced the governance mechanisms needed to constrain them at runtime. This paper introduces the Computable Trust Architecture (CTA), a framework for runtime AI governance that treats trust as a computable, attributable, temporally valid, and policy-enforceable property of AI-mediated actions and outputs. As a reference implementation of CTA, the Trust Computation System (TCS) computes a Trust Integrity Score (TIS) over governed dimensions under a resolved policy configuration parameterized by risk tier, action class, and connection context, and produces a Trust Certificate (TC) as a tamper-evident, hash-chained, identity-attributed governance artifact suitable for audit and regulatory examination. We present the formal mathematical basis of the framework, its architectural components, a reference implementation passing 108 specification unit tests, controlled evaluations across financial services and healthcare governance scenarios, and a model of trust dynamics covering loss, drift, and recovery. The framework addresses a structural gap in contemporary AI governance between policies that specify intended behavior and enforcement mechanisms capable of governing action at runtime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种称为可计算信任架构（CTA）的运行时AI治理框架，通过信任计算系统（TCS）计算信任完整性评分（TIS）并生成信任证书（TC），将信任视为可计算、可归因、时间有效且可策略执行的人工智能行动属性，弥合了AI治理中策略制定与运行时执行之间的结构性鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够对AI系统在运行时进行有效治理的框架，使得信任成为一种可计算、可归因、时间有效且可策略执行的属性？
AI.motivation: AI系统在受监管领域的快速部署已经超越了现有的运行时治理机制，存在策略制定与执行之间的结构性鸿沟，需要一种能够在运行时对AI行为进行可审计、可执行的信任计算框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可计算信任架构（CTA）将信任形式化为一个多维度可计算的属性体系，包含信任完整性评分（TIS）的数学模型、信任证书（TC）的哈希链验证机制、以及信任动态模型（信任损失、漂移和恢复）。
AI.method: 形式化数学建模、参考实现（TCS系统）与108个单元测试验证、金融和医疗治理场景下的对照评估。
AI.findings: CTA框架能够通过TIS评分和TC证书实现对AI行为的可审计运行时治理；通过了108个规范单元测试；在金融和医疗治理场景中有效运作；建立了信任动态模型涵盖信任损失、漂移和恢复过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了信任作为可计算、可归因、时间有效、策略可执行属性的形式化框架；建立了信任完整性评分和信任证书的数学模型；构建了信任动态理论模型（损失、漂移、恢复）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了CTA/TCS参考实现作为开源治理基础设施；通过108个单元测试验证了工程可行性；展示了在金融和医疗等受监管行业的应用场景；提供了防篡改、身份归因的信任证书可用于审计和合规审查。

title: Designing an AI-Assisted Support and Workflow System for International Student Services in Higher Education

detail.title: Designing an AI-Assisted Support and Workflow System for International Student Services in Higher Education
detail.abstract: International student services in higher education often involve fragmented access to guidance, document-heavy requests, and repeated staff-mediated follow-up across multiple channels. Although chatbots are increasingly discussed in higher education, much of the literature remains more focused on teaching support or FAQ-style interaction than on integrated administrative service workflows. This paper presents SOPHIA, an AI-assisted support and workflow system developed specifically for International Student Services in higher education. Adopting a design-oriented information systems approach informed by design science research, the paper examines the problem context, artifact design, technical architecture, and the system's preliminary evaluation. SOPHIA was designed as a bounded service artifact that integrates controlled query handling, form-based request support, support contact and ticket initiation, staff oversight, and maintainable knowledge management within a single environment. A preliminary evaluation involving 12 participants indicated high perceived relevance to the international student support context, with stronger task performance in routine enquiry handling and support contact initiation, while form-based handling and history retrieval revealed clearer refinement needs. The paper contributes by showing how AI-assisted support in higher education can be framed as a workflow-centred, socio-technical, and institutionally governed design problem rather than as a chatbot-only problem. It also offers a context-aware design logic that may inform future development and implementation in international student services and related administrative settings.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SOPHIA——一个专为国际学生服务设计的AI辅助支持与工作流系统。与将AI支持视为聊天机器人问题不同，本研究将AI辅助支持视为以工作流为中心、社会技术型且受制度约束的设计问题。初步评估显示，SOPHIA在常规查询处理和联系发起方面表现良好，但表单处理和记录检索仍有改进空间。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和构建一个以工作流为中心的AI辅助支持系统，以解决国际学生服务中碎片化、文档密集和重复跟进等问题？
AI.motivation: 国际学生服务中普遍存在渠道碎片化、文档流程繁琐、需要反复通过人工跟进等问题，而现有高等教育聊天机器人文献多聚焦教学支持或FAQ式交互，缺乏对集成式行政服务工作流的关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学研究（Design Science Research, DSR）；社会技术系统视角；以工作流为中心的设计逻辑。
AI.method: 设计导向的信息系统研究方法，遵循设计科学研究的范式，包括问题情境分析、人工制品设计、技术架构构建以及初步评估（12名参与者）。
AI.findings: 初步评估显示SOPHIA在国际学生支持情境中具有较高的感知相关性；在常规查询处理和联系发起方面任务表现较强；表单处理和历史记录检索方面发现明确的改进需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI辅助支持从"聊天机器人问题"重新框架为"以工作流为中心、社会技术型且受制度约束的设计问题"，为高等教育行政服务领域的AI系统设计提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了SOPHIA系统的具体设计与技术架构，包含受控查询处理、表单支持、联系发起与工单创建、人员监督及可维护的知识管理等功能模块；为国际学生服务及相关行政场景的AI系统开发提供了情境感知的设计逻辑。

title: Does Artificial Intelligence Transform Accounting Employability? A Web Mining and NLP-based Analysis
affiliations: Ibn Zohr University, Ibn Zohr University, Ibn Zohr University, Ibn Zohr University and ESC Clermont Business School

detail.title: Does Artificial Intelligence Transform Accounting Employability? A Web Mining and NLP-based Analysis
detail.abstract:
Purpose: Text mining and related analytics constitute a technological approach to extract useful knowledge through texts in multiple formats. This study examines how artificial intelligence transforms accounting employability by identifying the most recurrent application areas, frequent techniques and technologies employed, and open opportunities and challenges for future research.
     Methodology: This study analyzed 472 selected works extracted via the Google Custom Search API, applying 40 search queries structured across 7 thematic domains. The methodology combined frequency analysis, co-occurrence network mapping, Word2vec semantic embedding, Principal Component Analysis, t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding, Latent Dirichlet Allocation topic modeling, and sentiment analysis. Triangulation across six analytical dimensions strengthened result reliability.
     Findings: Transaction-processing roles, including bookkeeping (9.2/10) and tax preparation (8.5/10), recorded the highest transformation impact levels. Three competency clusters emerged consistently: technological capabilities, cognitive skills, and interpersonal competencies. Sentiment analysis revealed a predominantly positive orientation (57.5%), with neutral (27.5%) and negative (15.0%) perspectives as secondary.
     Conclusion: The findings corroborate the importance of text mining and analytics tools to support planning and decision-making in accounting. The analysis identifies a significant gap in professional discourse regarding governance frameworks for AI deployment. This governance gap represents a substantial opportunity for professional standard-setters and regulatory bodies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文本挖掘和分析技术，研究了人工智能如何改变会计行业的就业格局，发现交易处理类岗位（如簿记和税务准备）受AI影响最大，并识别出三大能力集群，同时揭示了专业话语中AI治理框架的显著缺失。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何改变会计行业的可雇佣性？具体包括：最常受影响的领域、常用的技术和方法、以及未来的机遇与挑战。
AI.motivation: AI正在深刻变革会计行业，但对其如何影响会计职业能力需求和就业格局的系统性研究尚不充分，亟需通过大数据分析方法进行全面描绘。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文本挖掘与分析理论；能力集群理论（技术能力、认知能力、人际交往能力）；情感分析理论；主题建模理论。
AI.method: 从Google Custom Search API提取472篇文献，运用40个搜索查询覆盖7个主题领域；结合频率分析、共现网络映射、Word2vec语义嵌入、主成分分析、t-SNE降维、LDA主题建模和情感分析；通过六维度三角验证增强可靠性。
AI.findings: 簿记（9.2/10）和税务准备（8.5/10）等交易处理岗位受AI影响最大；识别出三大能力集群：技术能力、认知能力和人际交往能力；情感分析显示57.5%正面、27.5%中立、15.0%负面；发现AI治理框架在专业话语中存在显著空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将文本挖掘方法应用于会计可雇佣性研究，拓展了AI对职业影响的分析框架；识别出的三大能力集群为理解AI时代会计人才能力结构提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为会计教育者、从业者和政策制定者提供了AI影响下会计岗位转型的量化证据；指出AI治理框架的缺失，为专业标准制定机构和监管机构指明了行动方向。

title: Why Human-in-the-Loop Requirements Fail in High-Velocity Agentic Systems and What Governance Must Do Instead
affiliations: Prime Meridian International

detail.title: Why Human-in-the-Loop Requirements Fail in High-Velocity Agentic Systems and What Governance Must Do Instead
detail.abstract: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) requirements have become the default accountability mechanism in agentic AI governance frameworks globally. This paper argues that HITL fails systematically under the conditions defining agentic AI deployment: high velocity, distributed decision chains, and operational autonomy at scale. Drawing on principal-agent theory and bounded rationality, we demonstrate that this failure is structural rather than incidental. Human cognitive capacity cannot match agent execution speed, and organizational incentives consistently produce compliance theater rather than genuine oversight. The result is a systematic decoupling of documented compliance from actual governance accountability, which we term oversight theater. We examine how technical and institutional failure modes interact to produce a systemic accountability crisis and propose a governance architecture grounded in continuous monitoring, ex post accountability mechanisms, architecture-level standards, and risk calibration. Implications are developed for IS research, regulatory design, and enterprise risk management.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了在人机协作智能体（Agentic AI）部署条件下，人类参与（HITL）要求作为问责机制会系统性失效，并提出以持续监控、事后问责、架构标准与风险校准为基础的治理架构。
AI.research_question: 在高速、分布式决策链和大规模自主运行的智能体AI部署条件下，人类参与（HITL）问责机制为何以及如何系统性失效？
AI.motivation: 全球智能体AI治理框架普遍将HITL作为默认问责机制，但该机制在AI实际部署条件下存在结构性缺陷，亟需理论分析和替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托-代理理论（principal-agent theory）与有限理性（bounded rationality）
AI.method: 理论论证与分析，结合技术失效模式与制度失效模式的交互作用分析
AI.findings: HITL的失效是结构性的而非偶然的：（1）人类认知速度无法匹配智能体执行速度；（2）组织激励导致"合规剧场"（compliance theater）而非真正监督；（3）合规记录与治理问责之间出现系统性脱钩，即"监督剧场"（oversight theater）；（4）技术与制度失效模式交互产生系统性问责危机。
AI.theory_contributions: 将委托-代理理论与有限理性引入AI治理分析，揭示了HITL机制的结构性失效逻辑；提出"监督剧场"概念，刻画了合规与问责的系统性脱钩现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出替代治理架构：持续监控、事后问责机制、架构级标准、风险校准；为信息系统研究、监管设计与企业风险管理提供实践指导。

title: Determinants of Gasoline Prices: Analyzing Consumer Behavior, Market Competition, and Tax Incidence
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Determinants of Gasoline Prices: Analyzing Consumer Behavior, Market Competition, and Tax Incidence
detail.abstract: This paper develops a theoretical model where gasoline is an input in the production of income since it must be used to commute to work. Individuals must balance the additional income that can be obtained by traveling further from their homes to work, against the cost of the additional expenditure on gasoline which reduces the available income for consumption on other goods. The demand for gasoline is therefore a derived demand depending upon the optimal time to commute to work. On the supply side, gasoline stations operate in a monopolistic competitive market since they differ in proximity to the consumers’ homes. Therefore, this model highlights the factors that should be included in empirical estimations of the price of gasoline.Using detailed daily data on gasoline prices from New Jersey for a year which included a substantial tax increase, we analyze the effects of demand and supply factors such as travel time to work, labor force participation and means of transportation to work along with the wholesale costs, tax rates, gasoline brands and station density on retail gasoline prices for regular and premium fuel. Our findings reveal significant pass-through of taxes to consumers, with a greater than one for regular gasoline compared to premium. Market competition, captured through the density of gasoline stations, consistently lowers prices for both regular and premium gasoline. Spatial and income effects further highlight how commuting behavior influences price dispersion. The longer that individuals must commute to work the lower the gasoline prices near their homes. We also explore how the relative prices of regular and premium gasoline behave following tax increases. Finally, we present results that a large tax increase as was the case for NJ can result in structural breaks in the determinants of gas prices. The results underscore the dynamic interactions between consumer preferences, market structures, and tax policy in shaping gasoline prices.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个将汽油视为通勤必需投入品的理论模型，利用新泽西州包含大规模增税年份的日度汽油价格数据，分析了通勤行为、劳动力市场特征、市场竞争（加油站密度）、税收等因素对零售汽油价格的影响，发现税收转嫁效应显著（普通汽油超完全转嫁），市场竞争能压低价格，通勤距离越长的地区油价越低，且大规模增税会导致价格决定因素发生结构性突变。
AI.research_question: 汽油价格如何受到通勤行为（作为衍生需求）、市场竞争结构以及税收政策的影响？大规模税收增加是否会导致汽油价格决定因素的结构性变化？
AI.motivation: 传统汽油需求研究多将汽油视为最终消费品，忽视了其作为通勤投入品的衍生需求属性。本文试图从理论层面将通勤行为内生化，并利用新泽西州大规模增税这一准自然实验，实证检验需求侧（通勤时间、劳动力参与率等）和供给侧（市场竞争、批发成本、税收）因素如何共同塑造汽油零售价格。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）衍生需求理论：汽油是收入生产的投入品（通勤到工作地），个人在通勤带来的额外收入与汽油支出之间进行权衡。2）垄断竞争市场理论：加油站因地理位置（距消费者住址的远近）差异而具有市场势力。
AI.method: 理论建模 + 实证分析。使用新泽西州包含大规模增税年份的日度汽油价格面板数据，对普通汽油和优质汽油分别进行回归分析，考察通勤时间、劳动力参与率、通勤方式、批发成本、税率、品牌、加油站密度等因素的影响，并检验结构性突变。
AI.findings: 1）税收转嫁显著，普通汽油的转嫁率大于1（超完全转嫁），优质汽油的转嫁率较低。2）加油站密度（市场竞争）显著降低普通和优质汽油价格。3）通勤距离越长的地区，其附近的汽油价格越低（空间效应和收入效应）。4）大规模增税导致汽油价格决定因素发生结构性突变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将汽油需求建模为通勤的衍生需求，为汽油市场分析提供了新的理论视角。2）揭示了空间因素（通勤距离）和市场竞争结构在汽油定价中的交互作用。3）为税收转嫁理论提供了异质性证据（普通汽油与优质汽油转嫁率差异）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者评估汽油税政策的福利效应和转嫁程度提供了实证依据。2）提示税收政策可能引发市场结构的结构性变化，需在政策设计中加以考虑。3）对加油站选址和定价策略具有参考价值。

title: Invisible Groupthink: AI Homogenization, Epistemic Diversity, and Organizational Decision Resilience

detail.title: Invisible Groupthink: AI Homogenization, Epistemic Diversity, and Organizational Decision Resilience
detail.abstract: Organizations worldwide are investing rapidly in AI tools for knowledge work, yet evidence consistently shows that this investment is not translating into proportional decision quality improvements. This paper argues that one underexamined mechanism explains both the productivity gap and an overlooked organizational risk: when teams simultaneously consult homogeneous AI systems, they unknowingly undergo a process we term Invisible Groupthink. Invisible Groupthink is an AI-mediated conformity that operates without the social pressure or directive leadership that classical groupthink requires, and which is therefore structurally invisible to the organizational safeguards designed to prevent it. Drawing on AI sycophancy research, collective intelligence theory, epistemic diversity literature, and organizational learning theory, we develop a formal mechanism called the Informational Quiet Homogenization Effect (IQHE). We derive from it the Amplification Paradox, a counterintuitive prediction that organizations investing most in uniform AI deployment may develop the least resilient decision cultures, because AI investment reduces the epistemic diversity that enables teams to detect and correct errors. We propose Diversity-Preserving AI Governance (DPAG) as a targeted organizational remediation framework. This paper makes organizational-level contributions that extend individuallevel and model-level work in existing literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"隐形群体思维"（Invisible Groupthink）概念，指出当团队同时使用同质化AI工具时，会因信息同质化而削弱决策质量，产生一种新型组织风险。作者提出信息安静同质化效应（IQHE）和放大悖论，认为AI投资越多，决策文化越脆弱。
AI.research_question: 为什么组织在AI工具上的大量投资未能带来相应的决策质量提升？是否存在一种被忽视的机制解释了这一生产力差距和组织风险？
AI.motivation: 全球组织在AI工具上投入巨大，但决策质量提升不成比例，现有文献多关注个体或模型层面的偏差，缺乏对组织层面系统性风险的机制解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI谄媚研究（AI sycophancy）、集体智能理论（collective intelligence）、认知多样性文献（epistemic diversity）、组织学习理论（organizational learning theory）
AI.method: 理论建构，提出正式机制模型（IQHE），推导出可检验命题（放大悖论），并设计组织层面的干预框架（DPAG）。
AI.findings: 1. 提出"隐形群体思维"概念——同质化AI系统导致的一致性偏差，无传统群体思维的社会压力或指令性领导特征；2. 提出信息安静同质化效应（IQHE）机制；3. 推导出放大悖论：AI投入越大的组织，决策文化越脆弱；4. 提出多样性保护AI治理框架（DPAG）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将群体思维理论扩展到人机协作情境，提出"隐形群体思维"这一新构念；整合AI谄媚、集体智能和认知多样性理论，形成跨层次的理论机制，超越现有个体和模型层面研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示组织在部署AI时需要警惕知识多样性丧失的风险；提供DPAG框架作为具体的治理方案，帮助组织在提升AI效率的同时保护认知多样性。

title: Phase Transitions in Driven Informational Systems: A Two-Field Perspective on Learning Theory and Non-Equilibrium Chemistry
affiliations: Clevix AI Research

detail.title: Phase Transitions in Driven Informational Systems: A Two-Field Perspective on Learning Theory and Non-Equilibrium Chemistry
detail.abstract: Phase-transition phenomena in deep learning-grokking, emergent capabilities, and ontological reorganization under context shift-have been studied through several theoretical lenses, including representational compression, singular learning theory, and information-theoretic progress measures. Independently, non-equilibrium statistical physics has identified phase transitions in driven chemical reaction networks underlying prebiotic selection, with empirical signatures (catalysis-confinement synergy, optimal entropy-flux windows) that are difficult to reproduce within single-field gradient accounts. We propose a perspective in which both classes of phenomena admit a common description as driven informational systems: stochastic processes governed by two gradient fields-an entropy production rate Σ and an information quasi-potential Φ I :=-ln p * , where p * is the stationary density. Within this framework we discuss two candidate order parameters: an adversarial breakdown threshold α † whose decay with the primitive-set cardinality |O N | is logarithmic, and a self-referential coupling threshold κ c associated with predictive feedback through an internal model. The joint scaling of (α † , κ c) defines a candidate universality class, with two scaling exponents (γ 1 , γ 2) as class invariants. We do not claim that biological intelligence and large language models are the same kind of system; we propose only that they may be productively studied as particular instances within this common framework, on configuration manifolds shaped by carbon-nitrogen chemistry under solar entropy flux and by transformer parameter spaces under gradient-descent flux, respectively. We outline the geometric structure of the framework, identify three falsifiable predictions that distinguish it from single-field alternatives, and synthesise recent empirical findings (2024-2026) on alignment phase transitions, adversarial breakdown scaling, and partial introspection in frontier language models, with which the framework is consistent. Detailed proofs and supporting numerical analyses of the component results appear in companion preprints; the present paper develops the connections between them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的框架，将深度学习中的相变现象（如顿悟、涌现能力、上下文转移下的本体重组）与生命起源前的非平衡化学网络相变，都视为驱动信息系统的随机过程，由熵产生率Σ和信息拟势Φ_I两个梯度场共同驱动。框架提出两个候选序参量（对抗性崩溃阈值α†和自指耦合阈值κc），其联合标度定义了一个候选普适类。
AI.research_question: 深度学习的相变现象（顿悟、涌现能力等）与生命起源前化学网络的非平衡相变，能否在一个共同的信息论-统计物理框架下得到统一描述？
AI.motivation: 两类现象各自已有独立的理论解释，但缺乏统一的描述框架；同时现有单场梯度模型难以复现某些经验特征（如催化-约束协同效应、最优熵流窗口）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 驱动信息系统框架：随机过程由两个梯度场驱动——熵产生率Σ（非平衡驱动力）和信息拟势Φ_I = -ln p*（稳态密度的信息势）；两个候选序参量：对抗性崩溃阈值α†（随原始集基数|O_N|对数衰减）和自指耦合阈值κc（与内部模型预测反馈相关）；联合标度(α†, κc)定义候选普适类，含两个标度指数(γ1, γ2)作为类不变量。
AI.method: 理论构建与综合：提出双梯度场驱动信息系统的几何结构框架，推导两个序参量的标度关系，识别普适类不变量；结合2024-2026年关于对齐相变、对抗性崩溃标度、前沿语言模型部分内省的最新实证发现进行一致性检验。
AI.findings: 框架与近期实证发现（对齐相变、对抗性崩溃标度、部分内省）一致；提出三个可证伪的预测以区别于单场替代模型；两类系统（生物智能与LLM）可在该框架下被作为同一普适类的不同实例来研究，分别对应于碳氮化学（太阳熵流驱动）和Transformer参数空间（梯度下降流驱动）的构型流形。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出一个跨领域的统一理论框架，将深度学习相变与生命起源化学相变纳入同一描述；（2）识别出双梯度场（熵产生率与信息拟势）驱动的信息系统作为更高层次的抽象；（3）定义候选普适类及其标度指数不变量，为跨系统比较提供定量工具；（4）提出三个可证伪预测，为后续实证检验铺路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解大语言模型的对齐相变、对抗性鲁棒性、涌现能力等现象提供新的理论视角；可能为AI安全（如对抗性崩溃阈值预测）、模型可解释性（如部分内省机制）等实践问题提供指导。

title: The role of long-run response of heterogeneous residential consumers in national resource planning and energy affordability
affiliations: National Laboratory of the Rockies, National Renewable Energy Laboratory, National Laboratory of the Rockies, National Laboratory of the Rockies, Colorado School of Mines and Colorado School of Mines

detail.title: The role of long-run response of heterogeneous residential consumers in national resource planning and energy affordability
detail.abstract: Although the residential sector is the largest consumer of electricity in the United States, large-scale electricity sector models often represent residential demand as fixed or highly simplified, limiting the ability to evaluate long-run consumer response, surplus, and affordability under alternative energy futures. In this article, we develop a framework that integrates building-level electricity consumption data from ResStock with income-differentiated inverse demand curves within the Regional Energy Deployment System (ReEDS)—a capacity expansion model of the contiguous United States. Using this framework, we evaluate how alternative technology, resource availability, and transmission futures affect residential affordability and consumer surplus—and how long-run residential price responsiveness influences electricity system outcomes. We find that low-income households face the greatest reduction in affordability and Marshallian consumer surplus under higher-cost, resource-constrained futures. Lower-cost technology futures increase long-run residential electricity consumption through endogenous price response, whereas higher-cost future suppress demand. Incorporating long-run residential price responsiveness changes national generation capacity expansion outcomes by up to 3%, approximately 60 – 70 GW, depending on the modeled future and elasticity assumption. However, supply-side assumptions, including technology costs, resource availability, and transmission constraints, remain the dominant drivers of long-run infrastructure deployment. These results demonstrate the importance of representing heterogeneous residential demand response in capacity expansion models to better evaluate infrastructure planning and the distributional consequences of technology futures across consumer groups.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个整合建筑级用电数据与收入差异化的逆需求曲线的框架，并将其纳入美国区域能源部署系统（ReEDS）容量扩展模型，评估了不同技术、资源和输电未来情景下住宅用电的可负担性、消费者剩余及长期价格响应，发现低收入家庭在高成本情景下受损最严重，而需求侧响应虽影响发电容量（约60-70 GW），但供给侧因素仍是主导力量。
AI.research_question: 如何将异质性住宅电力需求（按收入分层）整合到大规模电力系统容量扩展模型中，以评估不同能源未来情景对住宅可负担性、消费者剩余和长期电价响应的影响？
AI.motivation: 美国住宅部门是最大的电力消费端，但现有大规模电力系统模型通常将住宅需求视为固定或高度简化，无法评估长期消费者响应、剩余和可负担性。本文旨在弥补这一建模缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逆需求曲线理论（收入差异化）；消费者剩余（马歇尔消费者剩余）；住宅电力价格弹性；容量扩展模型（ReEDS）。
AI.method: 将ResStock建筑级用电数据与收入分层的逆需求曲线整合到ReEDS容量扩展模型中，模拟不同的技术成本、资源可用性和输电约束情景，评估长期住宅价格响应及系统影响。
AI.findings: (1) 低收入家庭在高成本、资源受限的未来中可负担性和马歇尔消费者剩余下降最为严重；(2) 低成本技术未来通过内生价格响应增加长期住宅用电量，高成本未来则抑制需求；(3) 住宅价格响应改变全国发电容量扩展结果约3%（60-70 GW）；(4) 供给侧因素（技术成本、资源可用性、输电约束）仍是长期基础设施部署的主导驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了在容量扩展模型中纳入异质性住宅需求响应的重要性，弥补了传统模型将住宅需求简化为固定的理论缺陷，为评估不同消费者群体的分配效应提供了建模框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源基础设施规划提供了更精细的评估工具，揭示了不同收入群体在能源转型中的差异化影响，有助于制定更公平的能源政策和资源配置方案。

title: How Memory Structure Shapes Tail Risk Forecasting in WTI Crude Oil Futures: Evidence from an Extended CAViaR Framework
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics, Renmin University of China and Renmin University of China - School of Finance

detail.title: How Memory Structure Shapes Tail Risk Forecasting in WTI Crude Oil Futures: Evidence from an Extended CAViaR Framework
detail.abstract: This paper examines how memory structure shapes downside tail-risk forecasting in WTI crude oil futures. We extend the Conditional Autoregressive Value-at-Risk (CAViaR) framework by incorporating alternative kernel functions and jointly considering window designs, bandwidth choices, and quantile updating specifications. We use the Model Confidence Set procedure to identify superior models and further examine their time-varying forecasting performance beyond the full-sample evidence. The full-sample evidence identifies a set of superior forecasting structures, characterized by longer histories, non-truncated kernel weighting, medium-to-long bandwidths, and asymmetric slope dynamics. The local evidence shows that this advantage is not uniform over time at the two extreme Value at Risk (VaR) levels. At the 95% VaR level, the leading memory structures outperform conventional CAViaR benchmarks over much of the evaluation period. At the 99% VaR level, predictive gains are concentrated in shorter local intervals that overlap different episodes of market stress.

AI.tldr: 本文研究记忆结构如何影响WTI原油期货的下行尾部风险预测，通过扩展CAViaR框架、纳入多种核函数并联合考虑窗口设计、带宽选择和分位数更新规格，发现基于较长历史、非截断核加权、中长带宽和非对称斜率动态的预测结构表现更优，但其优势在不同VaR水平和时间区间内并不均匀。
AI.research_question: 记忆结构如何影响WTI原油期货的下行尾部风险（VaR）预测？不同的窗口设计、带宽选择和分位数更新规格如何影响预测表现？
AI.motivation: 原油期货市场尾部风险预测对风险管理和监管至关重要，但现有CAViaR框架对记忆结构的处理（如窗口长度、核函数选择、带宽设置）缺乏系统性的比较和优化，需要更全面地探索最优预测结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: CAViaR框架、核函数加权理论、分位数回归、模型置信集（MCS）程序
AI.method: 扩展CAViaR框架，纳入多种核函数，联合考虑窗口设计、带宽选择和分位数更新规格；使用MCS程序识别最优模型；分析时变预测表现。
AI.findings: （1）全样本证据表明，较长历史、非截断核加权、中长带宽和非对称斜率动态的预测结构表现更优；（2）在95% VaR水平下，领先记忆结构在大部分评估期内优于传统CAViaR基准；（3）在99% VaR水平下，预测优势集中在与不同市场压力时期重叠的较短局部区间内。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地比较了不同记忆结构（窗口设计、核函数、带宽）对尾部风险预测的影响，为CAViaR框架的记忆结构选择提供了理论依据；揭示了记忆结构优势在不同VaR水平和时间维度上的非均匀性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为原油期货市场的风险管理者和监管者提供了优化尾部风险预测的具体记忆结构建议（较长历史、非截断核加权、中长带宽、非对称斜率）；指出在极端尾部风险（99% VaR）预测中，需要根据市场压力期动态调整模型。

title: The Impact of Geopolitical Risk on U.S. Natural Gas E&P Investments: A Time-Varying Quantile Causality Approach
affiliations: University of Central Oklahoma, University of Central Oklahoma and University of Central Oklahoma

detail.title: The Impact of Geopolitical Risk on U.S. Natural Gas E&P Investments: A Time-Varying Quantile Causality Approach
detail.abstract: This paper employs a time-varying quantile causality framework to examine the impact of geopolitical risk on the volatility of energy sector investment, proxied by U.S. gas rig counts. By allowing the causal relationship to vary across time and the conditional distribution, the analysis captures nonlinear and state-dependent dynamics that conventional approaches may overlook. The results indicate that the effect of geopolitical risk is asymmetric and episodic. During periods of moderate volatility, geopolitical risk does not exert a statistically significant influence, suggesting that investors largely discount such disturbances. In contrast, under conditions of elevated market stress, geopolitical risk becomes a significant driver of investment volatility, with responses consistent with a real options mechanism. Our study finds a massive causality spells from 2016 onward, perfectly aligning with the exact moment the U.S. began exporting LNG to the global market, suddenly making domestic rig operators highly vulnerable to international geopolitical shocks. Overall, the empirical specification controls for key supply-side fundamentals (gas storage), price dynamics, and broader macroeconomic conditions, including interest rates and equity market performance, allowing the analysis to isolate the independent role of geopolitical risk. Overall, the findings highlight the state-dependent nature of investment responses to geopolitical uncertainty and contribute to the literature on upstream energy investment dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文使用时变分位数因果检验框架，考察地缘政治风险对美国天然气钻机数量（能源部门投资volatility的代理变量）的影响。研究发现地缘政治风险的影响是非对称和偶发性的：在市场适度波动时影响不显著，而在高市场压力下则成为投资波动的重要驱动因素。自2016年美国开始出口LNG后，因果效应显著增强。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治风险如何影响能源部门投资volatility？这种影响是否具有状态依赖性和非对称性？
AI.motivation: 传统方法可能忽略地缘政治风险对投资volatility影响的非线性和状态依赖性特征，本文引入时变分位数因果框架以更精确地捕捉这种动态关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权理论（real options mechanism）：在高度不确定性下，投资者倾向于延迟不可逆投资，导致投资volatility增加。
AI.method: 时变分位数因果检验框架（time-varying quantile causality framework），控制天然气储存、价格动态、利率和股票市场表现等基本面因素。
AI.findings: （1）地缘政治风险影响不对称且偶发；（2）适度波动时期影响不显著；（3）高市场压力时期成为显著驱动因素；（4）2016年美国LNG出口后因果效应显著增强，国内钻机运营商对国际地缘政治冲击高度脆弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将实物期权理论应用于能源上游投资对地缘政治风险反应的情境，揭示了投资响应地缘政治不确定性的状态依赖性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和能源投资者提供地缘政治风险影响能源投资volatility的时变和条件依赖证据，有助于风险管理与投资决策优化。

title: Experimental Evaluation of an Algorithmic Trading Strategy Against the S&P 500 Benchmark

detail.title: Experimental Evaluation of an Algorithmic Trading Strategy Against the S&P 500 Benchmark

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the outcomes of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive personal data. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study presents an empirical evaluation of a rule-based algorithmic trading strategy designed to outperform the S&P 500 benchmark under controlled risk conditions. The proposed model is based on a Turtle Donchian trend-following framework combined with volatility-adjusted risk management using the Average True Range (ATR). The strategy is tested on the US100 index over the period January 2023 to April 2026 using multiple risk configurations, including fixed-risk and dynamic risk allocation models. Performance is evaluated using key financial metrics such as total return, maximum drawdown, Sharpe ratio, and recovery factor. Results indicate that the fixed-risk model is capable of outperforming the S&P 500 benchmark while maintaining comparable drawdown levels. Higher-risk configurations demonstrate significantly increased returns at the cost of elevated drawdown, illustrating the trade-off between return maximisation and risk control. Monte Carlo simulation and stress testing are also applied to evaluate the robustness of the fixed-risk and dynamic-risk models under randomised trade sequences and adverse execution assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文实证评估了一种基于海龟唐奇安趋势跟踪框架和ATR波动率调整风险管理的算法交易策略，在US100指数上（2023年1月至2026年4月）测试发现固定风险模型能在控制回撤的前提下跑赢标普500基准，高风险配置虽提升收益但伴随更大回撤。
AI.research_question: 基于规则的算法交易策略能否在可控风险条件下持续跑赢标普500基准？
AI.motivation: 现有趋势跟踪策略在风险管理和实际市场条件下的稳健性缺乏系统评估，尤其是固定风险与动态风险模型的比较尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 海龟唐奇安趋势跟踪框架；平均真实波幅（ATR） volatility-adjusted风险度量；蒙特卡洛模拟与压力测试理论。
AI.method: 在US100指数上运用固定风险和动态风险两种配置模型回测（2023.1-2026.4），采用总回报、最大回撤、夏普比率、恢复因子等指标评估，并使用蒙特卡洛模拟与压力测试检验稳健性。
AI.findings: 固定风险模型能跑赢标普500且回撤可控；高风险配置显著提升收益但伴随更大回撤；收益最大化与风险控制之间存在明确的权衡关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统比较了固定风险与动态风险模型在趋势跟踪策略中的应用效果，验证了ATR风险调整在此框架下的有效性，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟提供了稳健性证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化交易者提供了可操作的规则化策略框架，明确了不同风险配置下的收益-回撤权衡关系，有助于机构投资者在实战中优化风险预算分配。

title: Global Value Chains Under Strain: India's tariff Policy in the Era of Trade Wars and Supply Chain Disruptions

detail.title: Global Value Chains Under Strain: India's tariff Policy in the Era of Trade Wars and Supply Chain Disruptions
detail.abstract:
Using a sophisticated quantitative framework, this study addresses the "Gross Trade Blind Spot" by moving beyond traditional export-import metrics toward a value-added perspective. The research synthesizes product-level tariff data from the World Integrated Trade Solution with value-added trade indicators from the OECD Trade in Value Added database. By employing a fixed-effects panel regression model across multiple manufacturing sectors, the study isolates the relationship between tariff barriers and two distinct dimensions of integration: backward participation (the use of foreign inputs) and forward participation (the supply of intermediate goods to global markets) (Dutta, 2021; Narayanan et al., 2023).

The empirical findings reveal a significant "magnification effect," where tariffs on intermediate inputs—intended to protect domestic suppliers—effectively act as a tax on exports. This is particularly evident in the automobile and electronics sectors, where high import duties on components disrupt the "Just-in-Time" logic of lead firms (Kim, 2023; Narayanan et al., 2023). The analysis further quantifies the "cost of exclusion" following India’s withdrawal from the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership, projecting a 6.7% decline in export competitiveness due to trade diversion and the persistence of the "inverted duty structure" (Flach et al., 2021; Narayanan et al., 2023).

Furthermore, the study highlights a "Value Capture Trap" within the Indian manufacturing sector. While the "Atmanirbhar Bharat" initiative aims to foster self-reliance, the current tariff structure often reinforces the "Smiling Curve" phenomenon, in which Indian firms remain concentrated in low-value-added assembly tasks while high-value R&D and post-production services are offshore (Banga, 2017; Dutta, 2017). The dissertation concludes by arguing that for India to transition into a high-value manufacturing hub, trade policy must be recalibrated to reduce the "invisible tax" on GVC participation. It proposes a shift toward "value-added precision" in policy design, balancing the mandate for domestic resilience with the deep regional integration required to survive the ongoing GVC strain (Narayanan et al., 2023; Ray & Thakur, 2025).

AI.tldr: 本研究通过价值链增加值视角，利用固定效应面板回归模型分析关税壁垒对全球价值链参与的影响，发现中间品关税存在"放大效应"，对印度制造业造成"价值捕获陷阱"，并建议贸易政策向"增加值精准化"转型。
AI.research_question: 关税壁垒如何影响一国在全球价值链中的前向参与（供应中间品）和后向参与（使用外国投入），尤其是印度制造业在区域贸易协定退出背景下的竞争力变化？
AI.motivation: 传统贸易统计存在"总贸易盲点"，无法真实反映一国在全球价值链中的实际位置和附加值贡献。本研究旨在揭示关税结构对价值链参与的隐性扭曲效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链（GVC）理论、微笑曲线理论、放大效应（Magnification Effect）、倒置关税结构（Inverted Duty Structure）、价值捕获陷阱（Value Capture Trap）
AI.method: 基于WITS产品层面关税数据与OECD TiVA增加值贸易数据，采用固定效应面板回归模型，对多个制造业部门进行实证分析。
AI.findings: (1) 中间品关税存在"放大效应"，保护国内供应商的关税实际上成为出口税，汽车和电子行业尤为明显；(2) 印度退出RCEP导致出口竞争力下降6.7%；(3) 印度制造业陷入"价值捕获陷阱"，停留在低附加值组装环节。
AI.theory_contributions: 将关税壁垒与GVC参与的双重维度（前向/后向参与）系统链接，量化了"放大效应"和"价值捕获陷阱"的理论内涵，丰富了关税政策对价值链升级影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及发展中国家贸易政策制定提供实证依据，建议降低中间品关税的"隐形税"，推动政策从传统保护主义转向"增加值精准化"设计，平衡国内韧性与区域一体化需求。

title: Corporate Social Responsibility and the Talmudic Principle of Going Beyond the Requirements of the Law: The Cornerstone of Ethics
affiliations: City University of New York (CUNY) - Koppelman School of Business, Seton Hall University and Seton Hall University

detail.title: Corporate Social Responsibility and the Talmudic Principle of Going Beyond the Requirements of the Law: The Cornerstone of Ethics

keywords: Going Beyond the Strict Letter of the Law

detail.abstract: The Talmud offers a haunting post-mortem on a civilization: the Second Temple and Jerusalem were not lost to Roman might alone, but to a spiritual rigidity. The city fell because its citizens insisted on the strict letter of Torah law, refusing to move an inch beyond what was legally required. This paper argues that for any individual or organization truly committed to ethics, the law is merely the floor, not the ceiling. By exploring the rabbinic concept of lifnim mishurat hadin-acting beyond the line of the law-we propose a framework that transcends the modern debate over Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). While the corporate world often pits social good against shareholder wealth, we demonstrate that true ethical integrity requires a proactive step into the space beyond mandates. This paper presents a compelling argument for a "higher law" of ethics, where the survival of our modern institutions depends on our willingness to do more than what is simply required.

AI.tldr: 本文借犹太经典《塔木德》中耶路撒冷陷落的教训，提出"行义超越法律"（lifnim mishurat hadin）的伦理框架，主张无论个人还是组织，法律仅是道德底线而非天花板，真正的伦理诚信需要主动超越合规要求。这一框架超越了现代CSR争论中"社会公益vs股东财富"的二元对立，为现代机构的存续提供了"更高法则"的伦理路径。
AI.research_question: 法律合规是否足以支撑真正的伦理诚信？个人与组织如何超越法律底线实现更高的道德标准？
AI.motivation: 《塔木德》中关于第二圣殿和耶路撒冷陷落的训诫——城市因公民固守律法字面要求而亡——揭示了仅靠法律合规的局限性。现代企业CSR争论中"社会公益vs股东财富"的困境同样反映了这一问题，亟需一个超越法律底线的伦理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犹太拉比传统中的"lifnim mishurat hadin"（行义超越法律之线）概念；与CSR理论中"社会公益vs股东财富"争论的对话与超越。
AI.method: 文本诠释与概念分析：通过对《塔木德》经典文本的伦理解读，构建超越法律底线的伦理框架，并将其应用于当代CSR辩论。
AI.findings: 法律只是道德的"地板"而非"天花板"；真正的伦理诚信需要主动进入超越强制要求（mandates）的空间；"超越法律之线"的框架能够超越CSR争论中社会公益与股东财富的二元对立。
AI.theory_contributions: 将犹太伦理传统中的"lifnim mishurat hadin"概念系统化为一个通用的伦理分析框架；为CSR理论提供了超越"合规vs公益"二元对立的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人和组织提供了一种"更高法则"的伦理实践指南；指出现代机构的存续取决于是否愿意做"比被要求之事更多"的主动担当。

title: Anticipating Family Automation: Public Imaginaries of Robotic Surrogacy and Co-Parenting
affiliations: , Brunel University London - Brunel Business School, Ramon Llull University - IQS School of Management and University of Reading - Henley Business School

detail.title: Anticipating Family Automation: Public Imaginaries of Robotic Surrogacy and Co-Parenting

declarations.ethicsApproval: Approval was obtained from the ethics committee of University of Reading (SREC-HBS-20250129-ROPE3918). The procedures used in this study adhere to the tenets of the Declaration of Helsinki.

detail.abstract: Humanoid robotics is moving from industrial and service settings into intimate domains of family life, making robotic surrogacy and robotic co-parenting plausible but morally contested futures. This paper examines how prospective users perceive the potential role of humanoid robots in reproduction and parenting, focusing on perceived barriers, anticipated consequences and ethical dilemmas. The study is based on a multi-method qualitative design, including 40 AI-assisted interviews and four face-to-face focus groups. Data were examined using thematic analysis grounded in ethics of care and attachment theory. Findings reveal a conditional openness to robots as functional assistants, such as offloading repetitive childcare tasks, contrasted with profound moral resistance to relational substitution. We identify a critical red line where automation transitions from supportive assistance to a human identity threat zone where the potential dehumanisation of foundational parent-child bonds leads to technology resistance. We propose that resistance is concentrated where robotic mediation is perceived to substitute for, rather than augment, primary human attachment relationships. We contribute an attachment-grounded framework by showing that adoption of intimate robotics depends not only on technical feasibility or perceived usefulness, but on whether future users locate robots within a utility zone or a relational substitution zone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过40次AI辅助访谈和4次焦点小组讨论，探讨用户如何看待人形机器人在生育和育儿中的角色。研究发现，人们对机器人作为功能性助手（如分担重复性育儿任务）持条件性开放态度，但对机器替代亲子关系存在强烈道德抵制。关键红线在于从辅助性支持到威胁人类身份认同的过渡区，即机器人介入被视为替代而非增强人类依恋关系时。文章提出了基于依恋理论的分析框架，区分了"效用区"与"关系替代区"。
AI.research_question: 潜在用户如何看待人形机器人在生殖与育儿中的潜在角色？用户感知到的障碍、预期后果和伦理困境是什么？
AI.motivation: 人形机器人正从工业和服务领域进入家庭生活的亲密领域，使机器人代孕和机器人共同育儿成为可能但道德上有争议的未来。需要理解潜在用户对这些新兴技术的看法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关怀伦理学与依恋理论
AI.method: 多方法定性研究设计，包括40次AI辅助访谈和4次面对面焦点小组讨论，采用主题分析法
AI.findings: 1) 对机器人作为功能性助手承担重复性育儿任务持条件性开放态度；2) 对机器人替代亲子关系存在强烈道德抵制；3) 存在一条关键红线：自动化从支持性辅助过渡到威胁人类身份认同的领域；4) 当机器人介入被视为替代而非增强人类依恋关系时，技术抵制的集中度最高。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于依恋理论的框架，表明亲密机器人技术的采纳不仅取决于技术可行性和感知有用性，还取决于未来用户将机器人定位在"效用区"还是"关系替代区"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计者和政策制定者提供了理解用户对家庭亲密领域机器人技术接受度的关键边界条件，即必须避免机器人从辅助工具转变为人类依恋关系的替代品。

title: A Review of LTE 1800 MHz Spectrum Refarming: An Approach to Improve the Under-Utilization of 1800 MHz Spectrum
affiliations: University of Ibadan, Ibadan, Nigeria and University of Ibadan, Ibadan, Nigeria

detail.title: A Review of LTE 1800 MHz Spectrum Refarming: An Approach to Improve the Under-Utilization of 1800 MHz Spectrum
detail.abstract: Mobile communications have advanced greatly since the analogue systems of the late 1980s, which only supported voice calls. The development of GSM/GPRS and text messaging paved the way for mobile broadband through UMTS, HSDPA, and LTE. However, all these radio technologies rely on a limited portion of the electromagnetic spectrum, which is a scarce and valuable resource. As demand for mobile data services continues to grow, there is an increasing need to optimize spectrum utilization. To address this scarcity, some countries have amended their laws to permit additional services to share spectrum originally designated for other purposes, while others have adopted spectrum refarming. The 1800 MHz band is currently under-utilized due to the decline in 2G subscribers, and refarming it for LTE is a costeffective way for operators to deliver high-speed data services. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of how available radio resources can be optimized through spectrum refarming. The benefits of this approach are discussed, along with strategies to protect existing network investments and ensure a smooth transition to LTE.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了通过频谱重耕优化无线资源的方法，重点讨论了将1800MHz频段从2G重耕用于LTE的策略、收益及平滑过渡方案。
AI.research_question: 如何通过频谱重耕优化稀缺的无线频谱资源，以应对移动数据服务需求的持续增长？
AI.motivation: 移动通信频谱资源稀缺且价值高昂，而1800MHz频段因2G用户减少而利用率不足，需要探索将频谱重耕用于LTE的成本效益方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 频谱重耕（Spectrum Refarming）理论，涉及频谱资源再分配、网络投资保护及技术平滑过渡策略。
AI.method: 综述性研究，综合梳理频谱重耕的技术路径、政策调整（如法律修订允许频谱共享）及运营商实施策略。
AI.findings: 频谱重耕是优化频谱利用的经济有效方式；1800MHz频段重耕用于LTE可在保护现有投资的同时实现高速数据服务交付；不同国家通过法律修订或频谱共享等方式应对频谱稀缺。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地整合了频谱重耕的理论框架，为无线资源优化提供了全面的技术综述。
AI.practical_contributions: 为运营商提供了将1800MHz频段重耕用于LTE的具体策略，包括保护现有网络投资和确保平滑过渡的实践指导。

title: Smoke Signals from a Failed State: What Stopped, Who Left, and What Survived

detail.title: Smoke Signals from a Failed State: What Stopped, Who Left, and What Survived
detail.abstract: Haiti has not conducted a census since 2003 or updated its national accounts since 2019; armed groups control 80% of Port-au-Prince, and no survey enumerator can reach the zones where 1.4 million people have been displaced. Three satellite indicators -- tropospheric NO2 from TROPOMI (combustion flow), nighttime radiance from VIIRS (occupied infrastructure), and the built-up area index from Sentinel-2 (physical capital) -- jointly decompose the economic impact of state collapse into what stopped, who left, and what survived. A violence dose-response using ACLED conflict events as continuous treatment, estimated on 574,444 daily satellite observations, shows that each unit increase in log-violence reduces NO2 by 11.5 percentage points (t = -22.0) and nightlights by 78.9 percentage points (t = -60.7) in gang-controlled communes, with nightlights responding 6.9 times more strongly -- reflecting the irreversibility of displacement relative to the partial reversibility of combustion disruption. The decomposition reveals abandonment, not destruction: built-up area increased in gang communes while nightlights declined, and the satellite-implied displacement of 194,000-648,000 persons brackets the IOM's independently tracked 1.3-1.4 million. Total cost: US$2.3-7.4 billion over five years.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用三种卫星指标（对流层NO₂、夜间灯光、建成区指数）分解海地国家崩溃的经济影响，发现武装暴力主要导致人口流离失所（夜间灯光大幅下降）而非物理破坏（建成区面积反增），五年经济损失达23-74亿美元。
AI.research_question: 如何利用卫星遥感数据分解国家崩溃的经济影响，区分哪些经济活动停止、哪些人口离开、哪些基础设施幸存？
AI.motivation: 海地自2003年未进行人口普查、2019年未更新国民账户，武装团体控制太子港80%地区，140万人流离失所，传统调查方法完全失效，亟需替代性测量手段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 暴力剂量-反应模型、卫星遥感经济指标分解框架（燃烧流、占用基础设施、物理资本）。
AI.method: 使用TROPOMI（NO₂）、VIIRS（夜间灯光）、Sentinel-2（建成区指数）三个卫星指标，结合ACLED冲突事件数据构建连续处理变量的剂量-反应模型，基于574,444个日度卫星观测值进行估计。
AI.findings: 暴力每增加一个对数单位，帮派控制社区NO₂下降11.5个百分点，夜间灯光下降78.9个百分点（后者响应强度是前者的6.9倍）；建成区面积在帮派社区反而增加；卫星推断的流离失所人数（19.4万-64.8万）与国际移民组织的独立追踪数据（130-140万）部分吻合；五年总经济损失23-74亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多维度卫星指标分解国家崩溃经济影响的框架，区分了燃烧中断（可逆）与人口流离失所（不可逆）的不同经济效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为无法进行传统调查的极端脆弱国家提供了基于卫星的经济监测方法，量化了海地帮派暴力的经济成本，为国际援助和政策干预提供了数据基础。

title: AI for Whose Tasks? Directed AI Quality and Uneven Effective Access

detail.title: AI for Whose Tasks? Directed AI Quality and Uneven Effective Access

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study uses publicly available or secondary data and does not involve human subjects experiments or personally identifiable private information.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, or publication of this paper.

detail.abstract: Generic access to artificial intelligence need not imply equal effective access. This paper studies whether current AI capabilities fit the tasks performed by different economies. I develop a task-space model in which AI quality is task-specific and improves toward tasks with larger monetizable markets and richer deployment feedback. I then combine ILOSTAT occupation shares for 176 countries with occupation-level proxies for generative-AI exposure and use. Exposure-based AI-Fit is strongly increasing in income (ρ = 0.888) and in overlap with high-income task structures (ρ = 0.861); the income gradient remains in an ISCO-08 two-digit validation sample (ρ = 0.877). The evidence is descriptive, not causal, but it identifies a measurable task-fit margin: widely available AI tools may still be optimized for the tasks of large, high-feedback markets. If future investment follows the same market-weighted feedback, initial taskfit differences can compound into wider effective-use gaps.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI能力在不同经济体的任务适应性差异，发现AI对高收入国家任务的适配度显著更高（相关系数约0.88），即使AI工具普遍可获取，其实际效能仍偏向高收入、高反馈市场，可能导致有效使用差距扩大。
AI.research_question: 通用人工智能的可获取性是否意味着不同经济体拥有同等的有效使用权？当前AI能力是否适配不同经济体所执行的任务？
AI.motivation: 虽然AI工具在表面上普遍可获取，但不同经济体在任务结构上的差异可能导致AI的实际有效使用存在不平等。现有研究缺乏从任务层面衡量AI适配度的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务空间模型（task-space model）：AI质量具有任务特异性，其改进方向取决于可货币化市场规模和部署反馈的丰富程度。
AI.method: 将176个国家的ILOSTAT职业份额数据与生成式AI暴露度和使用度的职业层面代理变量相结合，构建"AI-Fit"指标；采用相关性分析，并在ISCO-08两位码验证样本中进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1. 基于暴露度的AI-Fit与人均收入高度正相关（ρ=0.888）；2. AI-Fit与高收入国家任务结构的重叠度也高度正相关（ρ=0.861）；3. 在ISCO-08两位码验证样本中，收入梯度依然显著（ρ=0.877）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"任务适配度（task-fit margin）"这一可量化概念，解释了AI普遍可获取与有效使用权不平等之间的差距；揭示了基于市场加权反馈的AI投资可能导致适配度差异自我强化的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者关注AI发展中的全球不平等问题：如果AI投资继续遵循市场加权反馈，初始任务适配度差异可能演变为更大的有效使用鸿沟，需要针对性干预以确保AI红利更公平地分配。

title: Administrative Stability as a Medicaid Quality Strategy: Reducing Procedural Churn Through Proactive Continuity Governance

detail.title: Administrative Stability as a Medicaid Quality Strategy: Reducing Procedural Churn Through Proactive Continuity Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article does not involve human subjects research, identifiable individual-level data, or clinical experimentation. Institutional Review Board approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author conducted this research independently. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract:
During the Medicaid unwinding period that began in April 2023, more than 25 million people were disenrolled nationally, the majority for procedural reasons rather than substantive ineligibility. Termination rates varied from 8 to 55 percent across states, a range explained not by differences in eligibility composition but by administrative design choices. Similar patterns appeared in Medicaid work requirement programs: Arkansas experienced substantial coverage loss without measurable employment gains, while Georgia’s Pathways program enrolled far fewer people than projected at substantially higher administrative cost per enrollee. These outcomes reflect a common structure: coverage loss produced not through eligibility determination alone, but through procedural interactions that eligible individuals could not successfully navigate.

Medicaid systems govern eligibility, utilization, clinical quality, and downstream financial performance. What they largely do not govern is participation stability: whether eligible individuals can maintain coverage across the administrative interactions Medicaid requires. This article argues that participation stability should become a measurable Medicaid quality and operational objective. Drawing on evidence from Medicaid unwinding, work requirement implementation, and New York’s Delivery System Reform Incentive Payment program as institutional precedent, it introduces a participation-stability framework that reframes procedural churn as a governance problem rather than merely a compliance problem and outlines a Benefit Continuity Triage model for upstream continuity intervention. Governing participation stability does not require new federal authority. It requires organizing existing Medicaid systems around continuity preservation as deliberately as they organize around eligibility determination.

AI.tldr: 本文指出Medicaid"解封"期间超过2500万人被取消参保，多数是程序原因而非实质不符合资格。各州取消率差异达8%-55%，源于行政设计而非资格构成。作者提出"参保稳定性"应成为Medicaid可衡量的质量与运营目标，并构建了参保稳定性框架和福利连续性分诊模型。
AI.research_question: Medicaid系统中，符合条件的个体为何会因程序性交互而非实质资格问题失去保险覆盖？如何将"参保稳定性"纳入可衡量的治理目标？
AI.motivation: Medicaid"解封"期间大规模程序性取消参保现象揭示了现有治理框架的缺陷——系统管理资格、利用、质量和财务，却忽视了参保稳定性这一关键维度。各州间巨大的取消率差异无法用人口构成解释，指向行政设计是核心原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参保稳定性框架（Participation-Stability Framework）；福利连续性分诊模型（Benefit Continuity Triage model）；程序性流失（procedural churn）作为治理问题而非合规问题的重新框架化。
AI.method: 基于Medicaid"解封"的跨州比较证据、工作要求项目（阿肯色州与佐治亚州）的实施结果分析，以及纽约州DSRIP项目作为制度先例的案例研究。
AI.findings: 1）超2500万人在Medicaid"解封"期间被取消参保，多数为程序性原因；2）各州取消率8%-55%的巨大差异源于行政设计选择而非人口资格构成差异；3）工作要求项目（阿肯色州）导致大量覆盖损失却无就业增益，佐治亚州Pathways项目参保人数远低于预期且行政成本极高；4）覆盖损失的核心结构是符合条件的个体无法成功导航程序性交互。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"程序性流失"重新定义为治理问题而非合规问题；提出了参保稳定性作为Medicaid质量与运营的可衡量目标；建立了福利连续性分诊模型用于上游干预。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Medicaid管理者提供了改善参保稳定性的具体框架和操作模型；指出不需要新的联邦授权，只需围绕连续性保留重新组织现有系统；为减少程序性覆盖损失提供了政策设计思路。

title: Cross-National Spillover Effects of ESG Violations
affiliations: , University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS), KEDGE Business School and

detail.title: Cross-National Spillover Effects of ESG Violations
detail.abstract: While brands fear that environmental, social, and governance (ESG) violations may harm consumers abroad, evidence of crosscountry spillovers remains limited and is often confined to home-host settings. We develop an omnidirectional perspective in which an ESG violation in any country can affect consumers in any other country where the brand operates, and we test when such spillovers are strongest. Using panel data that link ESG violation events to consumer-based brand equity for 4,045 brands across 40 countries over nine years, we find that violations in one country significantly reduce brand equity in other countries. These spillover effects persist beyond the initial news cycle, peaking about two months after the incident and remaining detectable for up to six months. Spillovers are larger when incidents receive greater international media attention and when brands are more salient to consumers, but smaller for brands with stronger market positions.
