They further depend on the country context, with stronger effects in more developed countries and weaker effects across greater psychic distance. Because these permarket losses aggregate, brand-wide damage per ESG violation scales with a brand's geographic footprint and, for international brands, can rival or exceed within-country damage. Together, the findings show that ESG violations inflict brand-wide consumer harm and identify actionable conditions that help multinational brands monitor, anticipate, and respond to crises.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，ESG违规事件会显著降低品牌在其他国家的消费者品牌资产，这种跨境溢出效应在两个月左右达到峰值，可持续长达六个月，且对跨国品牌造成的损失可与国内损失相当甚至更大。
AI.research_question: ESG违规事件如何在不同国家之间产生跨境溢出效应，影响消费者对品牌的评价？这种效应在什么条件下最强？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对ESG违规的跨境溢出效应了解有限，多局限于母国-东道国双边情境，缺乏全球视角下的系统性证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全方向溢出视角（Omnidirectional Spillover Perspective），结合国际媒体关注度、品牌显著性、市场地位、国家发展水平和心理距离等调节机制。
AI.method: 使用面板数据，将ESG违规事件与40个国家4045个品牌九年的消费者品牌资产数据相关联，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1) 一国违规显著降低他国品牌资产；2) 效应在两个月达峰，持续六个月；3) 国际媒体关注和品牌显著性增强溢出；4) 强市场地位减弱溢出；5) 发达国家效应更强，心理距离大则效应弱；6) 对跨国品牌而言，跨境损失总和可匹敌或超过国内损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了ESG违规的"全方向溢出"理论框架，超越了传统的母国-东道国二元视角，揭示了跨境消费者反应的时空动态规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国品牌识别了影响ESG危机跨境扩散的关键条件（媒体关注、品牌显著性、市场地位等），帮助品牌监测、预测和应对全球范围内的ESG危机。

title: Impact of Advanced Technology on Accuracy and Operational Efficiency: Assess How Technologies Like IoT, Automation, AI and Cloud-Based Sytems Influence Inventory Tracking and Management

detail.title: Impact of Advanced Technology on Accuracy and Operational Efficiency: Assess How Technologies Like IoT, Automation, AI and Cloud-Based Sytems Influence Inventory Tracking and Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research was conducted independently as part of an academic capstone requirement with no external funding or organizational influence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, patients or sensitive data collection. The study is based entirely on secondary data, published literature and publicly available case studies. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was completed as part of the academic requirements for the Masters in Logistics Management program at Millennia Atlantic University.

detail.abstract: This research examines the impact of advanced technologies on inventory accuracy and operational efficiency in supply chain management. The study investigates how the Internet of Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation and cloud-based systems transform traditional inventory management practices. Through a comparative analysis of global industry leaders including Amazon, Walmart, IKEA, Zara and H&M, the research demonstrates that the integration of these technologies can reduce inventory errors by 60–70% compared to traditional methods, and that combining all four technologies can reduce stock discrepancies by up to 90%. Strategic recommendations are provided for organizations seeking to successfully implement these technologies while managing associated challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了物联网、人工智能、自动化和云计算四种先进技术对供应链库存准确性和运营效率的影响，通过对亚马逊、沃尔玛等全球行业领导者的比较分析，发现这些技术可将库存错误减少60-70%，四种技术结合可减少高达90%的库存差异。
AI.research_question: 先进技术（物联网、人工智能、自动化和云计算）如何影响供应链管理中的库存准确性和运营效率？
AI.motivation: 传统库存管理方法存在较高误差率，而先进技术的整合有望大幅提升库存准确性，但缺乏系统的跨行业比较研究来量化其具体效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术整合理论、供应链库存管理理论、运营效率理论
AI.method: 比较分析法，对亚马逊、沃尔玛、宜家、Zara和H&M等全球行业领导者进行多案例比较研究。
AI.findings: 先进技术整合可将库存错误减少60-70%；四种技术（IoT、AI、自动化、云计算）全部结合可减少高达90%的库存差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 量化了多项技术协同效应相较于单一技术的边际收益，丰富了技术整合与供应链绩效关系的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了成功实施先进技术、管理相关挑战的战略建议，有助于企业制定数字化转型路径。

title: Creators vs. GenAI: Data Sharing and Compensation in Content Markets
affiliations: and Boston College - Carroll School of Management

detail.title: Creators vs. GenAI: Data Sharing and Compensation in Content Markets
detail.abstract: The digital content market is rapidly expanding across videos, images, audio, and written works. Content creators play an important role in producing engaging materials across digital platforms and social media. However, advances in generative AI (GenAI) have begun to reshape this industry: algorithms trained on creators' content can now generate outputs that closely resemble human-made work. As concerns grow, creators have filed lawsuits against GenAI companies alleging the unauthorized use of their works for algorithm training, yet the question of how creators should be compensated for their data remains poorly understood. This paper examines the strategic interaction between the AI company and content creators in a data licensing market. The AI company acquires data from content creators to train its algorithm, which then competes with creators by producing similar content. We analytically characterize the AI company's optimal datapayment strategy (i.e., from which creators to collect data and at what price), and creators' data-sharing decisions (i.e., what fraction of data to share) balancing monetary gains from licensing against losses in content revenue due to AI-driven competition. Our equilibrium analysis suggests several key insights. First, the technological maturity of the AI algorithm plays a central role in shaping both firm and creator behavior. Second, restricting creators to binary sharing decisions (full or none) is not only simple to implement but can also yield a higher payoff for the AI company while consistently harming creators. We further extend the model to settings where GenAI reduces production costs or expands market reach for creators, and to a dynamic framework capturing long-term interactions among all players. Finally, we calibrate the model using data from a large online photography platform. Our numerical results show that compensation mainly redistributes welfare rather than uniformly improving outcomes: some creators gain, while others lose. Our analysis offers practical insights into how content creators and AI companies strategically interact in the emerging marketplace.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI公司与内容创作者在数据许可市场中的战略互动，分析了AI公司的最优数据付费策略和创作者的数据共享决策，发现技术成熟度起关键作用，强制二元共享决策虽对AI公司有利但会损害创作者，且补偿主要是在重新分配福利而非普遍改善。
AI.research_question: 在生成式AI与内容创作者竞争的市场中，AI公司应如何设计数据付费策略（向谁购买数据、以何种价格购买），以及创作者应如何决定数据共享比例，以平衡许可收益与AI竞争导致的内容收入损失？
AI.motivation: 内容创作者起诉GenAI公司未经授权使用其作品训练算法的案例日益增多，但创作者应如何因其数据获得补偿这一问题尚未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、数据许可市场均衡分析、AI竞争与创作者行为互动的战略模型。
AI.method: 理论建模（均衡分析），并利用大型在线摄影平台数据进行模型校准和数值分析。
AI.findings: (1) AI算法技术成熟度对公司和创作者行为起核心作用；(2) 强制创作者做二元共享决策（全共享或不共享）对AI公司更有利，但始终损害创作者；(3) 补偿主要是在重新分配福利，部分创作者受益，部分受损。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统刻画了AI公司-创作者数据许可市场的战略互动均衡，揭示了技术成熟度的调节作用以及共享决策结构对各方福利的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和平台管理者提供了关于数据补偿机制设计的实践洞见，指出补偿并非普惠性改善方案，而是存在显著的福利再分配效应。

title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Modern Food Service Management: Insights from the Hospitality Industry
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Modern Food Service Management: Insights from the Hospitality Industry

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study, as it did not involve human participants, patients, personal medical data, interviews, surveys, or experimental procedures. The study was based on secondary sources and general academic analysis, and no identifiable personal information was collected or processed.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence plays an important role in modern food service management within the hospitality sector, including hotels, restaurants, catering services, and integrated hospitality operations. While research on digital transformation in hospitality has increased, less attention has been given to the impact of AI on food service practices such as demand forecasting, service design, workforce coordination, customer experience management, quality control, and operational learning. This conceptual paper examines AI in food service management from the perspective of the hospitality industry. Using organizational learning theory, the paper argues that AI in hospitality should be considered a managerial learning and knowledge-management capability rather than only a collection of tools. The paper uses a qualitative conceptual research method based on hospitality management literature, service innovation, AI in service research, and organizational learning. The findings suggest that AI affects food service management through guest-experience personalization, demand prediction, operational efficiency, food waste management, and management decision support. The paper also critically examines over-automation, employee deskilling, the risk of weakening human hospitality work, and the gap between AI capability and organizational learning. AI is most valuable in hospitality food service when it works in synergy with managers and service employees while preserving the relational and emotional dimensions of hospitality. The successful adoption of artificial intelligence will therefore depend on balanced humanmachine integration, organizational learning capacity, ethical governance, and employee training.

AI.tldr: 本文基于组织学习理论，从概念层面探讨了人工智能在酒店餐饮服务管理中的角色，提出AI应被视为一种管理学习与知识管理能力，而非仅仅是工具集合，并强调了人机协同、组织学习与伦理治理对AI成功采用的重要性。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响酒店业餐饮服务管理？AI在其中的角色应如何被理解？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对AI在酒店餐饮服务实践（如需求预测、服务设计、员工协调、客户体验管理、质量控制和运营学习）中的影响关注不足，缺乏从组织学习视角对AI角色的系统性概念探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织学习理论（Organizational Learning Theory）
AI.method: 定性概念研究方法，基于酒店管理、服务创新、AI在服务研究以及组织学习领域的文献综述与整合。
AI.findings: AI通过客户体验个性化、需求预测、运营效率提升、食物浪费管理和管理决策支持影响餐饮服务管理；同时指出过度自动化、员工去技能化、削弱人性化服务以及AI能力与组织学习之间的差距等风险；AI最有价值时是与管理者和服务员工协同工作，保留 hospitality 的关系与情感维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI重新概念化为管理学习与知识管理能力，而非仅技术工具，丰富了组织学习理论在AI与酒店服务交叉领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为酒店餐饮管理者提供了AI采纳的平衡路径建议：需注重人机整合、组织学习能力建设、伦理治理和员工培训，以保持 hospitality 的关系性与情感性本质。

title: The Ātman Is Not for Sale A Vedantic Reading of Roth's Moral Economics
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and Chess Ed

detail.title: The Ātman Is Not for Sale A Vedantic Reading of Roth's Moral Economics
detail.abstract: Alvin Roth and Gerrit Tiedemann's Moral Economics (2026) argues that the hardest moral controversies in contemporary society (organ sale, surrogacy, paid sex, drug access, plasma donation, assisted reproduction) are at bottom problems of market design, and that a careful designer can find balances between unrestricted commerce and outright prohibition that preserve liberty and protect the vulnerable better than either extreme. "Repugnance," on this view, is an empirical constraint to be respected where it tracks legitimate concerns and reformed where it merely obstructs welfare-improving exchange. We offer a Vedāntic reading of this framework, developed in the spirit of Swami Vivekananda's practical Vedānta. The argument has three components. First, we identify a category mistake at the foundation of Roth's framework: the Lockean topology of self-and-property on which market design relies is too thin a description of the human person to support the moral weight placed on it. Second, we engage Roth's specific cases (kidneys, plasma, surrogacy, sex work, drugs, reproduction) and show that the Vedāntic position diverges most sharply from his where the institution itself, not merely its allocation, is the moral question. Third, we treat the Ramakrishna Mission, founded by Vivekananda in 1897 and operating today across 279 branch centres with 748 educational institutions and a healthcare network reaching tens of millions, as a natural experiment in karma-yoga institutional logic. The Mission's record of more than 125 years of continuous operation, together with the cross-tradition pattern of monastic service institutions (Catholic religious orders, Buddhist monastic medicine, Quaker mutual aid, Islamic waqf foundations), bears on the framework's central assumption that motivational structure is exogenous to institutional design. We connect this to the motivation-crowding literature (Titmuss; Frey; Bowles; Akerlof and Kranton) and argue that the evidence converges on a finding Roth's framework cannot easily accommodate: institutional design is upstream of motivational structure, not downstream of it. The argument is not against Roth but against the sufficiency of Roth.

AI.tldr: 该论文从吠檀多哲学视角批判Alvin Roth的市场设计伦理学框架，认为Roth所依赖的洛克式自我-财产人格描述过于单薄，无法承载其道德理论；通过分析具体案例（器官买卖、代孕、性交易等）指出，吠檀多立场与Roth最尖锐的分歧在于制度本身（而非分配方式）是否为道德问题；并以罗摩克里希那传道会等 monastic 服务制度作为自然实验，论证制度设计在动机结构之先，而非其后。
AI.research_question: Roth提出的"市场设计伦理"框架是否足以解决当代最具争议的道德问题？吠檀多哲学视角能为这一框架提供怎样的补充与修正？
AI.motivation: 当代社会在器官买卖、代孕、性交易等涉及人体与市场的道德争议中，始终在"完全商业化"与"全面禁止"之间摇摆，缺乏精细的理论框架。Roth试图以市场设计伦理弥合这一鸿沟，但作者认为其哲学基础（洛克式人格概念）过于薄弱，且对制度与动机关系的理解存在方向性错误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) Roth的市场设计伦理学（将道德争议视为市场设计问题，"厌恶感"为经验约束）；2) 吠檀多哲学（特别以斯瓦米·维韦卡南达的实践吠檀多为指导）；3) 动机拥挤理论（Titmuss, Frey, Bowles, Akerlof & Kranton）；4) 跨传统的修道院服务制度模式（天主教修会、佛教医学、贵格会互助、伊斯兰瓦克夫基金会）。
AI.method: 哲学概念分析（识别Roth框架中的范畴错误）；案例比较分析（肾脏、血浆、代孕、性工作、药物、生殖等案例）；自然实验分析（罗摩克里希那传道会125年运营史及跨传统 monastic 制度模式比较）；与动机拥挤理论文献的对话性整合。
AI.findings: 1) Roth依赖的洛克式自我-财产人格描述不足以支撑其道德框架的道德分量；2) 在制度本身（而非仅分配方式）即为道德问题的案例中，吠檀多立场与Roth分歧最大；3) 罗摩克里希那传道会等 monastic 服务制度的长期成功表明，制度设计在动机结构之先，而非之后——这与Roth框架的核心假设（动机结构外生于制度设计）相矛盾；4) 跨传统制度模式与动机拥挤理论的证据共同指向制度设计对动机结构的塑造作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入吠檀多哲学视角（特别是实践吠檀多）丰富市场设计伦理学的理论资源；指出Roth框架中对"人"的概念化存在范畴错误；提出"制度设计在动机结构之先"的核心论点，修正Roth框架中动机外生性的假设；通过跨传统比较扩展了道德经济学的制度分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为器官买卖、代孕、性交易等争议性议题提供超越"全面市场化 vs. 全面禁止"的第三种制度设计思路；提醒政策制定者在设计市场制度时需关注制度本身对参与者动机结构的塑造效应，而非仅关注分配效率；罗摩克里希那传道会等案例为非市场、非国家的第三部门制度设计提供了可资借鉴的历史经验。

title: Proving and Improving in Low-Maturity Data Environments
affiliations: Arizona State University, Arizona State University and Arizona State University

detail.title: Proving and Improving in Low-Maturity Data Environments
detail.abstract:
Fast-growing public-sector and nonprofit organizations often operate in low-maturity data environments, characterized by fragmented systems, low trust in data, and rapidly shifting priorities. Conventional data strategy approaches frequently position these conditions as problems to be resolved before meaningful value can be delivered, reinforcing a “future-state” orientation in which integrated systems, standardized definitions, and high data quality are treated as prerequisites for realizing broader aims of data strategy – and finally delivering on the promise of data-enabled culture, decision-making, governance, analytics, and insight.

This paper argues that the conditions of low-maturity data environments, while representing very real structural and material limitations, do not in any way preclude successful data strategy deployment under those present circumstances. To that end, we introduce the Data Strategy Delivery System (DS2), a structured, sprint-based approach that enables teams to produce trusted, usable data products early and often, even when underlying systems are incomplete or fragmented. Rather than waiting for ideal infrastructure, the approach emphasizes consistent delivery, bounded scope, and continuous feedback as mechanisms for learning, trust-building, and system improvement.

We further present a framework that pairs common features of low-maturity environments – such as low trust in data, reliance on manual processes, and shifting requirements – with corresponding delivery tactics designed to operate effectively within those conditions. Drawing on applied experience within a small public-sector data team, we show how this approach accelerates speed-to-insight, increases user engagement, and incrementally strengthens data systems over time. The findings suggest that low-maturity environments do not need to be overcome before value can be created; rather, they require a different model of data strategy – one centered on delivering value today while building toward stronger systems over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出数据策略交付系统（DS2），一种基于冲刺的结构化方法，帮助低成熟度数据环境下的公共和非营利组织在系统碎片化、数据信任度低的情况下，通过持续交付可信数据产品来实现价值，而非等待理想基础设施建成。
AI.research_question: 在低成熟度数据环境下，公共及非营利组织如何有效实施数据策略并创造价值？
AI.motivation: 传统数据策略通常将低成熟度环境（系统碎片化、数据信任度低、优先级变动快）视为需要先解决的问题，导致"未来导向"思维，忽视了在现有条件下即可创造价值的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据策略交付系统（DS2）；低成熟度环境特征与相应交付策略的配对框架
AI.method: 基于小型公共部门数据团队的应用经验，采用行动研究或案例研究方法
AI.findings: 低成熟度环境不需要被克服后才能创造价值；通过DS2方法，团队能加速获取洞察、提高用户参与度、并逐步强化数据系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统数据策略的"先修基础设施再创造价值"的假设，提出了一种适应低成熟度环境的不同数据策略模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低成熟度数据环境中的组织提供了一套可操作的冲刺式交付方法（DS2），帮助其在现有条件下实现数据价值，同时逐步完善系统。

title: Housing Assistance and Labor Supply: The Case of Rent Control
affiliations: Hong Kong Baptist University, University of North Texas - Department of Economics and University of North Texas

detail.title: Housing Assistance and Labor Supply: The Case of Rent Control
detail.abstract: Housing affordability pressures have renewed interest in rent regulation, yet little is known about how rent control affects tenants' labor supply decisions. This paper studies the labor-supply effects of rent stabilization in New York City, a setting with a long history of rent regulation. Using the New York City Housing and Vacancy Survey (NYCHVS), which provides administratively verified rent-stabilization status and detailed labor market outcomes, we estimate the impact of rent stabilization on labor supply. To address nonrandom selection into rent-stabilized units, we adopt an instrumental variables strategy that exploits quasi-random variation in the relative availability of vacant rent-stabilized units at the time of move-in. Our preferred IV estimates indicate substantial reductions in hours worked: rent stabilization lowers weekly hours by 7.7 hours on average, or 20 percent, when including nonworkers, and by 5.6 hours, or 13 percent, among employed tenants. A comprehensive set of robustness and validity checks supports these findings. We further estimate marginal treatment effects (MTE) to assess whether the labor-supply disincentive varies with unobserved resistance to entering rent stabilization. The MTE curves are approximately flat, indicating no essential heterogeneity: the IV estimates generalize beyond compliers to the average treated and untreated tenants.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用纽约市住房与 vacancy 调查数据，采用工具变量法估计租金稳定政策对租户劳动供给的影响。研究发现，租金稳定显著降低了劳动者的工作时间——平均每周减少7.7小时（含非劳动者）或5.6小时（仅就业者），边际处理效应显示该影响在不同群体间基本同质。
AI.research_question: 租金稳定政策如何影响租户的劳动供给决策？
AI.motivation: 住房可负担性压力重燃了对租金管制的兴趣，但租金控制对租户劳动供给的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动供给理论、租金管制经济学
AI.method: 使用纽约市住房与 vacancy 调查数据，采用工具变量法（利用搬家时可获得的空置租金稳定单元的相对数量的准随机变异）处理选择性问题，并估计边际处理效应以检验异质性。
AI.findings: 租金稳定使每周工作时间平均减少7.7小时（降幅20%，含非劳动者），或5.6小时（降幅13%，仅就业者）；边际处理效应曲线近似平坦，表明不存在本质异质性，IV估计结果可推广到平均受处理者和未受处理者。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统估计租金管制对劳动供给的因果效应，揭示了租金稳定通过降低住房成本产生的劳动供给抑制作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为租金管制政策的福利评估提供了劳动供给维度的实证依据，提示政策制定者需权衡租金稳定带来的住房可负担性改善与潜在的劳动供给减少。

title: The Limits of Contemporary Leadership Theory: Boundary Conditions of Authority, Accountability, and Coordination

detail.title: The Limits of Contemporary Leadership Theory: Boundary Conditions of Authority, Accountability, and Coordination
detail.abstract: This paper examines the limits of contemporary leadership theory by identifying the boundary conditions under which its core assumptions-legitimacy, formal accountability, contract enforceability, transparency, and institutional stability-break down. While these assumptions shape current leadership frameworks, they are often unexamined in extreme contexts. Using organised crime as a case study, we demonstrate how these assumptions break down and explore alternative mechanisms that enable leadership to persist in challenging environments: authority without legitimacy, accountability outside formal structures, coordination without contracts, opacity instead of transparency, and adaptation amid instability. We introduce a boundarybreakdown model outlining the conditions under which leadership structures shift and present five propositions that differentiate leadership effectiveness from legitimacy. We also connect these concepts to modern organisations, particularly in the context of artificial intelligence (AI), where issues such as opaque decision-making and diluted accountability are on the rise. This study contributes to leadership theory by identifying its limits, proposing a framework for leadership under constraints, and highlighting the need for clear responsibility structures in AI for improved governance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究有组织犯罪这一极端情境，揭示了当代领导力理论核心假设（合法性、正式问责、契约可执行性、透明度、制度稳定性）的边界条件与失效机制，并提出了一个边界突破模型，探讨了在约束条件下领导力如何持续运作，最后将分析延伸至人工智能时代的治理挑战。
AI.research_question: 当代领导力理论的核心假设在极端情境下如何失效？在合法性、正式问责等条件缺失时，领导力如何通过替代机制持续运作？
AI.motivation: 领导力理论长期建立在合法性、正式问责等隐含假设之上，但这些假设在极端环境（如非法组织、新兴技术领域）中并不成立，导致理论解释力不足。本文旨在弥补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边界突破模型（Boundary-Breakdown Model）：识别领导力理论五大核心假设的边界条件，并提出对应的替代机制（如无合法性的权威、非正式问责、无契约的协调、不透明运作、动态适应）。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以有组织犯罪作为极端情境案例，分析领导力核心假设的失效机制，并推导出五个理论命题。
AI.findings: 领导力有效性可与合法性分离；在约束条件下，替代机制（如灰色权威、非正式问责）能维持领导力运作；该框架可延伸解释AI等新兴领域中的治理挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统界定了领导力理论的核心假设及其边界条件；提出了"边界突破模型"，拓展了领导力理论的适用范围；分离了"领导力有效性"与"合法性"两个概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在非标准情境（如危机、新兴技术治理）中的领导力实践提供指导；为AI治理中责任归属不明确的问题提供了理论框架；警示组织关注领导力假设的隐性前提，避免将其盲目应用于极端情境。

title: Bankruptcy Team Sports and the Private Equity Playbook
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - School of Law and Harvard Law School

detail.title: Bankruptcy Team Sports and the Private Equity Playbook
detail.abstract: This chapter explains how the growth of private equity has reshaped the agency-cost problem at the center of Chapter 11. Historically, bankruptcy law policed collusive transactions between managers and favored outsiders through three principal tools: creditor "teams," which force creditors with similar claims to act collectively and share costs and payoffs; market tests; and judicial valuation. But as buyout-driven secured debt has come to dominate bankrupt firms' capital structures, the central conflict has shifted from equity-versus-unsecured-debt or secured-versusunsecured-debt disputes to intra-class warfare among secured lenders. In this new environment, private equity sponsors and managers increasingly pursue "team breakup" strategies: transactions that favor a majority creditor coalition while diluting excluded minority creditors. These strategies appear both outside bankruptcy, as in uptiering transactions like Serta, and inside bankruptcy, through exclusive DIP financing, exit financing, restructuring support agreements, and committeeflipping strategies, as in Peabody, J.C. Penney, and Nine West. We argue that these transactions weaken traditional market-testing protections because insider creditor coalitions can use their control rights to deter outside competition. As a result, bankruptcy courts should more actively police team breakup strategies to preserve priority, limit value diversion, and restore Chapter 11's agency-cost-control function.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨私募股权增长如何改变破产法第11章中的代理成本问题，指出核心冲突已从股权与无担保债权或担保与无担保债权之间的纠纷，转向担保债权人内部的阶层斗争。私募股权发起人和管理层通过"团队拆分"策略（如Serta案的上层交易、Peabody等案的DIP融资）稀释少数债权人，削弱了市场测试保护。建议破产法院应更积极监管此类策略以维护优先权、防止价值转移，恢复第11章的代理成本控制功能。
AI.research_question: 私募股权的发展如何改变了破产法第11章中的代理成本问题？法院应如何应对新兴的"团队拆分"策略？
AI.motivation: 私募股权驱动的担保债务在破产企业资本结构中占据主导地位，导致传统代理成本控制工具（债权人团队、市场测试、司法估值）失效，需要重新审视破产法的监管角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理成本理论、破产法中的债权人集体行动理论、控制权分配理论
AI.method: 法律经济分析、案例研究（Serta、Peabody、J.C. Penney、Nine West等）
AI.findings: 私募股权增长使破产核心冲突从跨阶层纠纷转向担保债权人内部阶层斗争；"团队拆分"策略通过内部债权人联盟的控制权排斥外部竞争，削弱了市场测试保护机制；现有法律工具不足以应对新型价值转移行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 更新了破产法代理成本理论，识别出新型的"阶层内部代理成本"问题；将控制权理论与破产重整实践结合，揭示了控制权集中对市场测试的侵蚀效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议破产法院对"团队拆分"策略实施更积极的司法审查；为破产法改革提供具体方向，如加强债权人平等保护、防止通过融资安排稀释少数债权人权利。

title: From Isomorphic Mimicry to Functionality: Institutional Adaptation in India's Soil Health Card Programme
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University and  ICAR- National Institute of Biotic Stress Management

detail.title: From Isomorphic Mimicry to Functionality: Institutional Adaptation in India's Soil Health Card Programme
detail.abstract: This paper examines the evolution of India's Soil Health Card Scheme from a phase of isomorphic mimicry to a more functionality-oriented and impact-driven mode of implementation after 2019. Drawing on a pan-India evaluation conducted by the authors covering more than 3,600 farmers in 2017, the study identifies a major divergence between officially reported achievements and actual field-level outcomes during the programme's initial phase (2015-2019). The survey showed how implementation reflected isomorphic mimicry, wherein local agencies reproduced the appearance of compliance with centrally mandated targets without generating meaningful outcomes. Although administrative records indicated near-universal distribution of Soil Health Cards (SHCs) to over 120 million farmers, field evidence revealed that only a limited proportion of farmers had actually received, understood, or used the cards for nutrient management decisions. The paper argues that the programme's early design imposed ambitious universal targets on state and district administrations without adequately accounting for institutional, technical, and human resource capacities. Shortages of trained personnel for soil sampling, inadequate laboratory infrastructure, logistical constraints, weak extension systems, and limited verification mechanisms created incentives for compliance-oriented reporting rather than substantive implementation. Consequently, local bureaucracies prioritised numerical achievement over actual farmer use and behavioural change. Based on findings from the 2017-18 evaluation, the authors proposed a capability-oriented implementation framework emphasising achievable targets, phased expansion, stronger monitoring systems, digital technologies, and broader institutional participation. The study shows that the post-2019 restructuring increasingly reflected these principles through more realistic targets, integration of remote sensing and digital soil mapping with field verification, greater private-sector participation, improved extension support, and digital monitoring mechanisms linking fertilizer point-of-sale systems with SHC recommendations. The paper demonstrates how aligning policy ambition with implementation capability can help large public programmes transition from symbolic compliance to functional effectiveness, contributing to broader debates on state capacity and implementation reform in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度“土壤健康卡计划”如何从早期（2015-2019）的“同构模仿”阶段——即地方机构表面遵循中央指令但未产生实际效果——转向2019年后以功能性和影响力为导向的实施模式。基于对3600多名农民的全国调查，研究发现官方报告与实地结果严重脱节，并提出了以能力为导向的实施框架，最终推动了计划的结构性重组。
AI.research_question: 印度土壤健康卡计划在早期实施阶段为何出现官方报告与实地结果的巨大偏差？该计划如何从同构模仿转向功能性实施？
AI.motivation: 揭示发展中国家大规模公共计划中“形式合规”与“实际成效”之间的鸿沟，探索如何将政策雄心与执行能力对齐，以推动实质性改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 同构模仿（Isomorphic Mimicry）、国家能力（State Capacity）、实施改革（Implementation Reform）
AI.method: 泛印度实地评估，覆盖3600多名农民（2017年调查），结合行政记录与实地证据的对比分析，并提出能力导向的实施框架。
AI.findings: 1）2015-2019年初期，计划呈现严重的同构模仿：行政记录显示已向1.2亿农民发放土壤健康卡，但实地调查中仅少数农民收到、理解或使用该卡进行养分管理。2）早期设计设定不切实际的全民目标，但缺乏制度、技术和人力资源支撑。3）2019年后重组采用更现实的指标、遥感与数字土壤测绘、私营部门参与、强化推广和数字监控，实现了从象征性合规到功能性有效的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 为同构模仿理论提供了大规模公共计划的实证案例；阐明了政策雄心与执行能力之间的对齐机制；丰富了全球南方国家能力与实施改革的讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家大规模农业推广和公共服务计划提供了从“形式合规”转向“实质效果”的可操作框架，包括可行目标设定、分阶段扩展、数字技术整合和多方参与等具体策略。

title: Gap Opening Control to Facilitate Human-Driven Vehicle Overtaking of Connected and Automated Vehicle Platoons on Two-Lane Highways
affiliations: University of Wyoming, University of Wyoming and University of Wyoming

detail.title: Gap Opening Control to Facilitate Human-Driven Vehicle Overtaking of Connected and Automated Vehicle Platoons on Two-Lane Highways

declarations.funderStatement: This work was partially sponsored by the Center for Transformative Infrastructure Preservation and Sustainability (CTIPS). CTIPS is funded by a grant from the US Department of Transportation’s University Transportation Centers Program, Grant No. 69A3552348308 (IIJA / BIL)

detail.abstract: Connected and automated vehicle (CAV) platooning enhances fuel efficiency and operational performance but poses safety challenges when interacting with human-driven vehicles (HDVs) attempting to overtake on two-lane undivided highways. The close spacing within platoons limits overtaking opportunities, increasing collision risks of passing vehicles with oncoming traffic. This paper proposes a CAV platoon control strategy of gap opening for guided single HDV overtaking scenarios, which consists of algorithms that determine optimal gap location, gap opening complete time, and gap opening start time, to balance the trade-off between gap prediction accuracy, controller performance, and platoon string stability. The control strategy is evaluated with a simulation, demonstrating its capability to dynamically adapt to real-time traffic conditions and achieve the goals of control accuracy and reliability. The results highlight the feasibility of implementing the control strategy in CAV platooning systems for safe handling of interactions with HDVs in the twolane highway overtaking scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种网联自动车（CAV）队列控制策略，通过在队列中打开间隙引导单辆人类驾驶车（HDV）安全超车，平衡了间隙预测精度、控制器性能和队列串稳定性，仿真验证了该策略在双车道公路超车场景中的可行性和有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何在双车道无分隔高速公路上，通过CAV队列控制策略安全引导HDV超车，同时平衡间隙预测精度、控制器性能与队列串稳定性？
AI.motivation: CAV队列紧密编队虽能提升燃油效率和运行性能，但与HDV交互时存在安全隐患；在双车道公路上，HDV超车需借用对向车道，队列间距过小会限制超车机会、增加碰撞风险，亟需一种协调控制策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 队列控制理论、间隙优化算法、串稳定性理论
AI.method: 提出包含最优间隙位置、间隙完全打开时间和间隙打开起始时间三个算法的控制策略，并通过仿真进行验证。
AI.findings: 该控制策略能够动态适应实时交通条件，实现控制精度和可靠性的目标；在双车道公路超车场景中，策略能安全处理CAV队列与HDV的交互。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个兼顾间隙预测精度、控制器性能与串稳定性的三目标权衡框架，丰富了CAV队列控制与异构交通流交互的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为双车道公路上CAV队列安全处理HDV超车提供了可实施的控制方案，对提升混合交通流的安全性和通行效率具有实际意义。

title: The AI Infrastructure Triad in Regional Governance: How Regions Balance Progress, Sustainability, and Equity
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Kennedy School (HKS) and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: The AI Infrastructure Triad in Regional Governance: How Regions Balance Progress, Sustainability, and Equity
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence infrastructure, including data centers and the energy, land, water, and labor systems that support them, presents regional policymakers with trade-offs that are poorly captured by the prevailing "innovation versus regulation" frame. This article develops the AI Infrastructure Triad as a conceptual framework for analyzing three competing priorities in regional AI infrastructure governance: Progress, Sustainability, and Equity. We argue that regions are unlikely to maximize all three simultaneously under current technological, institutional, and resource conditions. Drawing on prior work on the economic, physical, and moral limits of AI development, a previously coded dataset of 10,068 public comments submitted to the 2025 U.S. AI Action Plan and illustrative regional cases, the article interprets stakeholder and regional positions as different ways of prioritizing the triad's frontiers. The evidence is used illustratively rather than as a full causal test. The paper's contribution is to clarify the trade-offs that infrastructure decisions often obscure, distinguish deliberate triad governance from default allocation by market power or regulatory inertia, and propose a Deliberate Triad Choice Framework for policymakers considering AI infrastructure decisions of significant scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"AI基础设施三难困境"框架，指出区域政策制定者在AI基础设施建设中面临进度、可持续性和公平性三个竞争性目标之间的权衡，并提出了"审慎三难选择框架"作为政策工具。
AI.research_question: 区域政策制定者在AI基础设施治理中，如何理解并应对进度、可持续性与公平性这三个相互竞争的目标之间的权衡？
AI.motivation: 现有"创新vs监管"的二元框架未能充分捕捉AI基础设施扩张带来的复杂社会-环境-经济权衡，区域政策制定者缺乏系统性的分析工具来指导决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI基础设施三难困境框架：进度（Progress）、可持续性（Sustainability）、公平性（Equity）；借鉴了AI发展的经济极限、物理极限和道德极限相关研究。
AI.method: 1. 概念框架构建（AI基础设施三难困境）；2. 基于先前编码的10,068条公众评论数据集（提交至2025年美国AI行动计划）；3. 结合区域案例的说明性分析（非完全因果检验）。
AI.findings: 在当前技术、制度和资源条件下，区域难以同时最大化进度、可持续性和公平性三个目标；利益相关者和区域立场本质上是三难困境中不同优先排序方式的体现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI基础设施三难困境框架，区分了"审慎的三难选择"与默认的市场权力或监管惯性分配方式，阐明了基础设施决策中常被掩盖的权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域政策制定者提供了"审慎三难选择框架"，用于指导大规模AI基础设施决策，帮助避免在创新与监管的简单二分法中忽视关键的社会、环境与公平问题。

title: We Look Like What We Like
affiliations: TUM School of Management,Technical University of Munich, University of Basel, Arison School of Business , Reichman University - Interdisciplinary Center (IDC) Herzliyah and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Marketing

detail.title: We Look Like What We Like

publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Our faces are said to be windows into the soul. But can they also reflect who we are as consumers? Can facial images predict brand preferences? To answer these questions, we analyze a unique dataset of over 100,000 single-face Twitter profile pictures linked with brand followership data for 444 brands across categories and brand personality metrics. Using advanced machine learning for automated face analysis, we demonstrate that consumers' social media profile faces can reveal their preferences between rival brands (study 1). We further show that consumers who follow brands with similar brand personality traits (e.g., glamorous, rugged) tend to look alike (study 2). Finally, we identify facial appearance characteristics associated with brand personality traits; for example, followers of "smart" brands like Barnes & Noble are likely to wear reading glasses, while "edgy" brands like Diesel attract bearded men (study 3). Together, our findings show that brands can extract actionable insights from consumers' facial images, both to address the "cold start" problem by predicting preferences before any consumption actions are observed and to better understand the brand's identity through the aggregated traits of its followers. This work is among the first to demonstrate large-scale associations between faces and brand preferences.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用超过10万张Twitter个人资料照片和444个品牌的关注数据，通过机器学习面部分析技术，发现消费者的社交媒体面部照片可以预测其品牌偏好，不同品牌人格特征（如"聪明"、"前卫"）的追随者在外貌上具有可识别的相似特征（如戴眼镜、留胡须），为品牌提供了利用面部图像解决"冷启动"问题和理解品牌身份的新途径。
AI.research_question: 面部图像能否预测消费者的品牌偏好？消费者的社交媒体头像是否揭示了其对不同品牌的喜好倾向？
AI.motivation: 探索面部图像这一非传统数据源在预测消费偏好方面的潜力，填补了"面孔与品牌偏好之间大规模关联"这一研究空白，为品牌营销提供新的洞察工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌人格理论（Brand Personality）、面部特征与社会认知理论、机器学习面部分析技术、消费者自我呈现理论。
AI.method: 收集超过10万张Twitter单人头像照片及444个品牌的关注数据；采用先进的机器学习自动化面部分析技术；进行三个子研究：品牌偏好预测（研究1）、品牌人格与外貌相似性（研究2）、品牌人格与具体面部特征关联（研究3）。
AI.findings: （1）消费者的社交媒体头像可预测其对竞争品牌之间的偏好；（2）追随具有相似品牌人格特质（如魅力、粗犷）的消费者在面部特征上具有相似性；（3）特定面部特征与品牌人格相关：如"聪明"品牌（Barnes & Noble）的追随者更可能戴眼镜，"前卫"品牌（Diesel）的追随者更可能是留胡须的男性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在大规模样本中验证了面部图像与品牌偏好之间的系统性关联，将消费者面部特征研究与品牌人格理论相结合，拓展了消费者自我呈现和品牌认同的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌提供了一种基于面部图像的新方法来解决"冷启动"问题（即在观察到任何消费行为之前预测偏好），并帮助品牌通过追随者的聚合特征更好地理解自身品牌身份和定位。

reference: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
title: Why Real Wage Gains Were Not So Real: Evidence from Household-Level Food-at-Home Inflation

detail.title: Why Real Wage Gains Were Not So Real: Evidence from Household-Level Food-at-Home Inflation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: During the pandemic-era inflation (2021-2024), widely cited measures of real wage growth suggested that the purchasing power of U.S. workers-especially low-wage workers-rose. Yet economic sentiment remained persistently negative, prompting arguments that public pessimism reflected psychology rather than material conditions. This paper provides evidence that standard CPI-deflated wage measures misrepresented changes in material well-being for many households during this period. Using NielsenIQ Consumer Panel Data (2005-2023), I construct household-specific food-at home inflation rates and corresponding real purchasing-power measures. I find substantial dispersion in household-level food-at-home inflation, which widened sharply during the 2021-2023 inflation surge. Consequently, despite conventional measures indicating rising real food-at-home purchasing power for low-wage workers, I find that a majority of households in the bottom income decile experienced declines in real food-at-home purchasing power between 2019 and 2023. I likewise document similar divergences between conventional measures and the experiences of households across the broader income distribution. These results demonstrate how aggregate CPI-deflated wage measures can misrepresent changes in material well-being, highlighting a broader measurement issue and offering a material explanation for the apparent disconnect between macroeconomic indicators and public sentiment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究2021-2024年疫情期间，标准CPI平减后的工资指标低估了许多家庭（尤其是低收入家庭）实际购买力下降的真实情况。作者利用尼尔森家庭消费面板数据，构建了家庭层面的食品通胀率，发现家庭间通胀率存在巨大差异，导致多数低收入家庭的实际食品购买力下降，而传统指标却显示上升。
AI.research_question: 疫情期间，标准CPI平减的实际工资指标是否准确反映了美国家庭（特别是低收入家庭）物质福利的变化？为什么宏观经济指标与公众情绪之间存在脱节？
AI.motivation: 疫情期间标准实际工资指标显示美国工人（尤其是低薪工人）购买力上升，但经济情绪持续低迷，有观点将此归因于公众悲观心理。本文试图从测量偏差角度提供一种物质层面的解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭层面的异质性通胀率理论；CPI平减指标对福利测量的局限性；收入分布与消费篮子构成的异质性。
AI.method: 使用尼尔森消费者面板数据（2005-2023），构建家庭层面的食品消费通胀率，并将其与传统CPI平减指标进行对比分析，考察不同收入分位家庭的实际购买力变化。
AI.findings: （1）家庭层面食品通胀率存在显著差异，且在2021-2023年通胀激增期间差异急剧扩大；（2）传统指标显示低薪工人实际食品购买力上升，但2019-2023年间，收入最低十分位的大多数家庭实际食品购买力下降；（3）类似偏差同样存在于更广泛的收入分布中。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了聚合CPI指标对家庭福利测量的系统性偏差，证明了消费篮子异质性和家庭层面通胀差异的重要性，为宏观经济指标与微观感受之间的"脱节"提供了测量视角的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和研究者，传统的CPI平减工资指标可能误导对民众真实福利状况的判断；指出改善物价测量方法的必要性，特别是在高通胀时期应关注不同收入群体的差异化通胀体验。

title: Human Time as an Economic Asset: How Innovation Creates Value and Why It Should Be Measured
affiliations: Market Platform Dynamics

detail.title: Human Time as an Economic Asset: How Innovation Creates Value and Why It Should Be Measured

keywords: human time as an economic asset
revealed preference and the value of time

detail.abstract: The stock of human time serves a dual role in the economy: it is the ultimate source of social welfare and a principal input into producing it. It is therefore central to economic progress. Raising its value, both at the intensive margin through gains in productivity and at the extensive margin through gains in longevity, could generate substantial increases in short-run and long-run welfare. Yet no one systematically tracks the value of human time, and this paper argues that economists should. The paper makes five contributions. First, it shows that human time is a personal, national, and global asset: a rough estimate places the value of the U.S. time stock at roughly $4.5 quadrillion, dwarfing conventional assets such as the housing stock, fixed capital, and the value of publicly traded companies. Second, it develops a framework in which human time is two-dimensional, combining chronological time with the brain activity, which includes the allocation of attention, that occurs over time. Third, it uses this framework to identify nine overlapping sources of disruptive innovation that raise the value of human time, pointing in several cases to rigorous economic studies that document the gains. Fourth, it shows that the existing economic toolkit, such as value-of-life studies, can deliver revealed-preference estimates of changes in the value of time at the intensive and extensive margins. Finally, it argues that it is worthwhile and feasible to construct a "time score card" that tracks changes in the value of human time using revealed preference, with money as a common numeraire. Such a measure would fill gaps left by conventional metrics such as GDP, which miss key aspects of human time; it would provide a rigorous proxy for long-run welfare; and it could guide economic policy, including investments in public goods that raise the value of human time. Economists, the paper concludes, would do well to devote more research to human time as a measurable improvable asset that is critical to well-being and incorporate human time more rigorously into existing fields such as macroeconomics.

AI.tldr: 本文主张经济学家应系统追踪人类时间的价值，将其视为可衡量的关键经济资产，并提出构建"时间记分卡"以弥补GDP等传统指标的不足。
AI.research_question: 为什么经济学家应该系统性地追踪和衡量人类时间的价值？如何构建一个衡量人类时间价值的框架？
AI.motivation: 人类时间是社会福利的最终来源和生产社会福利的主要投入，但其价值从未被系统追踪。现有指标（如GDP）忽略了人类时间的关键维度，而人类时间价值（美国约$4.5 quadrillion）远超传统资产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二维时间框架：结合了时间顺序（chronological time）与随时间发生的脑活动（包括注意力分配）。从集约边际（生产率提升）和粗放边际（寿命延长）两个维度分析时间价值提升。
AI.method: 概念框架构建、已有经济研究综述、显示性偏好估算方法（如生命价值研究）、以及提出构建"时间记分卡"的可行性论证。
AI.findings: 美国时间存量价值约为$4.5 quadrillion，远超住房存量、固定资本和上市公司市值；识别了九种提升人类时间价值的破坏性创新来源；显示性偏好方法可用于估算时间价值的集约和粗放边际变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了人类时间作为个人、国家和全球资产的新概念；构建了二维时间框架，将时间顺序与脑活动/注意力分配结合；将人类时间价值纳入宏观经济学等现有领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议构建以货币为共同计量单位的"时间记分卡"，作为长期福利的代理指标；指导经济政策制定，包括提升人类时间价值的公共品投资；弥补GDP等传统指标的关键缺失。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Inventory Control in Three-Echelon Supply Chains with Bypass Routing

detail.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Inventory Control in Three-Echelon Supply Chains with Bypass Routing
detail.abstract: We study a finite-horizon, periodic-review, capacitated three-echelon supply chain inventory problem with multiple factories, distribution centers, and local warehouses, in which replenishment can follow either standard hierarchical routes or direct factory-to-warehouse bypass routes. The resulting decision problem jointly integrates production planning, shipment allocation, inventory control, and routing under stochastic and seasonal demand, deterministic or stochastic lead-time regimes, and networkwide inventory interactions. To address this problem, we formulate it as a stochastic control problem in which routing decisions are represented by binary variables, and we develop a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approach based on proximal policy optimization (PPO). We compare alternative observation and action parameterizations, including full versus reduced state representations and purely continuous versus mixed action designs. We then benchmark the learned policies against an expected-value problem baseline and optimized static inventory policies, such as (s,Q) and basestock rules. Numerical experiments on a broad family of 12 benchmark instances with divergentto-general supply chain networks under four lead-time regimes show that PPO consistently delivers the best overall performance in terms of total cost, especially as the network becomes larger, more interconnected, and more uncertain. The results further indicate that reduced observation designs improve scalability in complex settings and that mixed action parameterizations can enhance solution quality with only moderate computational overhead. Overall, this study demonstrates that DRL is a promising and scalable methodology for coordinating inventory and routing decisions in real-world multi-echelon supply chains with flexible replenishment structures.

AI.tldr: 本文利用深度强化学习（PPO算法）解决多级供应链中生产、库存、配送与路径的联合优化问题，实验表明该方法在大规模、互联、不确定的网络中优于传统策略。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度强化学习协调多级供应链中的库存与路径决策，以实现总成本最小化？
AI.motivation: 多级供应链在生产、库存、配送和路径决策之间存在复杂交互，且面临随机需求、季节性波动和多种提前期，传统方法难以有效应对这种联合优化问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机最优控制理论；深度强化学习（近端策略优化PPO）；库存管理理论（如(s,Q)策略、基库存策略）。
AI.method: 将问题建模为含二进制路径变量的随机控制问题；采用基于PPO的深度强化学习方法；对比不同观测表示（完整vs简化）和动作参数化（纯连续vs混合）；与传统期望值方法和静态库存策略进行基准比较。
AI.findings: PPO在12个算例和四种提前期体制下总成本表现最优；网络越大、互联越复杂、不确定性越高时优势越明显；简化观测设计可提升复杂场景的可扩展性；混合动作参数化能以适度计算开销提升解质量。
AI.theory_contributions: 将深度强化学习应用于多级供应链联合优化问题，展示了DRL在库存-路径协调中的理论可行性；对比多种参数化设计，揭示了观测简化与混合动作设计对性能的影响规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际多级供应链提供了一种可扩展的智能决策方法，支持灵活补货结构（层级与直达路线并存），在复杂不确定环境下优于传统库存策略。

title: Hedging with Talent: How Selection Under Uncertainty Reshapes Automation's Workforce Effects
affiliations: University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) - College of Engineering and

detail.title: Hedging with Talent: How Selection Under Uncertainty Reshapes Automation's Workforce Effects
detail.abstract: When automation arrives at workplaces where workers can easily exit, job insecurity theory predicts they should flee. Across automation deployments at the fulfillment organization we studied, temporary workers did not. The candidate worker-side explanations for this puzzle---improved working conditions and reduced labor market alternatives---find no support in our evidence. We document an upstream organizational mechanism---that we call hedging with talent---comprising two coordinated practices: managers facing operational uncertainty at automation deployment concentrate their most reliably observed workers against the uncertainty reliability hedging, while shielding workers from the automation context that would let them self-select information shielding. Hedging with talent is a general response to automation in temp-labor settings; what novelty contributes is duration. Through a mixed-method study combining administrative data on 59,021 temp worker separations across 21 automation deployments with 351 interviews and 718 hours of observation, we trace the mechanism through hire-cohort decomposition across ten deployment sites. Across all sites, incumbents (workers hired before deployment who separated after) showed elevated tenure relative to fresh hires---the structural signature of selection from the observed pool. At the focal novel-technology site, the depth and duration of incumbent retention substantially exceeded the patterns at comparable mature-sortation sites: 22.4 percent of Gallifrey incumbents reached 2,000 hours of cumulative tenure against an upper bound of 9.0 percent at comparable mature-sortation sites; 13.5 percent of Gallifrey incumbents lasted more than a year past the deployment date, against an upper bound of 0.4 percent at sites with comparable observation windows. A second site with concurrent novel and mature deployments showed directionally consistent patterns. What appears to be worker behavior at automation deployments is, on inspection, management action working through an information system workers cannot see---a structural process that operates broadly across automation deployments and that novelty distinctively sustains.

AI.tldr: 在工人容易离职的自动化部署场景中，临时工并未如工作不安全感理论预期的那样逃离。本文揭示了一个上游组织机制——"用人才对冲"——管理者通过集中保留最可靠观察到的工人（可靠性对冲）并屏蔽自动化信息（信息屏蔽）来应对运营不确定性。混合方法研究发现，这一机制在临时工环境中普遍存在，而技术新颖性显著延长了其持续时间。
AI.research_question: 为什么在自动化部署后，能够轻易离职的临时工并未如工作不安全感理论所预测的那样选择逃离？
AI.motivation: 传统工作不安全感理论认为，当自动化到来时，工人会因担心失业而逃离。然而，作者在物流履约组织的实际观察中发现，临时工并未大规模离职。工人层面的解释（工作条件改善、劳动力市场替代机会减少）均未得到数据支持，因此需要从组织层面寻找机制解释这一"谜题"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）工作不安全感理论（Job Insecurity Theory）；2）组织人才管理理论；3）信息不对称与工人自我选择理论；4）组织对冲（Hedging）理论——管理者通过可靠性对冲和信息屏蔽来应对运营不确定性。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：①行政数据分析：59,021名临时工在21次自动化部署中的离职数据，跨10个部署站点进行雇佣队列分解；②定性研究：351次访谈 + 718小时观察；③对比分析：以新颖技术站点（Gallifrey）与成熟分拣站点进行对照。
AI.findings: 1）自动化部署后，在职者（部署前入职、部署后离职的工人）的任期显著高于新入职者，这是从观察池中筛选的结构性标志；2）在新颖技术站点（Gallifrey），22.4%的在职者达到2,000小时累计任期（成熟站点上限为9.0%），13.5%的在职者在部署后持续工作超过一年（对照站点上限为0.4%）；3）管理者通过"可靠性对冲"集中保留高可靠性工人，通过"信息屏蔽"阻止工人了解自动化可能性，从而阻止其自我选择离职。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）挑战了"工人主动逃离自动化"的传统叙事，揭示自动化部署中看似工人行为实为管理行为的现象；2）提出"用人才对冲"（Hedging with Talent）这一新机制，将组织不确定性与人才保留策略联系起来；3）揭示技术新颖性如何延长组织对冲机制的持续时间，丰富了技术变革与组织行为的交叉理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提醒管理者和政策制定者：自动化部署中工人的"留任"可能并非自愿选择，而是信息不对称下的被动结果；2）揭示管理实践中的"信息屏蔽"可能损害工人自主决策权，存在伦理隐患；3）为企业在自动化转型中如何平衡运营效率与工人权益提供参考。

reference: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 925/2026; LawFin Working Paper Forthcoming
title: Templates in the EU Inc. Regulation Proposal
affiliations: ,  and Leibniz Institute for Financial Research SAFE

detail.title: Templates in the EU Inc. Regulation Proposal

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 925/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series
DFG Center for Advanced Studies - Foundations of Law & Finance (LawFin) Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
European debates on competitiveness increasingly treat corporate law as a lever to help innovative firms scale. The European Commission’s Proposal for a new “28th regime” seeks to introduce an optional, EU-wide corporate legal form designed, inter alia, to facilitate the cross-border scaling of innovative firms. A central instrument of the Proposal is the use of model articles of association to be adopted through future implementing acts. This Article argues that, while standardised articles may ease incorporation and lower drafting costs for ordinary unlisted firms, they fall short for VC-backed companies—the very cases that motivated the initiative.

Building on prior work on venture capital contracting under mandatory corporate law, we identify four shortcomings. First, the architecture is incomplete: the Proposal omits a model shareholder agreement, even though effective VC contracting depends on the interaction between articles of association and shareholder arrangements. Second, the drafting process is overly generalist and unlikely to yield genuinely VC-specific templates. Third, the Proposal’s fairness-oriented logic risks producing terms that clash with the asymmetric, state-contingent structures typical of VC deals. Fourth, the legal protection offered by the template is limited, focusing on formation-stage effects while leaving subsequent judicial intervention unconstrained.

We propose four adjustments: introduce a model shareholders’ agreement; create a dedicated VC drafting track; abandon fairness as the organising principle for VC templates; and provide a robust safe harbour covering both ex ante design and ex post enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性分析欧盟“第28种制度”提案中的示范章程条款，指出其虽有利于普通非上市公司，但对风险投资支持的企业存在四大缺陷，并提出四项改进建议。
AI.research_question: 欧盟“第28种制度”提案中的示范公司章程条款能否有效满足风险投资支持企业的需求？若不能，应如何改进？
AI.motivation: 欧盟试图通过引入可选性的欧盟层面公司法律形式（“第28种制度”），利用示范公司章程降低创新型企业跨境扩张的合规成本，但现有设计可能忽视风险投资（VC）支持型企业的特殊契约需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险投资契约理论；强制性公司法下的合同自由理论；公司治理中的条款互动理论（公司章程与股东协议的互补性）。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析；基于既有风险投资契约文献的理论推演；比较法视角下的制度设计评估。
AI.findings: 1. 提案架构不完整，缺少配套的示范股东协议；2. 起草过程过于一般化，难以生成VC特定模板；3. 公平导向的逻辑与VC合约中非对称、状态依存的典型结构冲突；4. 法律保护有限，仅关注设立阶段而放任后续司法干预。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了强制性公司法框架下标准化条款与VC复杂契约需求之间的结构性张力，拓展了公司法与创业金融交叉领域的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟立法者提出四项具体改进建议：引入示范股东协议、设立VC专门起草轨道、放弃公平原则作为VC模板的组织原则、提供覆盖事前设计与事后执行的安全港规则。

reference: Cornell SC Johnson College of Business Research Paper
title: Power and Influence: Billionaire Companies in Emerging Market Economies
affiliations: , Cornell University - Emerging Markets Institute and Cornell University - Johnson Graduate School of Management

detail.title: Power and Influence: Billionaire Companies in Emerging Market Economies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Cornell SC Johnson College of Business Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Cornell SC Johnson College of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper deepens the understanding of the multifaceted importance of billionaire companies from emerging markets, with a focus on the E20+1, a group of 21 key emerging economies defined by the Cañizares Center for Emerging Markets at Cornell University. The group includes China and, in alphabetical order, Argentina, Bangladesh, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Iran, Malaysia, Mexico, Pakistan, Peru, the Philippines, Romania, Russia, South Africa, Thailand, Türkiye, and Viet Nam. The paper examines the revenues and sectoral distribution of these enterprises, highlighting significant concentrations of corporate power across many emerging market economies.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦E20+1（21个关键新兴经济体）中的 billionaire companies，分析了这些企业的收入与行业分布，揭示了新兴市场经济体中企业权力的显著集中现象。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场中的 billionaire companies 收入与行业分布如何？这些企业在E20+1经济体中呈现出怎样的企业权力集中格局？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对新兴市场 billionaire companies 的多维重要性理解不足，作者希望弥补这一空白，深入探讨其在E20+1经济体中的角色与影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业权力集中理论、新兴市场企业战略理论
AI.method: 以E20+1经济体为样本，收集 billionaire companies 的收入与行业数据，进行描述性统计与行业分布分析。
AI.findings: E20+1经济体中 billionaire companies 的收入高度集中，且行业分布呈现显著的不均衡，反映出新兴市场企业权力的集中化趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴市场 billionaire companies 多维度重要性的理论理解，拓展了企业权力集中理论在新兴经济体情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和企业家提供了关于新兴市场企业权力格局的实证依据，有助于识别市场风险与机会。

reference: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 928/2026
title: Reining in Big Tech Corporations: Why Platform Governance Requires Structural Regulation
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Reining in Big Tech Corporations: Why Platform Governance Requires Structural Regulation

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 928/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper argues that modern corporations, particularly Big Tech Platform Corporations (BTPCs), should be understood not as private contractual arrangements but as artificial legal entities created and empowered by States. Through incorporation, corporations receive State-like attributes including perpetual existence, legal personhood, capital lock-in, and entity shielding, enabling them to accumulate and organise capital across time and space. The paper introduces the concepts of “Recursive Capital” and “Capital-Constituting Corporations” to explain how BTPCs extend beyond market participation to shape the very conditions under which economic activity becomes capitalisable. Drawing historical parallels with the English East India Company and Gilded Age monopolies, the paper contends that BTPCs now exercise infrastructural and governance power comparable to semi-sovereign actors. Existing antitrust and contractual theories are therefore inadequate. The paper concludes that platform governance requires structural regulation and a reassertion of democratic oversight to recalibrate the delegated powers States have granted corporations.

AI.tldr: 本文主张现代企业（尤其是大型科技平台企业）应被理解为国家创造和授权的虚拟法律实体，而非私人契约安排。它们拥有准国家属性，能够塑造经济活动资本化的条件，因此需要结构性监管和民主监督。
AI.research_question: 现代大型科技平台企业的本质是什么？现有的反垄断和契约理论为何不足以解释它们的权力？
AI.motivation: 现有法律和经济理论将企业视为私人契约安排，无法充分解释大型科技平台企业所行使的准国家权力和基础设施治理能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: "递归资本"（Recursive Capital）和"资本构成型公司"（Capital-Constituting Corporations）概念；公司作为国家创造的虚拟法律实体理论。
AI.method: 理论论证与历史比较分析（与英国东印度公司和镀金时代垄断企业进行类比）。
AI.findings: 大型科技平台企业通过国家授予的公司特权获得了永久存续、法律人格、资本锁定和实体屏蔽等准国家属性，其权力已超越市场参与，构成类似半主权行为者的基础设施和治理权力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"递归资本"和"资本构成型公司"新概念，挑战传统企业契约理论，将企业重新定位为国家授权行使公共权力的实体。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出平台治理需要结构性监管和民主监督，以重新校准国家授予企业的委托权力，为反垄断和平台规制政策提供理论依据。

title: What California's Senate Bill 253 Means for Asset Managers
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business, Hankuk University of Foreign Studies and University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: What California's Senate Bill 253 Means for Asset Managers
detail.abstract: Asset managers serving climate-conscious investors rely on carbon-intensity metrics to guide capital allocation within sectors, but until now have compared firms primarily on Scopes 1 and 2 emissions—direct operations and purchased energy—because that data was most available under voluntary reporting. California's Senate Bill 253 changes that, mandating full-scope emissions disclosure, including Scope 3, for U.S.-incorporated firms with over $1 billion in annual revenue doing business in California. Our study in Nature Communications Sustainability shows that adding value-chain emissions fundamentally alters relative carbon performance evaluation, with partial and full sector-peer rankings correlating at just 42%. In sector-neutral carbon-tilted portfolios, full-intensity tilting cuts financed emissions by roughly 45% versus only 6% on partial-intensity data, at comparable returns. This synthesis evaluates what these findings mean for asset managers and the climate-conscious investors they serve, arguing that the choice of emissions metric shapes a portfolio's fundamental and carbon characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用加州SB253法案强制要求企业披露全范围（含Scope 3）碳排放数据的机会，发现纳入价值链碳排放从根本上改变了企业的相对碳绩效评估，使用全范围碳强度构建行业中性组合比仅使用部分范围数据能多削减约39%的融资排放，且回报相当。
AI.research_question: 纳入全范围碳排放（含Scope 3价值链排放）如何改变行业内企业的相对碳绩效评价，以及对资产管理者构建低碳投资组合有何影响？
AI.motivation: 长期以来，资产管理者和气候意识投资者仅依赖Scope 1和Scope 2排放数据（直接运营和购买能源）进行资本配置，因为自愿披露框架下Scope 3数据不可得。加州SB253法案强制要求企业披露全范围排放，为研究完整碳排放信息对投资决策的增量影响提供了契机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳强度指标比较方法、行业中性碳倾斜投资组合理论、融资排放（financed emissions）评估框架。
AI.method: 比较部分范围（Scope 1+2）与全范围（Scope 1+2+3）碳强度在企业间排名的一致性（斯皮尔曼相关系数），并构建行业中性碳倾斜投资组合，对比两种指标下的融资排放削减幅度和投资回报。
AI.findings: （1）部分范围与全范围碳强度排名仅有42%的相关性；（2）全范围碳倾斜组合削减约45%的融资排放，而部分范围组合仅削减约6%；（3）两种组合的回报相当。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在强制性全范围披露数据背景下，实证证明Scope 3价值链排放信息对行业内碳绩效排名具有颠覆性影响，挑战了依赖部分排放数据进行相对绩效评估的现有实践。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产管理者和气候意识投资者提供关键启示：仅基于Scope 1+2的碳指标会严重低估减排潜力，应转向全范围碳强度指标以更有效地降低融资排放，同时不影响投资回报。

reference: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 930/2026
title: Corporate National Identity
affiliations: Stanford Law School, Harvard Law School and Singapore Management University - Yong Pung How School of Law

detail.title: Corporate National Identity

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute - Law Working Paper No. 930/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Law Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
What makes a corporation American, Italian, Chinese, or any other nationality – and who gets to decide? In the contemporary global economy, corporate national identity (CNI) can no longer be understood as a fixed legal attribute. Rather, it emerges from the interaction of four interrelated facets – legal, economic, (geo)political, and symbolic – whose relative salience varies across contexts and over time. Classical legal tests such as the jurisdiction of incorporation, real seat doctrine, and corporate control remain important, but they are increasingly insufficient. In a world of weaponized interdependence, data location and access, supply-chain geography, state influence over private firms, and efforts to shape public perceptions of corporate identity now play central roles in determining how firms are classified and treated. Two nascent tests are emerging across these facets: what might be called a “data seat” doctrine that treats data location and access as a marker of CNI, and a government influence test that looks beyond voting equity to assess the degree of state leverage over corporate decision-making.

Drawing on case studies involving TikTok, Shein, Pirelli, and Nippon Steel’s acquisition of U.S. Steel, the article illustrates how CNI is increasingly contested and actively reconstructed. The result is a potential shift away from a binary world in which cross-border transactions are either permitted or blocked, toward a more intrusive model in which states restructure governance arrangements midstream in the name of national security, while firms seek to strategically shape their identities to navigate this new reality. The article explores new questions CNI contestation and engineering raise for corporate law, investor protection, and cross-border investment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了企业国籍（CNI）在全球化经济中如何从固定法律属性转变为由法律、经济、地缘政治和象征性四个维度互动建构的动态概念。传统法律测试（如注册地、实际管理地、控制权）已不足够，新兴的"数据所在地"和"政府影响力"测试正在形成。通过TikTok、Shein、倍耐力、新日铁收购美国钢铁等案例，文章展示了CNI如何被争议和重构，并分析了这一趋势对公司法、投资者保护和跨境投资的影响。
AI.research_question: 在当代全球经济中，企业国籍（CNI）是如何被界定和建构的？传统法律标准为何不足，以及哪些新标准正在兴起？
AI.motivation: 全球化经济中企业国籍问题日益复杂，传统法律框架已无法解释各国如何基于国家安全理由干预跨境交易和企业治理。需要新的理论框架来理解这一动态过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业国籍（CNI）的四维度框架：法律、经济、地缘政治、象征性。两种新兴测试："数据所在地"原则和政府影响力测试。"武器化相互依赖"理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析TikTok、Shein、倍耐力、新日铁收购美国钢铁等多个典型案例。
AI.findings: 企业国籍已从固定法律属性转变为由多维度互动建构的动态概念；传统法律测试不足；"数据所在地"和"政府影响力"成为新兴判定标准；各国从二元（允许/禁止）模式转向更侵入性的治理重组模式；企业也开始主动塑造自身国籍形象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了企业国籍的四维度互动框架；识别并定义了"数据所在地"和"政府影响力"两种新兴测试；将"武器化相互依赖"理论引入企业国籍研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业跨国经营提供国籍风险管理的战略指导；为政策制定者理解企业国籍认定的复杂性提供分析工具；为公司法、投资者保护和跨境投资实践提供新的思考方向。

title: Advancing Competition Policy in the Digital Gatekeeper Era – A Tribute to Heike Schweitzer
affiliations: University of Mannheim and University of Mannheim - Department of Economics

detail.title: Advancing Competition Policy in the Digital Gatekeeper Era – A Tribute to Heike Schweitzer
detail.abstract: This contribution examines Heike Schweitzer’s role as a competition policy analyst and adviser in the formative phase of European competition policy towards digital platforms. It situates her work in this context and develops a conceptual framework that captures the challenges of analysis under conditions of uncertainty and dynamic market developments. Through a selective analysis of four key reports, the article reconstructs central analytical approaches and policy proposals, identifies characteristic features of a “Heike Schweitzer approach”, and assesses its influence on subsequent regulatory developments, in particular the Digital Markets Act and section 19a of the German Competition Act.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Heike Schweitzer在欧洲数字平台竞争政策形成阶段的分析与政策建议，通过四个关键报告梳理其研究方法与政策主张，评估其对《数字市场法》和德国《竞争法》第19a条的影响。
AI.research_question: Heike Schweitzer在数字平台竞争政策形成阶段的分析方法和政策建议是什么，以及她对后续监管发展（尤其是DMA和德国竞争法第19a条）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 在不确定性高、市场动态变化快的条件下，竞争政策分析面临独特挑战。通过研究Schweitzer的工作，可以更好地理解在复杂环境下如何开展竞争政策分析与咨询。
AI.theoretical_framework: 在不确定性和动态市场发展条件下进行分析的概念框架；竞争政策分析中的"不确定性"与"动态市场发展"理论视角。
AI.method: 选择性分析四个关键报告，进行定性内容分析与历史重构。
AI.findings: 识别出"Heike Schweitzer approach"的特征性方法，并发现其工作对《数字市场法》和德国《竞争法》第19a条产生了实质性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在不确定性和动态市场条件下进行竞争政策分析的概念框架，为理解数字平台监管的理论基础提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 系统评估了Schweitzer的政策建议对欧洲数字平台监管立法（DMA和德国竞争法）的实际影响力，为竞争政策制定者提供了参考。

title: Framing AI in public innovation: the engagement-manipulation nexus
affiliations: University of Edinburgh, Pan-Atlantic University and Epam Systems Colombia SAS

detail.title: Framing AI in public innovation: the engagement-manipulation nexus
detail.abstract: AI integration into public service innovation creates a paradox: promising enhanced engagement while risking manipulation. This paper develops the Engagement-Manipulation Nexus, a conceptual framework using Framing Theory to analyse this tension. We adapt Framing Theory to the algorithmic era, arguing AI is both an object to be framed and an agent disseminating frames. AI innovation trajectories are forged through communicative struggles among actors deploying competing frames. This paper contributes a novel theoretical framework, theorizes public innovation as communicatively constructed, and provides a diagnostic tool for practitioners. Critical frame awareness is essential for steering AI towards public value and democratic governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"参与-操纵关系"框架，运用框架理论分析AI融入公共服务创新的悖论——既提升参与又存在操纵风险，强调批判性框架意识对引导AI走向公共价值和民主治理的重要性。
AI.research_question: AI融入公共服务创新如何同时产生增强参与和操纵风险的双重效应？这一悖论如何在沟通互动中被建构和演变？
AI.motivation: AI融入公共服务创新存在一个核心悖论：一方面承诺增强公众参与，另一方面又存在操纵风险。现有研究缺乏分析这一张力的系统性理论工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 框架理论（Framing Theory）——将其适应到算法时代，认为AI既是被框架的客体，也是传播框架的主体。
AI.method: 概念性理论研究，通过提出"参与-操纵关系"（Engagement-Manipulation Nexus）概念框架进行理论建构。
AI.findings: AI创新轨迹通过不同行动者之间的沟通斗争（竞争性框架的部署）而形成；批判性框架意识对于引导AI走向公共价值和民主治理至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"参与-操纵关系"这一新颖的理论框架；2. 将公共服务创新理论化为沟通建构的过程；3. 将框架理论拓展至算法时代，重新定义AI的双重角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供诊断工具，帮助他们识别和分析AI创新中的框架竞争，从而更好地引导AI服务于公共价值和民主治理。

title: What Creates Safe and Efficient Pedestrian–Vehicle Interactions? A Naturalistic Study to Design Human-Like Behaviour for Automated Vehicles
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Leeds and University of Leeds

detail.title: What Creates Safe and Efficient Pedestrian–Vehicle Interactions? A Naturalistic Study to Design Human-Like Behaviour for Automated Vehicles
detail.abstract: Safe and efficient interaction with pedestrians is critical for the successful deployment of autonomous vehicles (AVs). While vehicle speed and acceleration are vital communication signals for this interaction, the ways in which human drivers use this kinematic communication signals remain under-explored. To design motion-based communication for AVs, this study aims to explore how drivers control their speed as a function of initial interaction conditions, and how this translates into more or less successful interaction outcomes. We analysed naturalistic trajectory data of vehicles and pedestrians from two zebra crossings in Leeds, UK, comprising 981 interactions. Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling (PLS-SEM) was applied to quantify the mediating effect of vehicle kinematics on the relationship between initial time gap and interaction outcomes (crossing order, efficiency, and safety). Based on these models, vehicle speed profiles associated with optimal and worst outcomes were identified and compared using Generalized Estimating Equations (GEE). PLS-SEM results confirmed that vehicle kinematics significantly mediate interaction outcomes, exerting a strong influence on efficiency and safety, and a weaker influence on crossing order. Minimum vehicle speed in particular exerted a strong influence on crossing order and safety, suggesting that the speed to which the driver drops is a key communication signal to pedestrians. The mediation results and trajectory analysis revealed that drivers used different strategies to achieve balance between their efficiency and interaction safety: in yielding scenarios (time gap > 3 s), they decelerated early and softly to maintain a low non-zero speed (~1 m/s) at a far distance (>10 m) to ensure safety while conserving momentum to ensure efficiency; in ambiguous non-yielding scenarios (time gaps ~ 1 – 3 s), they employed a two-stage strategy: a proactive initial deceleration to prepare for potential danger and reduce uncertainty, followed by an assertive acceleration for efficiency; in unambiguous non-yielding scenarios with a narrow time gap (< 1 s), they sacrificed a small amount of efficiency and adopted proactive deceleration before pedestrians displayed a clear crossing intention to ensure safety. This study expands the understanding of interaction beyond binary yielding choices, offering new insights into the proactive strategies human drivers use to negotiate right-of-way safely and efficiently. Emulating these kinematics strategies can support better integration of AVs into human traffic.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析981次自然主义的人车交互轨迹数据，利用PLS-SEM和GEE方法，揭示了驾驶员在不同初始时间间隔下如何通过速度控制实现安全高效的交互，并识别出三种典型的速度调节策略。
AI.research_question: 驾驶员如何根据初始交互条件控制车速，以及这种运动学沟通信号如何影响人车交互的成功结果（通行顺序、效率、安全性）？
AI.motivation: 自主驾驶汽车需要与行人进行安全高效的交互，但人类驾驶员如何使用速度和加速度等运动学信号进行沟通尚未得到充分探索。为设计基于运动的AV-行人交互策略，需要深入理解人类驾驶员的自然行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 运动学沟通信号理论；部分最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）中介效应分析；广义估计方程（GEE）；车辆运动学对初始时间间隔与交互结果关系的中介作用。
AI.method: 以英国利兹两个斑马线处的981次自然主义车辆-行人轨迹数据为样本，采用PLS-SEM量化车辆运动学在初始时间间隔与交互结果之间的中介效应，并利用GEE比较最优和最差结果对应的速度曲线。
AI.findings: 车辆运动学显著中介了交互结果，对效率和安全性影响强，对通行顺序影响较弱。最低速度是影响通行顺序和安全性的关键信号。驾驶员采用三种策略：让行场景（时间间隔>3s）提前轻柔减速至约1m/s低速；模糊不让行场景（1-3s）采用先主动减速后积极加速的两阶段策略；明确不让行场景（<1s）牺牲少量效率提前减速确保安全。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人车交互理解从二元让行/不让行拓展为连续的速度调节策略，揭示了驾驶员如何通过运动学信号实现安全与效率的平衡，丰富了微观交互行为理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自主驾驶汽车设计仿人运动学沟通策略提供实证依据，有助于AV更好地融入人类交通环境，提升人车交互的安全性和效率。

title: Price Discovery Leadership and Structural Fragility: Investment-Grade Credit Leads High Yield in the March 2020 Liquidity Crisis

detail.title: Price Discovery Leadership and Structural Fragility: Investment-Grade Credit Leads High Yield in the March 2020 Liquidity Crisis
detail.abstract: Applying the structural warming framework of Yun (2026b) to HYG (iShares iBoxx High Yield Corporate Bond ETF), we document a counter-intuitive lead-lag relationship in structural fragility: investment-grade credit (LQD) exhibits a spread volatility inflection 7 trading days before high yield credit (HYG) during the March 2020 liquidity crisis. LQD's structural warming signal begins February 24, 2020, with a 13-day lead over the March 9 limit-point bifurcation. HYG's signal begins February 28, with a 6-day lead. Both instruments snap on the same date. The finding is consistent with LQD's role as the price discovery venue for investment-grade credit (Yun, 2026a): the venue that carries the structural load of institutional hedging and flight-to-quality flow absorbs stress first. We also document a consistent 4x volatility ratio at the structural yield point across both instruments (LQD: 4.0x, HYG: 4.3x), suggesting a candidate universal threshold at which dealer intermediation fails regardless of credit quality. A methodological finding accompanies the empirical result: daily spread standard deviation is the correct structural signal for both instruments; daily maximum spread is contaminated by auction microstructure noise in HYG and unreliable as a fragility indicator.

AI.tldr: 本文运用Yun(2026b)的结构性升温框架分析高收益债ETF(HYG)，发现投资级信用债(LQD)在2020年3月流动性危机中比高收益债(HYG)提前7个交易日出现价差波动拐点，揭示了一个反直觉的领先-滞后关系。LQD的结构性信号于2020年2月24日开始，比3月9日的极限点分叉提前13天；HYG信号于2月28日开始，提前6天。两者在同一日期"折断"。文章还发现两个工具在结构性屈服点均存在一致的4倍价差波动率比率（LQD: 4.0x, HYG: 4.3x），暗示了一个跨信用质量的交易商中介失效的通用阈值。方法论上，每日价差标准差是正确信号，而每日最大价差受拍卖微观结构噪音污染。
AI.research_question: 在2020年3月流动性危机中，投资级信用债(LQD)与高收益债(HYG)在结构性脆弱性上是否存在领先-滞后关系？结构性升温信号在两类信用质量不同的工具间如何传导？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为高收益债更脆弱、应率先表现出压力信号，但本文发现一个反直觉的模式：投资级信用债(LQD)反而先于高收益债(HYG)出现结构性升温信号。这一发现挑战了对信用市场危机传导机制的既有认知。
AI.theoretical_framework: Yun(2026b)的结构性升温(structural warming)框架；Yun(2026a)关于投资级信用债作为价格发现场所的理论；极限点分叉(limit-point bifurcation)理论；交易商中介失效模型。
AI.method: 运用结构性升温框架分析LQD和HYG的价差时间序列数据；比较每日价差标准差与每日最大价差作为结构性信号的优劣；识别结构性屈服点(structural yield point)并计算波动率比率。
AI.findings: 1) LQD的价差波动拐点比HYG提前7个交易日出现；2) LQD的结构性升温信号始于2020年2月24日，比3月9日极限点分叉提前13天；HYG信号始于2月28日，提前6天；3) 两个工具在同一日期"折断"；4) LQD和HYG在结构性屈服点的波动率比率高度一致（4.0x vs 4.3x）；5) 每日价差标准差是可靠的信号，每日最大价差受噪音污染不适用于HYG。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了信用市场危机传导中反直觉的领先-滞后关系：投资级信用债先于高收益债承受结构性压力；2) 提出跨信用质量的通用屈服阈值（约4倍波动率比率），暗示交易商中介失效具有普遍性；3) 验证了投资级信用债作为机构对冲和逃向优质品流动的结构性负载承担者的理论角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为市场参与者提供信用危机早期预警信号：监控LQD而非HYG的结构性升温可更早识别系统性压力；2) 提供方法论指导：应使用每日价差标准差而非最大价差作为脆弱性指标；3) 4倍波动率比率可作为交易商中介失效的监测阈值，适用于不同信用质量资产。

title: The Paradox of Cooperative Migration Diplomacy in the Global South: Inter-Sending State Cooperation, Multilevel Diplomacy Strategies, and the Philippine State

detail.title: The Paradox of Cooperative Migration Diplomacy in the Global South: Inter-Sending State Cooperation, Multilevel Diplomacy Strategies, and the Philippine State
detail.abstract: How and why do sending states in the Global South cooperate under anarchy? Despite their significance, IR scholarship has largely overlooked the sending states' strategic logic and use of labor migration as a foreign policy tool. Using the Philippine state as a single case study, I argue that Global South sending states strategically manipulate complex interstate power dynamics to solidify inter-sending state coalitions and enhance bargaining power by employing multilevel cooperative diplomacy-bilateral (learning), multilateral (cooperation), and global (positioning). Methodologically, I employ semi-structured interviews (N = 15) with state and nonstate actors, process tracing, secondary sources, and decade-long field observations. Rather than viewing migration diplomacy as zero-sum, the Philippine state adopts a positive-sum, human-rights-centered migration diplomacy, fostering global coalition-building while pursuing material and ideational interests. Overall, this study advances IR debates on foreign policy and South-South labor migration by recentering the neglected inter-Global South-South sending-state migration cooperation in an anarchic international system. ¿Cómo y por qué cooperan los Estados emisores de personas migradas del Sur Global bajo condiciones de anarquía? A pesar de su importancia,

AI.tldr: 本文研究全球南方派遣国如何在无政府状态下开展移民外交合作。以菲律宾为案例，作者提出派遣国通过多层级合作外交——双边（学习）、多边（合作）和全球（定位）——操纵复杂的国家间权力动态，巩固派遣国间联盟并增强议价能力。菲律宾采取正和、以人权为中心的移民外交策略，推进全球联盟建设，同时追求物质和观念利益。研究重新关注了被忽视的南南派遣国间移民合作，推进了国际关系外交政策和南南劳务移民的辩论。
AI.research_question: 全球南方派遣国如何在无政府状态下合作？它们使用劳务移民作为外交政策工具的戰略逻辑是什么？
AI.motivation: 国际关系学术研究忽视了全球南方派遣国的战略逻辑，以及将劳务移民作为外交政策工具的使用。尽管劳务移民在全球南方国家外交中具有重要意义，但相关研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层级合作外交：双边（学习）、多边（合作）和全球（定位）；正和博弈、以人权为中心的移民外交；无政府状态下的国家合作理论。
AI.method: 单案例研究（菲律宾）；半结构化访谈（N=15，涉及国家和非国家行为体）；过程追踪；二手资料分析；长达十年的实地观察。
AI.findings: 全球南方派遣国通过多层级合作外交（双边学习、多边合作、全球定位）操纵复杂的国家间权力动态，巩固派遣国间联盟并增强议价能力。菲律宾采取正和、以人权为中心的移民外交，而非零和博弈，在追求物质和观念利益的同时推动全球联盟建设。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进国际关系外交政策和南南劳务移民辩论，重新关注被忽视的南南派遣国间移民合作；挑战了移民外交的零和博弈观点，提出正和移民外交框架；补充了无政府状态下全球南方国家合作理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方派遣国提供了移民外交策略参考，强调多层级合作外交和人权中心策略的有效性；对理解南南劳务移民合作机制具有政策启示。

title: Inequality, Business Cycles, and Growth: A Unified Theory of Fiscal Stabilization Policies
affiliations: Brown University and University of Mannheim

detail.title: Inequality, Business Cycles, and Growth: A Unified Theory of Fiscal Stabilization Policies
detail.abstract: Do tax-financed fiscal expansions entail a trade-off between short-run output stabilization and long-run growth? To answer this question, we develop a heterogeneous agent framework with nominal rigidities and endogenous growth. Analytically, we characterize three regimes with potentially opposing effects on output and technology growth, depending on systematic monetary policy and tax incidence. In the U.S., the quantitatively relevant regime features a robust tradeoff: a typical fiscal expansion, financed by higher tax progressivity, yields an impact output multiplier above one, a near-zero multiplier after three years, and sizable long-run output losses. Taxing the middle class avoids this trade-off and maximizes welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了税收融资的财政扩张是否会在短期产出稳定与长期增长之间产生权衡。通过构建包含名义刚性和内生增长的异质性主体框架，作者分析了三种不同体制，发现美国处于存在明显权衡的体制：提高税收累进性融资的财政扩张短期内产出乘数大于1，三年后接近零，长期则导致显著产出损失。对中产阶级征税可避免这一权衡并最大化福利。
AI.research_question: 税收融资的财政扩张是否会在短期产出稳定与长期增长之间产生权衡？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济学往往关注财政政策的短期稳定效应，但对其长期增长影响关注不足。本文旨在系统分析不同税收融资方式下财政扩张对短期产出和长期技术增长的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性主体模型、名义刚性、内生增长理论
AI.method: 构建包含异质性主体、名义刚性和内生增长的动态随机一般均衡模型，进行理论分析刻画三种体制，并对美国进行量化校准和数值模拟。
AI.findings: （1）根据货币政策系统和税收归宿的不同，存在三种对产出和技术增长有潜在相反影响的体制；（2）美国处于存在明显权衡的体制：提高累进性税收融资的财政扩张，短期产出乘数大于1，三年后接近零，长期产出出现显著损失；（3）对中产阶级征税可以避免这一权衡并最大化社会福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在统一框架中系统分析财政政策在短期稳定与长期增长之间的权衡机制，区分了三种不同体制，揭示了税收结构（累进性）在这一权衡中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：通过提高税收累进性为财政扩张融资会带来长期增长损失；对中产阶级增税可以兼顾短期稳定与长期增长，是更优的融资选择。

title: Propagation Risk and Structural Sensitivity in Supply Chain Networks
affiliations: University of Florida - Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering and University of Florida - Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering

detail.title: Propagation Risk and Structural Sensitivity in Supply Chain Networks

declarations.funderStatement: The authors acknowledge support from NSF award No. 2534856.

detail.abstract: This paper studies how productivity shocks propagate through a Cobb-Douglas supply-chain network with inventories and intermediate inputs. In the unconstrained economy, the aggregate response to a sectoral productivity shock is characterized by the standard Hulten-Domar effect. We introduce a constrained propagation framework in which one sector's output is fixed at its baseline level. The resulting expression shows that the constrained aggregate response equals the unconstrained effect minus the component transmitted through the constrained sector. This leads to a shock-specific bottleneck measure that identifies sectors acting as transmission channels, rather than merely as shock origins. We also derive the sensitivity of aggregate output to variations in input-output link weights in the unconstrained economy. We then apply the framework to BEA input-output data and show that constrained bottleneck rankings differ from standard sector-importance rankings. Combining these rankings with shock probabilities estimated from Fama-French industry returns yields a forward-looking sector-protection rule. The results suggest that constrained propagation and link sensitivity provide a tractable framework for supply-chain risk management.

AI.tldr: 本文研究生产率冲击如何通过带有库存和中间投入品的柯布-道格拉斯供应链网络传播，提出了一个约束传播框架，并应用于BEA投入产出数据，为供应链风险管理提供可操作的工具。
AI.research_question: 生产率冲击如何通过包含库存和中间投入品的供应链网络传播？在存在约束条件（某部门产出固定不变）的情况下，加总经济如何响应部门级冲击？
AI.motivation: 传统Hulten-Domar效应描述了无约束经济中部门冲击的加总响应，但现实经济中存在瓶颈和约束（如产能限制、供应链中断），亟需一个能刻画约束条件下冲击传播的理论框架，以改进供应链风险管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 柯布-道格拉斯生产函数、投入产出网络模型、Hulten-Domar定理、约束传播框架（constrained propagation framework）、瓶颈度量（bottleneck measure）、链接敏感性（link sensitivity）。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建包含库存和中间投入的柯布-道格拉斯供应链网络模型，推导无约束和约束条件下的加总响应表达式。实证应用：使用BEA投入产出数据，结合Fama-French行业收益率估计的冲击概率，进行瓶颈排名和部门保护规则分析。
AI.findings: 无约束经济中冲击响应遵循Hulten-Domar效应；约束条件下加总响应等于无约束效应减去通过受约束部门传导的部分。提出冲击特定的瓶颈度量，识别作为传输渠道的部门而非仅是冲击源头。约束瓶颈排名与标准部门重要性排名不同。结合冲击概率可推导出前瞻性的部门保护规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了约束传播框架，扩展了投入产出网络理论；推导了链接敏感性公式；区分了冲击源头与传播瓶颈的角色，为网络经济理论提供了新概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为供应链风险管理提供了可计算框架；基于BEA数据和Fama-French收益率的实证分析给出了具体的部门保护规则，有助于政策制定者和企业识别关键瓶颈部门。

title: Globalization, Borders, and the Limits of RTAs in Africa

detail.title: Globalization, Borders, and the Limits of RTAs in Africa
detail.abstract: This paper examines the dynamic trade effects of RTAs in Africa within the broader context of globalization. Using a dynamic gravity model that accounts for international borders and geographic factors, the results indicate that RTAs led to a 670% increase in intra-African trade over 45 years. However, when border-related frictions capturing the effects of globalization are included, the trade impact drops to 260%, supporting the view that the large average trade effects of RTAs in Africa cannot be explained by tariff reductions alone. The analysis also uncovers significant trade diversion effects when non-tariff barriers are considered, challenging the conventional view of RTAs as net welfare-enhancing in Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文利用动态引力模型，研究发现非洲区域贸易协定（RTAs）在45年间使区域内贸易增长670%，但纳入全球化相关的边境摩擦后，效应降至260%，且存在显著的贸易转移效应，挑战了RTAs净福利提升的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 非洲区域贸易协定（RTAs）在全球化背景下对区域内贸易的动态影响如何？
AI.motivation: 传统研究认为RTAs通过关税削减促进贸易，但非洲RTAs的贸易效应远高于预期，其背后的机制尚不明确。本文旨在区分关税削减与全球化（边境摩擦）对贸易效应的贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态引力模型，纳入国际边界和地理因素，控制全球化相关的边境摩擦效应。
AI.method: 动态引力模型（Dynamic Gravity Model）实证分析，涵盖45年面板数据。
AI.findings: （1）RTAs使非洲区域内贸易增长670%；（2）控制全球化边境摩擦后，效应降至260%；（3）存在显著的贸易转移效应，挑战RTAs净福利提升的传统观点。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了非洲RTAs的高贸易效应主要由全球化进程（边境摩擦下降）驱动，而非仅靠关税削减；发现非关税壁垒下的贸易转移效应，对传统RTA福利经济学理论提出修正。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲区域一体化政策制定提供实证依据，提示政策制定者应关注非关税壁垒和贸易转移风险，避免高估RTAs的福利效果。

title: Measuring Institutional Closure in Public Procurement: A Network-Based Index from European Buyer-Supplier Data
affiliations: , Aristotle University of Thessaloniki - Faculty of Medicine, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki and Aristotle University of Thessaloniki - Department of Economics

detail.title: Measuring Institutional Closure in Public Procurement: A Network-Based Index from European Buyer-Supplier Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available administrative data and does not involve human participants. No ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Public procurement systems generate detailed administrative records that capture how contracting authorities interact with suppliers over time.
