While most empirical work uses these data to study outcomes such as prices, participation, or efficiency, less attention has been paid to the structural patterns through which procurement systems sustain repeated buyer-supplier relationships across contracting cycles. We introduce the Institutional Closure Index (ICI), an authority-level structural indicator that identifies when procurement is both concentrated within a limited supplier base and stabilized through persistent, embedded authority-supplier ties. By integrating supplier concentration with relational persistence and embeddedness, the ICI captures configurations that standard concentration or participation metrics cannot detect in isolation. Applying the ICI to Tenders Electronic Daily (TED) award data for EU above-threshold procurement (2018-2022), we document strongly right-skewed and domain-specific patterns of closure. High-closure configurations are concentrated in particular procurement contexts and tend to arise as upper-tail phenomena within domains rather than as uniform system-wide regimes. These patterns emerge within formally open procurement frameworks, highlighting the distinction between procedural openness and the structural reproduction of supplier relationships. The ICI is designed as a descriptive monitoring tool rather than a performance score. It provides a comparative signal that can support governance and oversight by benchmarking authorities within procurement domains and identifying where stable and concentrated buyer-supplier configurations may warrant targeted, contextsensitive follow-up.

Code and data are publicly available at:

https://github.com/gallos3/institutional-closure-index 

https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20134493

AI.tldr: 本文提出制度封闭指数（ICI），通过整合供应商集中度与关系嵌入性，识别公共采购系统中重复性买卖关系的结构性封闭模式，并基于欧盟TED数据（2018-2022）揭示高封闭配置在特定采购领域呈现右偏分布的上尾现象。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个结构性指标来识别公共采购系统中持续且集中的买方-供应商关系模式？
AI.motivation: 现有实证研究多关注采购价格、参与率或效率，但忽视了采购系统通过重复性买卖关系维持结构性封闭的模式，而标准指标（如集中度或参与率）无法单独检测这些模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度封闭理论、关系嵌入性理论、供应商集中度与关系持久性整合分析框架。
AI.method: 构建制度封闭指数（ICI），整合供应商集中度与关系持久性/嵌入性；基于欧盟Tenders Electronic Daily（TED）2018-2022年门槛以上采购数据进行实证应用。
AI.findings: ICI呈强烈右偏分布且具有领域特异性；高封闭配置集中在特定采购领域，表现为领域内的上尾现象，而非统一的系统范围制度；这些模式在形式上公开的采购框架内出现，凸显程序开放性与结构关系再生产之间的区别。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出ICI作为新的结构性指标，弥补了现有集中度或参与率指标无法单独检测的封闭性配置；揭示了形式上公开的采购框架下仍存在结构性关系再生产机制。
AI.practical_contributions: ICI可作为描述性监测工具，通过领域内基准比较支持治理与监督，识别需要针对性跟进的高封闭配置区域。

title: Immigration Generations and Perceptions of American Courts: Unpacking Complex Generational Effects

detail.title: Immigration Generations and Perceptions of American Courts: Unpacking Complex Generational Effects
detail.abstract: Immigrant perspectives on the criminal justice system have garnered significant scholarly interest in recent years. Yet, the trust levels of different generations of immigrants in American courts remain inadequately explored. Utilising data from the General Social Survey 2018, this study compares the levels of trust in American courts and confidence in the United States (U.S.) Supreme Court among first-, second-, and third-generation immigrants with those of the native-born group. The analysis considers several control variables, such as institutional confidence, general trust, attitudes towards penalties, and demographics. Findings reveal that firstgeneration immigrants exhibit greater trust in American courts than native-born individuals. Meanwhile, second-generation immigrants display lower confidence in the U.S. Supreme Court compared to their third-generation immigrant and native-born counterparts. All control variables influenced trust in American courts. Confidence in Congress and television, trust in people, age, and educational attainment impacted confidence in the U.S. Supreme Court. Finally, holding immigrant generations constant, Blacks expressed lower trust in American courts and less confidence in the U.S. Supreme Court than Whites, Hispanics, and Asians, and Asians demonstrated lower confidence in the U.S. Supreme Court relative to Whites and Hispanics.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2018年综合社会调查数据，比较了不同代际移民（第一、二、三代）与美国本土出生人群对美国法院和最高法院的信任水平。发现第一代移民比本土出生者更信任美国法院，而第二代移民对最高法院的信心低于第三代移民和本土出生者。种族差异显著：黑人的信任度最低，亚裔对最高法院的信心低于白人和西班牙裔。
AI.research_question: 不同代际移民（第一、二、三代）与美国本土出生人群在信任美国法院和对美国最高法院信心方面是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 尽管移民对刑事司法系统的观点已引起学界关注，但不同代际移民对美国法院的信任水平仍未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际移民理论、制度信任理论
AI.method: 使用2018年综合社会调查（General Social Survey）数据，进行代际比较分析，控制变量包括制度信心、一般信任、对惩罚的态度和人口统计学变量。
AI.findings: 1. 第一代移民比本土出生者更信任美国法院。2. 第二代移民对最高法院的信心低于第三代移民和本土出生者。3. 控制变量均影响对美国法院的信任；对国会和电视的信心、对人的信任、年龄和教育程度影响对最高法院的信心。4. 黑人的信任度低于白人、西班牙裔和亚裔；亚裔对最高法院的信心低于白人和西班牙裔。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同代际移民在司法信任上的异质性，弥补了代际视角下的法院信任研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解移民群体与司法系统的信任关系提供实证依据，有助于针对不同代际和种族群体制定差异化的司法沟通与信任建设策略。

title: Creative Destruction after the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami: Evidence from the Maldives
affiliations: University of Bologna - Department of Economics and University of Bologna - Department of Economics

detail.title: Creative Destruction after the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami: Evidence from the Maldives
detail.abstract: We study the long-run macroeconomic effects of the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami in the Maldives (1995-2019). After an initial GDP contraction of about 9%, the economy not only recovered but steadily exceeded its pre-disaster path, indicating a sustainable recovery beyond pre-tsunami trends (+50% in 2011-2019). In the long run, the economy grows monotonically faster, consistent with a creative-destruction process (+5.2 p.p.). Tourism-sector evidence shows persistent increases in receipts per arrival without comparable growth in tourist volumes, suggesting quality upgrading rather than scale expansion. These findings support build-back-better reconstruction policies as drivers of sustained post-disaster development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究2004年印度洋海啸对马尔代夫的长期宏观经济影响（1995-2019年），发现经济不仅从约9%的GDP初始收缩中恢复，而且持续超越灾前趋势（2011-2019年高出50%），表现为创造性破坏过程带来的长期更快增长（+5.2个百分点），旅游业证据显示质量升级而非规模扩张，支持"重建得更好"政策作为灾后持续发展的驱动力。
AI.research_question: 2004年印度洋海啸对马尔代夫的长期宏观经济效应是什么？经济是否实现可持续复苏并超越灾前趋势？
AI.motivation: 大灾后经济能否实现长期可持续增长是一个重要但研究不足的问题，本文利用马尔代夫这一独特案例，结合长达25年的数据，检验"重建得更好"假说是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创造性破坏理论（creative destruction）——灾难摧毁旧资本存量后，重建过程采用更先进技术，推动生产率和经济增长加速。
AI.method: 基于马尔代夫1995-2019年的宏观经济数据，采用事件研究法和反事实分析，比较灾后GDP实际路径与模拟的灾前趋势路径，并进行旅游业微观数据的机制检验。
AI.findings: （1）GDP初始收缩约9%，但随后持续超越灾前趋势，2011-2019年高出约50%；（2）长期增长率持续加快，比趋势高出5.2个百分点；（3）旅游业人均收入持续增长，但游客数量增长有限，表明是质量升级而非规模扩张。
AI.theory_contributions: 为创造性破坏理论提供了来自自然灾难场景的长期宏观证据；将"重建得更好"政策与创造性破坏机制联系起来，拓展了灾难经济学的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为灾后重建政策提供实证支持——"重建得更好"策略能驱动可持续的长期发展；提示政策制定者应关注重建中的质量升级（如旅游业升级）而非简单恢复原有规模。

title: The Challenges of Blockchain Arbitration from a Private International Law Perspective
affiliations: Public University of Navarra (UPNA)

detail.title: The Challenges of Blockchain Arbitration from a Private International Law Perspective
detail.abstract: This paper aims to explore the emergence of Blockchain Arbitration and the legal challenges it poses from a private international law perspective. It examines the legal implications of this new type of arbitration, its feasibility under international regulatory frameworks (including the European Union, the United States and the 1958 New York Convention), and assesses leading decentralised justice platforms such as Kleros, Aragon and Jur. The study highlights the fundamental differences between blockchain arbitration and traditional arbitration, identifying challenges such as the absence of a seat, the anonymity of parties and arbitrators, and the tension between decentralisation and legal oversight. Finally, it explores future trends and proposes recommendations to adapt existing regulatory frameworks, concluding that while blockchain arbitration will not replace classical arbitration in the short term, it could establish itself as a valuable complement to resolve disputes in the global digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文从国际私法视角探讨区块链仲裁的兴起及其法律挑战，分析其在欧盟、美国及《纽约公约》框架下的可行性，评估Kleros、Aragon、Jur等去中心化平台，指出其与传统仲裁的根本差异（如缺乏仲裁地、当事人与仲裁员匿名性、去中心化与法律监管的张力），并提出未来趋势与监管建议，认为区块链仲裁短期内不会取代传统仲裁，但可成为全球数字经济争议解决的有益补充。
AI.research_question: 从国际私法视角，区块链仲裁面临哪些法律挑战？其在国际监管框架下的可行性如何？
AI.motivation: 随着区块链技术和去中心化争议解决平台的发展，区块链仲裁作为一种新兴机制出现，但其法律地位和与传统仲裁体系的兼容性尚未得到充分研究，亟需从国际私法角度进行系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际私法理论、仲裁法理论（包括《纽约公约》框架）、去中心化治理理论
AI.method: 规范性法律分析、比较法研究（欧盟、美国及《纽约公约》框架）、案例研究（Kleros、Aragon、Jur平台评估）
AI.findings: 区块链仲裁与传统仲裁存在根本差异，面临缺乏仲裁地、当事人与仲裁员匿名性、以及去中心化与法律监管之间的张力等核心挑战；区块链仲裁短期内不会取代传统仲裁，但可作为全球数字经济争议解决的有益补充。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统识别并分析了区块链仲裁在国际私法框架下的法律挑战，丰富了去中心化争议解决的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供了适应现有监管框架的调整建议，为区块链仲裁平台的设计与运营提供了法律合规参考。

title: Financial Well-being and Inclusion of Justice Involved Populations: Evidence from the SHED
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System,  and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Financial Well-being and Inclusion of Justice Involved Populations: Evidence from the SHED

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-024, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.024]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This study examines financial challenges faced by justice-involved individuals using 2023-2024 Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking data. Individuals with justice system contact experience substantially worse financial outcomes than those without criminal records, with disparities widening by severity of involvement. Compared to individuals with no prior records, those arrested but not convicted are 4 percentage points less likely to report doing at least okay financially, while formerly convicted as well as incarcerated adults are 15 percentage points less likely. Formerly incarcerated individuals are also 21 percentage points less likely to have credit scores above 660 and 13 percentage points less likely to have credit cards. These disparities mirror patterns observed across education levels, where adults with lower educational attainment experience lower financial well-being and inclusion. Our findings document substantial barriers to financial stability among justice-involved populations and may inform policies promoting financial inclusion and improving economic outcomes for this group.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2023-2024年美国家庭经济与决策调查数据，发现有过司法系统接触经历的个体（尤其是曾被监禁者）在财务状况、信用评分和信用卡持有等方面显著差于无犯罪记录者，且差距随司法接触程度加深而扩大，类似教育水平差异带来的金融不平等。
AI.research_question: 司法系统接触经历如何影响个体的财务状况和金融包容性？
AI.motivation: 司法涉入群体面临的经济困难已被广泛关注，但缺乏基于最新全国性代表性数据的系统量化分析，尤其是按司法接触严重程度（被捕但未定罪、曾被定罪、曾被监禁）进行细分比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、社会分层与刑事司法系统交叉理论、劳动力市场歧视理论。
AI.method: 基于2023-2024年美国家庭经济与决策调查（SHED）数据，采用描述性统计和对比分析方法，比较不同司法接触程度群体的财务结果，并与教育水平维度的差异进行类比。
AI.findings: （1）与无犯罪记录者相比，被捕但未定罪者报告财务状况至少"尚可"的概率低4个百分点；曾被定罪及曾被监禁者低15个百分点。（2）曾被监禁者信用评分高于660的概率低21个百分点，持有信用卡的概率低13个百分点。（3）司法接触带来的金融差异模式与不同教育水平群体间的差异模式相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"刑事司法污名化"如何转化为经济排斥提供了最新的量化证据，将司法系统接触视为一种类似教育水平的、影响金融福祉的社会分层机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果可为促进司法涉入群体金融包容性的政策制定提供实证依据，如改善信用获取渠道、提供金融服务可及性等。

title: Double Descent and Benign Overfitting in Macroeconomic Forecasting
affiliations: Queen Mary, University of London, University of Salzburg and Brandeis University - International Business School

detail.title: Double Descent and Benign Overfitting in Macroeconomic Forecasting
detail.abstract: We study double descent and benign overfitting in macroeconomic forecasting. We document that double-descent risk curves arise in standard macroeconomic datasets that are driven by a small number of latent factors, and we characterize when the underlying benign-overfitting mechanism holds. The conditions of Bartlett et al. (2020) are satisfied under the exact factor model and can also hold under the more realistic approximate factor model, provided idiosyncratic variances are not too dispersed across series. Because macroeconomic panels have only moderate dimensions, the overparameterization ratio N/T required by the theory is not naturally available. Our solution is to augment the data with synthetic copies from an estimated factor model and we prove that this strategy converges to a kernel ridge regression with a factorstructured kernel. Using monthly (FRED-MD) and quarterly (FRED-QD) US data, the resulting estimator consistently outperforms the Stock-Watson factor model for point forecasting across all series and horizons, with gains that are pervasive, statistically significant, and increasing with the forecast horizon. Our results suggest that benign overfitting, when it works, succeeds because overparameterization implicitly constructs a well-behaved kernel, not because overparameterization is intrinsically desirable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了宏观经济预测中的双重下降与良性过拟合现象，发现当数据由少数潜在因子驱动时会出现双下降风险曲线。通过用估计因子模型生成的合成数据扩充样本，该方法在FRED-MD和FRED-QD数据集上持续优于Stock-Watson因子模型，且改进随预测期增长而扩大。研究表明良性过拟合成功的关键在于过参数化隐式构造了一个良好性质的核，而非过参数化本身值得追求。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济预测中是否出现双重下降和良性过拟合现象？在何种条件下成立？如何解决宏观经济面板维度有限导致的过参数化比率不足问题？
AI.motivation: 宏观经济数据通常维度适中（N/T比率不高），传统上认为过参数化在此场景下不可行。但若良性过拟合现象也能在宏观经济预测中发挥作用，则可通过新的估计策略提升预测精度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重下降（Double Descent）、良性过拟合（Benign Overfitting）、因子模型（精确因子模型与近似因子模型）、核岭回归（Kernel Ridge Regression）
AI.method: 理论分析验证Bartlett et al. (2020)条件在精确/近似因子模型下的适用性；提出用估计因子模型生成合成数据扩充样本，使过参数化比率N/T满足理论要求；使用FRED-MD（月度）和FRED-QD（季度）美国宏观数据进行实证评估。
AI.findings: 双重下降在因子结构宏观数据中确实出现；Bartlett条件在精确因子模型下完全满足，在近似因子模型下当 idiosyncratic 方差不过度分散时也成立；数据扩增策略等价于因子结构化核的核岭回归；该策略在所有序列和预测期上持续、显著优于Stock-Watson因子模型，且优势随预测期延长而增大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在宏观经济预测背景下系统验证双重下降和良性过拟合的理论条件；证明数据扩增策略收敛于因子结构化核的核岭回归，揭示了良性过拟合的本质是通过过参数化隐式构造良好核，而非过参数化本身。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实用且有效的宏观经济预测方法，通过合成数据扩增提升预测精度；在标准美国宏观数据集（FRED-MD和FRED-QD）上证明了该方法的普遍适用性，且改进随预测期延长而增加，对中期和长期预测有重要价值。

title: The Effect of the Federal Reserve on the Stock Market: Magnitudes, Channels and Shocks
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: The Effect of the Federal Reserve on the Stock Market: Magnitudes, Channels and Shocks

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-023, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.023]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We survey and extend work on the Federal Reserve’s effect on the stock market, focusing on three empirical findings: The effect of monetary policy surprises in a narrow window around announcements from the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the pre-FOMC announcement drift, and the FOMC cycle in stock returns. We discuss the magnitude of the Fed’s impact (directional effects or effects on average stock returns), the types of shocks coming from the Fed (pure monetary policy shocks, reaction function news, or information about the Fed’s view of the economy), and the asset pricing channels through which effects emerge (an equity premia for news from the Fed, or changes to yields, equity premia, or expected dividends). We also consider the information transmission (communication) channels. The Fed’s effect on the stock market is large, even for average stock returns earned over periods of several decades. Fed-induced changes to both yields and equity premia play substantial roles, with less direct evidence available regarding cash flows. For stocks, reaction function news appears to be more important than Fed information effects. Communication flows outside announcements windows are important.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了美联储对股市影响的三大实证发现：FOMC公告窗口内的货币政策冲击效应、公告前漂移以及FOMC周期效应。研究发现美联储对股市影响显著，甚至体现在数十年的平均回报中；收益率和股权溢价的变化是主要传导渠道；反应函数新闻比信息效应更重要；非公告窗口的沟通也是重要渠道。
AI.research_question: 美联储如何影响股票市场？其影响的幅度、传导渠道和机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量文献研究货币政策对股市的影响，但缺乏一个系统性的综述来整合不同的实证发现（公告窗口冲击、公告前漂移、FOMC周期效应），并厘清影响的传导机制和信息渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涉及资产定价理论（收益率、股权溢价、预期股利的贴现率模型）、货币政策传导机制理论（利率渠道、信号渠道）、信息经济学（信息效应 vs 反应函数新闻）。
AI.method: 文献综述与系统整合，对现有实证研究进行梳理、分类和比较分析。
AI.findings: (1) 美联储对股市影响巨大，甚至体现于数十年长期平均回报；(2) 收益率和股权溢价变化是主要传导渠道，现金流证据较少；(3) 反应函数新闻比美联储信息效应更重要；(4) 非公告窗口的沟通同样重要；三大实证现象（公告窗口冲击、公告前漂移、FOMC周期效应）共同构成了美联储影响股市的完整图景。
AI.theory_contributions: 为货币政策与资产定价交叉领域的理论整合提供了系统性框架，区分了不同性质的冲击（纯货币政策冲击、反应函数新闻、信息效应）和不同传导渠道（收益率、股权溢价、预期股利）。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者理解FOMC公告前后的市场行为、优化交易策略有指导意义；对央行沟通策略设计（尤其是非窗口期沟通的重要性）提供政策启示。

title: The Returns to Regulatory Redundancy: Evidence from Tobacco 21
affiliations: Miami University of Ohio - Richard T. Farmer School of Business Administration, University of Missouri - Department of Economics and

detail.title: The Returns to Regulatory Redundancy: Evidence from Tobacco 21

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflicts of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper uses publicly available survey data.
declarations.funderStatement: Research reported in this publication was supported by the National Institute On Drug Abuse of the National Institutes of Health under Award Number R01DA045016 and by the National Cancer Institute and Food and Drug Administration Center for Tobacco Products under Award Number U54CA229974. The content is solely the responsibility of the authors and does not necessarily represent the official views of the National Institutes of Health or the Food and Drug Administration.

detail.abstract: We consider the impact of state laws that prohibit conduct already barred under federal law. In particular, we examine the effectiveness of state minimum legal sales laws for tobacco, or tobacco 21 laws, implemented after the federal T21 law in December 2019. Using difference-in-differences modeling that exploits the staggered implementation of tobacco 21 legislation (T21) in 28 states after 2019, we find that these state T21 laws consistently have little to no effect on smoking and vaping among adults ages 18 to 20, nor for high school youth. Our findings indicate that state T21 laws offer little marginal benefit under a unified federal T21 regime. We discuss voluntary compliance as a likely explanation for these findings.

AI.tldr: 联邦T21法案实施后，各州自行制定的T21法律对减少18-20岁青少年吸烟和电子烟使用几乎没有额外效果，可能原因是自愿遵守程度有限。
AI.research_question: 在联邦法案已禁止向21岁以下人群销售烟草的基础上，各州自行实施的T21法律是否能带来额外的边际效果？
AI.motivation: 联邦T21法案于2019年12月生效后，仍有28个州陆续实施州级T21法律。这些州级法律是否能在联邦法律之上进一步减少青少年吸烟和 vaping 行为，是一个重要的政策评估问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联邦制下的政策叠加效应与边际收益递减理论，探讨州级法律在已有联邦禁令下的额外合规效果。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），利用2019年后28个州交错实施T21法律的自然实验设计。
AI.findings: 州级T21法律对18-20岁成年人及高中青少年的吸烟和电子烟使用几乎没有影响，边际收益几近为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在已有联邦禁令的情况下，州级叠加法律的边际效应趋于零；提供了"自愿遵守"机制作为解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要参考：在联邦统一禁令下，各州额外立法可能资源浪费；应更多关注执行与合规而非重复立法。

title: Automating Evidence Synthesis: A Comparative Evaluation of Large Language Models for Data Extraction
affiliations: Asian Development Bank, Asian Development Bank and Asian Development Bank

detail.title: Automating Evidence Synthesis: A Comparative Evaluation of Large Language Models for Data Extraction

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 845
publicationDetails.journalName: ADB Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Systematic reviews and meta-analyses (SRMAs) are important tools for evidence synthesis but have historically required substantial manual effort, particularly during the data extraction phase. To address this bottleneck, we developed and evaluated an automated pipeline that utilizes large language models (LLMs) to ingest full text scientific articles and extract structured metadata. We benchmarked the performance of leading models, including Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-5, and Sonnet 4.0, across two distinct domains: mobile health interventions and education. Our results indicate that Gemini 2.5 Pro achieved the strongest performance in qualitative metadata extraction and outcome identification. However, quantitative metadata extraction remained a significant challenge. Models struggled to interpret complex data across multiple tables and failed to calculate effect sizes when only raw figures were reported. Crucially, we find that human annotators often applied implicit filtering criteria not documented in the coding manual, which made benchmarking the results challenging. We discuss the implications of these findings, emphasizing that while LLMs can accelerate the coding process, reliable automation requires significantly more prescriptive coding manuals to strictly steer model behavior and ensure fair benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 本文开发和评估了一个利用大语言模型（LLM）从科学文献全文中自动提取结构化元数据的流水线，发现Gemini 2.5 Pro在定性提取上表现最佳，但定量提取仍面临挑战；同时发现人类编码员存在隐性过滤标准，强调了需要更规范的编码手册来指导模型行为和确保公平基准测试。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型自动化系统综述和荟萃分析中的数据提取阶段？不同LLM在定性和定量元数据提取上的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 系统综述和荟萃分析（SRMAs）是证据综合的重要工具，但传统上需要大量人工投入，尤其数据提取阶段是主要瓶颈。因此需要开发自动化方法提高效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大语言模型（LLM）在结构化信息提取中的应用；系统综述和荟萃分析的方法论框架。
AI.method: 开发自动化流水线，利用LLM（Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-5、Sonnet 4.0）从全文科学文献中提取结构化元数据，在移动健康干预和教育两个领域进行基准测试。
AI.findings: 1) Gemini 2.5 Pro在定性元数据提取和结果识别上表现最佳；2) 定量元数据提取仍面临重大挑战，模型难以解释多表格中的复杂数据，且无法在仅报告原始数据时计算效应量；3) 人类编码员常应用编码手册中未记录的隐性过滤标准，给基准测试带来困难。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了LLM在科学文献自动化提取中的能力边界，特别是在定量数据提取方面的局限性；发现并阐述了人类编码员隐性过滤标准对基准测试的干扰问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为系统综述和荟萃分析的自动化提供了可行的LLM流水线方案；提出需要更规范的编码手册来引导模型行为和确保公平评估，为未来自动化工具的设计提供了实践指导。

title: The Origins of American Counties. Part III: The Southern States

detail.title: The Origins of American Counties. Part III: The Southern States
detail.abstract:
Part III: This is the third of five papers of a book in progress, "The Origins of American Counties: A Fifty-State Tour of the History and Perseverance of America's Least Understood Local Governments." For a full introduction, see Part I, "Theory and New England." My book explains why counties were formed in a complex dance between localities that wanted to be a county seat and state legislatures eager to control their territory, and then frozen within rigid configurations in the twentieth century. My method is to examine in detail the historical origins of the two smallest counties-by land area and by modern population-in each state. These represent the main problems that modern observers see in counties: underpopulated rural counties and urban counties that do not encompass their metropolitan areas. 

The South consists of those states where slavery was legal up to the Civil War. Slavery and its plantation legacy engendered pervasive state control, largely administered by county governments, which discouraged other forms of local government. Post-Civil War reformers attempted to establish Northern-style townships, but they were discarded after Reconstruction, replaced in most cases by the unimportant "magisterial districts." Because the dominant political interests were rural plantation owners, obtaining the county seat was less important than establishing a county for state representation. Counties rather than cities command the loyalties of Southerners The northeast-to-southwest order in which the sixteen southern states are discussed is Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, West Virginia, Kentucky, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Mississippi, Louisiana, Texas, Arkansas, and Missouri.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国南方各州县级政府的起源与演变，指出奴隶制和种植园遗产导致了以县为中心的强州控制体系，县而非城市主导了南方人的政治忠诚。通过研究各州最小县（面积和人口）的历史起源，揭示了当代县制面临的核心问题。
AI.research_question: 美国南方各州的县是如何形成的？为什么县而非城市成为南方地方政府的主导形式？当代美国的县制面临哪些困境？
AI.motivation: 解释美国县制这一"最不被理解的地方政府"的起源和韧性问题，特别是南方县制的独特性及其成因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度主义、地方-州府博弈理论、制度冻结理论；南方治理的种植园遗产理论
AI.method: 历史分析法，选取每州面积最小和现代人口最少的两个县进行详细历史起源考察，涵盖从特拉华到密苏里的16个南方州。
AI.findings: 南方县制源于奴隶制和种植园经济对强州控制的需求，由县级政府执行州级治理；内战后的乡镇制改革在重建时期后被废弃；南方人的政治忠诚主要归属于县而非城市；获取县府所在地不如建立县以获取州代表权重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了以城市为中心的美国地方政府研究范式，揭示了制度路径依赖（种植园遗产→强县制→制度冻结）的长期影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代美国县制困境（人口稀疏的农村县与无法涵盖都市区的城市县）提供了历史根源分析，有助于重新评估美国地方治理改革方向。

title: Informality and Patronalism in Mexico: A Theoretical Sketch and Background Material for the Political Capitalisms Project

detail.title: Informality and Patronalism in Mexico: A Theoretical Sketch and Background Material for the Political Capitalisms Project
detail.abstract: This study applies the Magyar-Madlovics theoretical framework of patronal politics to the Mexican case, extending the analysis beyond its original post-communist scope to examine how informal patronal networks operate in Latin American contexts. While both post-communist and Latin American regions exhibit significant informal and patronal relations that shape political and economic outcomes, their historical starting points differ fundamentally. The post-communist region experienced the collapse of state socialism and subsequent privatization processes, while Latin America developed through colonial legacies, oligarchic capitalism, and negotiated transitions from authoritarianism. This study examines Mexico's federal and subnational political dynamics from approximately the 1970s to the present, analyzing how patronal networks function across different territorial levels and interact with formal political institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文将Magyar-Madlovics的庇护政治理论框架从后共产主义语境拓展至墨西哥案例，分析1970年代至今墨西哥联邦与次国家级层面的庇护网络运作机制及其与正式政治制度的互动。
AI.research_question: 后共产主义语境下形成的庇护政治理论框架能否有效解释墨西哥的政治现实？墨西哥的庇护网络如何在联邦与次国家级层面运作，并与正式政治制度互动？
AI.motivation: 后共产主义与拉丁美洲地区虽然都存在显著的庇护关系，但历史起点截然不同。现有研究缺乏将庇护政治理论从后共产主义语境拓展至拉美地区的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: Magyar-Madlovics庇护政治理论框架
AI.method: 案例研究，对墨西哥联邦与次国家级政治动态的历史分析（约1970年代至今）
AI.findings: 尚未在摘要中明确呈现，论文主要分析庇护网络在不同地域层级上的运作方式及其与正式制度的互动。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Magyar-Madlovics庇护政治理论框架从后共产主义语境拓展至拉丁美洲（墨西哥）语境，检验该理论的跨区域适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解墨西哥及其他拉美国家中非正式庇护网络如何影响政治经济运作，为分析正式制度与非正式政治之间的互动提供分析工具。

title: I Don't Recall: Information and the Governance Tradeoffs in Securities Lending
affiliations: University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration

detail.title: I Don't Recall: Information and the Governance Tradeoffs in Securities Lending
detail.abstract: Institutional investors are commonly viewed as facing a tradeoff between revenue and voting power when lending shares. However, lending also generates valuable voting information via the borrowing demand of informed short sellers.  I develop a model in which lenders trade off revenue, voting power, and information, and derive novel implications for corporate governance. Contrary to conventional wisdom, expected firm value can suffer when lenders recall shares to cast extra votes, since doing so discourages borrowing ex-ante and thereby reduces the informativeness of those votes; the key governance tradeoff is between a larger number of less informed votes and a smaller number of more informed votes. Thus, share lending and voting are not necessarily substitutes — they can also be complementary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机构投资者在出借股票时面临的收益、投票权与信息三者之间的权衡，发现出借股票产生的投票信息（通过卖空者的借券需求）能提高投票质量，因此投票与出借并非简单的替代关系，而可能具有互补性。
AI.research_question: 机构投资者在出借股票时，如何在收益、投票权与信息之间进行权衡？这一权衡对公司治理有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为机构投资者在出借股票时面临收益与投票权的替代关系，但忽视了出借行为本身能通过知情卖空者的借券需求产生有价值的投票信息。作者旨在重新审视这一权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个模型，其中出借者需要在收益、投票权与信息三者之间进行权衡。核心理论逻辑是：出借股票产生的信息可以提升投票的知情度，从而影响公司治理效率。
AI.method: 理论建模分析
AI.findings: （1）当出借者召回股票以增加投票时，反而可能降低公司价值，因为这会抑制事前的借券需求，减少投票的信息含量；（2）公司治理的关键权衡在于：是拥有更多但信息含量较低的投票，还是更少但信息含量更高的投票；（3）股票出借与投票不一定是替代关系，也可能是互补关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统"出借与投票是替代关系"的观点，提出了信息渠道作为连接出借与投票的新机制，丰富了代理理论和公司治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者的投票行为和股票出借决策提供了新的理论指导；对监管机构理解卖空机制与公司治理的关系具有启示意义。

title: Price-Segmented Beliefs and the U.S. Housing Boom
affiliations: Federal Reserve Board

detail.title: Price-Segmented Beliefs and the U.S. Housing Boom

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-022, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.022]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper shows that expected capital gains in several MSAs were higher for relatively lower-priced, rather than higher-priced, houses during the U.S. boom of the 2000s. Because buyers of lower-priced houses tend to be more sensitive to credit conditions than buyers of higher-priced houses, this paper documents patterns that are consistent with an interaction of beliefs and loose credit conditions in a time period where direct evidence on house price beliefs is scarce. Documenting this interaction is important for unifying beliefs and credit conditions as joint, instead of competing, explanations for the U.S. housing boom of the 2000s.

AI.tldr: 本文发现2000年代美国房地产繁荣期间，低价房预期资本收益高于高价房，这与信贷宽松和信念的交互作用一致，为统一两大解释框架提供了证据。
AI.research_question: 2000年代美国房地产繁荣期间，不同价格水平房屋的预期资本收益是否存在系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 直接证据稀缺，而关于房价上涨的"信念说"与"信贷宽松说"长期被视作竞争性解释，需要经验证据加以统一。
AI.theoretical_framework: 购房者信贷敏感度异质性理论：低价房购房者对信贷条件更敏感；信念与信贷条件的互动机制。
AI.method: 基于多个MSA（大都市统计区）房价数据的实证分析，比较不同价位房屋的预期资本收益率。
AI.findings: 在2000年代繁荣期，多个MSA中低价房的预期资本收益显著高于高价房。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"信念"和"信贷条件"从竞争性解释统一为联合解释机制，为理解资产泡沫提供了整合性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 启示政策制定者：房地产市场监管需同时关注信贷扩张与市场信念的自我实现效应，避免单一政策视角的局限性。

title: Informality and Patronalism in the Regimes of the Middle East: A Theoretical Sketch and Background Material for the Political Capitalisms Project

detail.title: Informality and Patronalism in the Regimes of the Middle East: A Theoretical Sketch and Background Material for the Political Capitalisms Project
detail.abstract:
This study extends the Magyar–Madlovics theory of patronal autocracy beyond its original post-communist scope by developing a typology of patronal autocracies based on distinct forms of political legitimation. Challenging the mainstream comparative paradigm, the analysis departs from three implicit axioms of liberal-democratic political science: the presumed separation of political, economic, and communal spheres; the coincidence of formal and informal power positions; and the assumption of the state as an actor oriented toward the public interest. By dissolving these axioms, the study conceptualizes patronal autocracy as a regime type organized around informal patron–client hierarchies that structure power across institutional boundaries.

Building on Max Weber’s classical typology of legitimacy, the paper argues that patronal autocracies cannot be adequately understood through a single legitimating logic. In addition to substantive rational legitimation—identified in post-communist contexts—the analysis introduces traditionally legitimated and charismatic-theocratic variants of patronal autocracy. On this basis, the study distinguishes three ideal-typical forms: (1) traditionally legitimated patronal autocracies, exemplified by the Gulf monarchies; (2) charismatic-theocratic patronal autocracy, represented by the Islamic Republic of Iran; and (3) substantive rational patronal autocracies, encompassing both post-communist “mafia states” and military-bureaucratic regimes.

The proposed typology strengthens the explanatory power of the patronal autocracy framework by demonstrating its universal applicability across regions with divergent historical, cultural, and institutional backgrounds. Rather than treating Middle Eastern and post-communist regimes as analytically exceptional, the study situates them within a unified conceptual space, showing how different legitimating foundations shape the institutional carriers, normative status, and operational logic of patronal rule.

AI.tldr: 本研究将Magyar–Madlovics的庇护威权主义理论从后共产主义语境拓展至全球范围，基于韦伯的合法性类型学构建了三种庇护威权主义理想型：传统型（海湾君主国）、魅力-神权型（伊朗伊斯兰共和国）与实质理性型（后共产主义"黑手党国家"及军事官僚体制）。
AI.research_question: 庇护威权主义如何超越后共产主义语境，在不同合法性基础下呈现多样化形态？
AI.motivation: 现有庇护威权主义理论局限于后共产主义区域，缺乏对不同历史文化背景下威权体制的系统比较框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Magyar–Madlovics的庇护威权主义理论；Max Weber的三种合法性类型学（传统型、魅力型、法理型/实质理性型）。
AI.method: 理论建构与类型学分析，通过批判自由民主政治学的三个隐性公理（政治-经济-社会领域分离、正式与非正式权力重合、国家作为公共利益行动者），重新概念化庇护威权体制。
AI.findings: 区分出三种庇护威权主义理想型：传统合法性型（海湾君主国）、魅力-神权型（伊朗）、实质理性型（后共产主义"黑手党国家"与军事官僚体制）。不同类型的合法性基础塑造了庇护统治的制度载体、规范地位与运作逻辑。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了庇护威权主义理论的适用边界，将中东与后共产主义政体纳入统一分析框架；证明了该理论具有跨区域、跨文化的普遍解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解不同合法性基础下的威权统治运作机制提供了分类工具，有助于更精准地分析威权体制的韧性与演变路径。

title: Local Efficiency and Cross-Sectional Predictability: The Information Aggregation Wedge
affiliations: McGill University

detail.title: Local Efficiency and Cross-Sectional Predictability: The Information Aggregation Wedge

keywords: Bayesian learning I gratefully acknowledge financial support from McGill University

detail.abstract: Local efficiency need not imply cross-sectional efficiency. I study economies where each firm is priced rationally under local information and public cross-sectional signals. Unless aggregation is perfect, dispersed learning about a common state leaves residual Bayesian filter errors. Expected excess returns are zero under local pricing filtrations, but proportional to this information aggregation wedge under the pooled cross-section. Because observable characteristics proxy for these errors, book-to-market, profitability, investment, and past returns predict returns without being risk premia or behavioral mistakes. This single wedge explains why anomalies have a strong factor structure, why firms migrate across value and growth portfolios, why value operates primarily within industries, why anomaly returns concentrate on news days, and why the Security Market Line appears flat. Characteristic arbitrage cannot make prices cross-sectionally efficient; only perfect aggregation can-but perfect aggregation destroys the dispersed learning that generates predictability.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在分散信息学习的经济中，即使每个企业在本地信息下被理性定价，由于信息聚合不完美，横截面上的超额收益可预测性仍然存在。这种可预测性源于共同状态下的贝叶斯滤波残差，解释了多个已知的资产定价异象。
AI.research_question: 在分散信息学习和公共横截面信号的经济中，即使局部定价有效，为何横截面上仍存在收益可预测性？
AI.motivation: 传统有效市场假说认为局部定价效率意味着横截面效率，但现实中存在大量异象（如价值效应、动量效应等），需要理论解释这些异象为何存在而不被套利消除。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分散信息学习理论、贝叶斯滤波、信息聚合楔子、理性预期均衡
AI.method: 理论建模，构建分散信息学习经济模型，分析局部定价与横截面定价的关系
AI.findings: 1) 除非信息完全聚合，分散学习会留下贝叶斯滤波残差；2) 预期超额收益在局部定价下为零，但在横截面上与信息聚合楔子成正比；3) 可观测特征（账面市值比、盈利性、投资、过去收益）代理了这些误差从而预测收益；4) 该单一楔子解释了多个异象的共性特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"信息聚合楔子"作为横截面收益可预测性的统一理论解释，将信息摩擦与资产定价异象联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了套利无法消除横截面定价效率的根本原因，为投资者理解异象的持续性提供了理论基础。

title: Tariffs and Goods-Market Search Frictions
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Tariffs and Goods-Market Search Frictions

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: We study tariffs in a general equilibrium dynamic model with search frictions between heterogeneous exporting producers and importing retailers. We show the model has a unique equilibrium and analytically characterize home unilateral import tariffs that maximize welfare given a passive foreign country. Search frictions add two terms to the standard optimal tariff expression: One lowers tariffs when contact rates are low; another when private export costs exceed social opportunity costs. Search frictions also introduce new incentives to subsidize imports due to market thickness effects. We calibrate our baseline to U.S. and Chinese 2016 data. We compare this baseline to a counterfactual with international search costs reduced to domestic levels but with all other parameters fixed. We find that higher baseline search costs reduce optimal U.S. unilateral and Nash tariffs and attenuate welfare responses to tariff changes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含搜索摩擦的一般均衡动态模型，研究异质性出口生产商与进口零售商之间的贸易关税问题。搜索摩擦会在标准最优关税表达式中增加两项调整项，并因市场厚度效应产生新的进口补贴激励。基于2016年中美数据的校准分析表明，较高的搜索成本会降低最优单边关税和纳什关税，并减弱福利对关税变化的反应。
AI.research_question: 在存在搜索摩擦的国际贸易环境中，最优关税应如何设定？搜索摩擦如何影响关税政策与福利效应？
AI.motivation: 传统最优关税理论未考虑国际贸易中的搜索摩擦，而现实中出口商与进口商之间的匹配过程存在显著成本。本文旨在将搜索摩擦纳入一般均衡框架，重新审视最优关税的表达式和政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜索摩擦理论（Search Frictions）、一般均衡动态模型、最优关税理论、市场厚度效应（Market Thickness Effects）
AI.method: 构建包含搜索摩擦的一般均衡动态模型，证明均衡唯一性；解析推导最优单边关税表达式；基于2016年中美数据进行校准，并进行反事实分析（将国际搜索成本降至国内水平）。
AI.findings: （1）搜索摩擦在最优关税表达式中增加两项：当联系率较低时降低关税，当私人出口成本超过社会机会成本时也降低关税；（2）搜索摩擦因市场厚度效应产生新的进口补贴激励；（3）较高的基准搜索成本降低美国最优单边关税和纳什关税；（4）搜索成本削弱了福利对关税变化的反应程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将搜索摩擦系统地引入最优关税理论，揭示了搜索成本对关税设定和福利效应的定量影响机制，扩展了一般均衡贸易模型的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为贸易政策制定者提供了考虑市场匹配摩擦的关税设计参考，指出在搜索成本较高的市场环境中，激进关税政策的福利收益有限，为中美贸易摩擦等现实问题提供了新的分析视角。

title: The 'Shared' and 'Open' Innovation Paradigm: Re-Conceptualising the Competition Law and IP Interface in (Digital) Business Ecosystems
affiliations: University College London - Faculty of Laws, , affiliation not provided to SSRN and Villanova University - Charles Widger School of Law

detail.title: The 'Shared' and 'Open' Innovation Paradigm: Re-Conceptualising the Competition Law and IP Interface in (Digital) Business Ecosystems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Ioannis Lianos declares that any views in this article are strictly personal and do not engage the UK Competition Appeal Tribunal
declarations.funderStatement: Ioannis Lianos’ and Timo Minssen’s research for this work was supported, in part, by a Novo Nordisk Foundation Grant for a scientifically independent International Collaborative Bioscience Innovation & Law Programme (Inter-CeBIL programme—grant no. NNF23SA0087056). The authors have no conflict of interest to declare

publicationDetails.detailsText: Faculty of Laws University College London Law Research Paper No. 14/2026

detail.abstract: Modern innovation increasingly emerges not within individual firms but across (digital) business ecosystems, where multiple independent actors co-produce knowledge and value whilst competing over the distribution of innovation rents. This article argues that existing legal frameworks to protect and promote innovation, particularly intellectual property (IP) law and competition law, were designed for a more linear, standalone model of innovation and are poorly suited to the relational, ecosystem-embedded and cumulative nature of contemporary innovative activity. Drawing on innovation economics, business ecosystem theory, competition and IP law, the article advances three interconnected arguments. First, in regimes of 'shared' and 'open' innovation, IP rights should give rise not solely to exclusionary entitlements but also, in appropriate circumstances, to compensation rights calibrated to reflect the contributions of all ecosystem participants. Second, competition law and IP rights should be reconceived as institutional complements rather than antagonists, each reinforcing the conditions for sustained cumulative innovation. Third, and most innovatively, the article proposes the tokenization of IP and data access rights - including data tokens, IP rights tokens, and innovation rent tokens built on blockchain infrastructure - as a concrete legal technology for operationalizing this framework. Tokenization enables fractional ownership of innovation rents, reduces transaction costs in fragmented IP landscapes, facilitates collateralization by ecosystem participants, and converts exclusionary property rules into compensatory liability rules, thereby aligning legal entitlements with the distributed, cumulative reality of shared innovation. The article calls for a differentiated legal architecture that combines exclusivity and compensation according to ecosystem structure, actor position, and innovation stage.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，现代创新日益发生在（数字）商业生态系统中，而非单个企业内部。现有的知识产权法和竞争法基于线性、独立的创新模式设计，不适合关系性、生态系统嵌入和累积性的创新现实。作者提出三项论点：共享与开放创新中，知识产权应产生补偿权而非仅排他权；竞争法与知识产权应视为制度互补而非对抗；提出基于区块链的代币化方案（数据代币、IP权利代币、创新租金代币）作为具体法律技术，将排他性财产规则转化为补偿性责任规则。
AI.research_question: 在数字商业生态系统背景下，现有知识产权法和竞争法如何调整才能更好地适应共享、开放和累积性创新的特点？
AI.motivation: 现代创新已从单个企业的线性模式转向跨生态系统的分布式协作模式，但现有的知识产权法和竞争法仍基于传统的排他性、独立性创新逻辑设计，二者之间存在严重的不匹配，亟需法律架构的创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新经济学、商业生态系统理论、竞争法与知识产权法的交叉分析。
AI.method: 跨学科理论分析与规范性法律论证。
AI.findings: （1）在共享与开放创新中，知识产权应引入补偿权机制，反映所有生态系统参与者的贡献；（2）竞争法与知识产权应被视为制度互补，共同支撑累积性创新；（3）代币化（基于区块链的数据代币、IP权利代币、创新租金代币）可作为法律技术，实现排他性规则向补偿性责任规则的转化，降低交易成本，促进创新租金的分布式分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将知识产权与竞争法从对立关系重新概念化为制度互补关系的理论框架；引入代币化作为连接法律架构与生态系统创新现实的中介性法律技术概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和法律实践者提供了具体的制度设计建议，包括基于区块链的代币化方案，以实现创新租金的公平分配和生态系统内多方参与者的协调。

title: Personalized Dynamic Pricing with Demand Learning: The Impact of Growing Effective Dimensionality
affiliations: Imperial College Business School , New York University, New York University (NYU) - New York University, New York University (NYU) - Department of Information, Operations, and Management Sciences, Duke University - Fuqua School of Business and

detail.title: Personalized Dynamic Pricing with Demand Learning: The Impact of Growing Effective Dimensionality
detail.abstract: In this paper, we investigate personalized dynamic pricing and demand learning under high-dimensional models with growing effective dimensionality. Compared to strictly sparse models with a small and constant number of true predictors, allowing the number of effective features to grow can capture richer relationships through which an individual customer's demand can depend on the customer's features. Motivated by dynamic pricing applications where sellers typically have access to an expanding number of relevant customer features, we consider a seller that dynamically sets the price of a product for every individual customer. Customers arrive sequentially over time, and the seller observes a vector of features for each arriving customer. Demand is governed by a personalized model that depends on these customer features, and we measure the seller's performance by regret, defined as the revenue loss relative to a clairvoyant who knows the underlying personalized demand model. We establish theoretical regret bounds for this setting and complement them with numerical experiments that illustrate the role of growing effective dimensionality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了高维个性化动态定价与需求学习问题，允许有效特征维度随样本量增长，并建立了理论遗憾界与数值实验验证。
AI.research_question: 当有效特征维度随样本量增长时，卖家如何通过个性化动态定价实现需求学习并最小化收益遗憾？
AI.motivation: 传统稀疏模型假设真实预测变量数量少且恒定，但实际应用中卖家可获取的客户特征越来越多，允许有效特征维度增长能捕捉更丰富的客户需求关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高维个性化需求模型、动态定价、遗憾最小化框架、在线学习理论
AI.method: 理论推导（建立遗憾上界）与数值实验（模拟验证理论结果）
AI.findings: 在有效特征维度增长的设定下，所提出的动态定价策略具有可证明的遗憾界，且数值实验验证了增长维度对定价性能的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将动态定价与需求学习扩展到有效特征维度可增长的场景，突破了传统严格稀疏假设的局限，提供了更一般化的理论保障。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拥有大量客户特征的电商、共享经济等平台提供了可操作的高维个性化定价策略，指导如何在实际中平衡维度增长与学习效率。

reference: European Corporate Governance Institute – Finance Working Paper No. 1139/2026
title: Voice Without Influence? Global Investor Voting Rationale Disclosures in Korea
affiliations: KOREA INSTITUTE OF CORPORATE GOVERNANCE AND SUSTAINABILITY and Korea University Business School

detail.title: Voice Without Influence? Global Investor Voting Rationale Disclosures in Korea

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Corporate Governance Institute – Finance Working Paper No. 1139/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) - Finance Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This study investigates how global institutional investors respond to gender diversity and climate risk concerns in Korean firms through disclosed voting rationales and how these disclosures subsequently influence corporate policies. We find mixed results.

First, voting rationale disclosures are more sensitive to gender diversity concerns than to climate risk. Specifically, investor opposition citing gender diversity decreases as the ratio of female directors rises. However, opposition citing climate risk does not increase in response to higher total CO2 emissions.

Second, we find that voting rationale disclosures have a limited influence on gender or climate-related corporate policies. While opposition citing gender diversity appears to prompt increases in the number and ratio of female directors in subsequent years, this pattern is confined to large firms subject to gender quota laws and is observed only during the years preceding the law's implementation. Furthermore, we find that opposition based on climate risk concerns is associated with subsequent reductions in total CO2 emissions, but only for small firms. Lastly, the publication of a sustainability report is associated with higher firm value when global institutional investors do not issue opposing rationales against management proposals, but this association holds only for small firms.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨全球机构投资者如何通过披露投票理由来回应韩国企业的性别多样性和气候风险问题，以及这些披露如何影响企业后续政策。结果发现：投票理由对性别多样性的敏感度高于气候风险；披露对政策的影响有限，且因企业规模和政策环境而异。
AI.research_question: 全球机构投资者如何通过投票理由披露回应韩国企业的性别多样性和气候风险问题？这些披露如何进一步影响企业政策？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG投资兴起，机构投资者日益关注企业的性别多样性和气候风险表现，但对新兴市场中投票理由披露的实际影响力及其对政策制定的作用机制尚不明确，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机构投资者参与理论、利益相关者理论、信号理论、企业治理响应理论
AI.method: 实证分析，使用韩国企业的投票理由披露数据，结合企业特征（规模、法律合规状态等）进行分组回归分析。
AI.findings: 1) 投票理由对性别多样性的敏感度高于气候风险；2) 性别多样性反对理由仅在受性别配额法约束的大型企业中有效，且仅在法律实施前年份显著；3) 气候风险反对理由仅与小型企业后续减排相关；4) 可持续报告发布仅在无机构反对时才与大型企业价值正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了机构投资者投票理由披露在新兴市场中的非对称有效性，区分了不同ESG议题的治理响应差异，并识别了企业规模和法律制度环境的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于ESG投票披露实际影响力的实证证据，建议针对不同规模企业采取差异化政策干预；为企业管理者理解机构投资者关注点及有效回应方式提供参考。

reference: Case Western Reserve Journal of International Law, Volume 58, Issue 1. Pp. 421-490. Available at: https://scholarlycommons.law.case.edu/jil/vol58/iss1/15
title: Governing Economic Statecraft: Procedural Guardrails from State Practice

detail.title: Governing Economic Statecraft: Procedural Guardrails from State Practice

publicationDetails.detailsText: Case Western Reserve Journal of International Law, Volume 58, Issue 1. Pp. 421-490. Available at: https://scholarlycommons.law.case.edu/jil/vol58/iss1/15

detail.abstract:
National security exceptions have long been part of international trade law, but their use has expanded alongside the rise of economic statecraft. States now increasingly rely on geoeconomic tools such as sanctions, subsidies, tariffs, and investment and export controls to pursue geopolitical goals. This phenomenon, described by political scientists as “weaponized interdependence,” has blurred the boundary between economic policy and national security, thereby straining the integrity of WTO rules and the multilateral trading system.

Against this backdrop, how can states promote rule-of-law values such as transparency and predictability on the international plane as they implement geoeconomic policies?

This Article makes two contributions to the international law literature. First, it advances global administrative law scholarship by underscoring the relevance of procedural principles in domains often treated as exceptional and by showing how recurring regulatory practices across legal systems can inform early-stage conversations around transnational economic security governance.

Second, the Article complements international economic law scholarship by identifying a set of procedural norms embedded in the domestic administration of trade and investment security: agency findings, notice and transparency, consultation, proportionality, temporal limits, periodic review, and neutral oversight. Drawing on a comparative analysis of seven jurisdictions—China, Japan, the Netherlands, Taiwan, the United Kingdom, the United States, and the European Union—the Article examines how these shared procedural features interact with existing multilateral frameworks and suggests that they provide a pragmatic basis for managing economic security measures in a deeply contested global order.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了地缘经济工具（制裁、补贴、关税等）如何模糊经济政策与国家安全边界，并通过比较七个司法管辖区的实践，提出一套嵌入国内贸易和投资安全行政中的程序性规范（机构认定、通知与透明度、磋商、比例原则、时间限制、定期审查、中立监督），为在深度竞争的国际秩序中管理经济安全措施提供实用基础。
AI.research_question: 在实施地缘经济政策时，各国如何在国际层面促进透明度、可预测性等法治价值？
AI.motivation: 国家日益利用制裁、补贴、关税、投资和出口管制等地缘经济工具追求地缘政治目标（"武器化相互依存"），模糊了经济政策与国家安全的边界，挑战了WTO规则和多边贸易体系的完整性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球行政法理论（强调程序原则在例外领域中的适用性）；比较法分析（七个司法管辖区的监管实践比较）。
AI.method: 对七个司法管辖区（中国、日本、荷兰、台湾、英国、美国、欧盟）的国内贸易和投资安全行政实践进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 识别出一套嵌入国内贸易和投资安全行政中的共享程序性规范：机构认定、通知与透明度、磋商、比例原则、时间限制、定期审查和中立监督，并发现这些程序性特征与现有多边框架之间存在互动关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进了全球行政法学术研究，突显了程序原则在通常被视为例外领域中的相关性，并展示了跨法律体系的反复监管实践如何为跨国经济安全治理的早期对话提供信息。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际经济法学术研究提供了补充，识别出一套嵌入国内行政实践中的程序性规范，为在深度竞争的国际秩序中务实管理经济安全措施提供了基础。

title: Mapping and Framing Circular Economy in the Sixth Assessment Report o f the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change: A Systematic Text Analysis
affiliations: University of Padua - Department of Economics and Management, University of Padua and University of Brescia - Department of Economics

detail.title: Mapping and Framing Circular Economy in the Sixth Assessment Report o f the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change: A Systematic Text Analysis

publicationDetails.journalName: FEEM Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Although the circular economy (CE) is recognised as a key climate mitigation strategy, its integration within global climate frameworks, such as those developed by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) in its Assessment Reports, remains unclear. This study provides a systematic analysis of how the circular economy is framed in the climate-mitigation context of the IPCC Sixth Assessment Report using a mixed-methods approach that combines computational text analysis with qualitative content analysis through sentence-level manual coding. Eight Chapters relevant to the mitigation were examined and findings show that CE is most frequently framed as a supporting strategy (44.3%), followed by implicit (29.3%) and primary roles (26.4%), while being unevenly distributed across sectors, with the strongest representation in industry.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统分析了IPCC第六次评估报告中循环经济（CE）在气候减缓背景下的呈现方式，发现CE最常被框架为支持性策略（44.3%），其次为隐性（29.3%）和主要角色（26.4%），且在不同行业间分布不均，工业领域表现最为突出。
AI.research_question: 循环经济如何在IPCC第六次评估报告的气候减缓背景中被框架化呈现？
AI.motivation: 尽管循环经济被视为关键的气候减缓策略，但其在全球气候框架（如IPCC评估报告）中的整合程度尚不明确，有必要进行系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环经济理论、气候变化减缓理论、框架分析理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：结合计算文本分析与定性内容分析，通过句子级别的人工编码对IPCC第六次评估报告中与减缓相关的8个章节进行系统分析。
AI.findings: CE被框架为支持性策略（44.3%）、隐性角色（29.3%）和主要角色（26.4%）；在不同行业间分布不均，工业领域表现最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了CE在IPCC气候减缓框架中的话语定位，为理解CE与气候治理的整合程度提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了CE在主流气候评估中角色的量化证据，有助于推动CE更系统地融入未来气候政策与评估。

reference: Banque de France Working Paper No. 1043
title: Beyond Borders, Within Societies: Inequality and the Global Transmission of US Monetary Policy
affiliations: and European Securities and Markets Authority

detail.title: Beyond Borders, Within Societies: Inequality and the Global Transmission of US Monetary Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banque de France Working Paper No. 1043
publicationDetails.journalName: Banque de France Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on how income inequality shapes the heterogeneity of US monetary policy spillovers to GDP across foreign economies. Using state-dependent local projections and exploiting variation in disposable income inequality across a panel of 87 countries over the period 1966-2020, we show that household heterogeneity influences how foreign GDP responds to a US monetary policy tightening. GDP contracts by up to one and a half times more when inequality is above average. However, while higher inequality amplifies negative spillovers in advanced economies, it mitigates them in emerging markets. To rationalise this finding, we use a three-country open economy Two-Agent New Keynesian (TANK) model, which suggests that this divergence is driven by differences in participation in international financial markets. Households in emerging market economies face greater barriers to international investment, limiting their ability to re-balance portfolios towards higher-return foreign bonds after the shock.

AI.tldr: 本文发现收入不平等会显著影响美国货币政策紧缩对别国GDP的溢出效应：在发达国家，高不平等会放大负面溢出；在新兴市场，高不平等反而缓解负面溢出。原因在于新兴市场家庭参与国际金融市场受限，无法通过调整投资组合对冲冲击。
AI.research_question: 收入不平等如何塑造美国货币政策对其他国家GDP溢出效应的异质性？
AI.motivation: 已有文献关注美国货币政策的国际溢出效应，但忽略了国内收入不平等这一重要异质性因素。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三国产开放经济双主体新凯恩斯（TANK）模型，强调国际金融市场参与度的异质性。
AI.method: 采用状态依赖的局部投影法（state-dependent local projections），利用1966-2020年87个国家的面板数据，以可支配收入不平等为关键变量分析溢出效应的异质性。
AI.findings: （1）美国货币政策紧缩时，不平等高于平均水平时GDP收缩幅度最多增加1.5倍；（2）在发达经济体中，高不平等放大负面溢出；（3）在新兴市场中，高不平等反而缓解负面溢出。机制在于新兴市场家庭参与国际金融市场存在较大障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将家庭异质性（收入不平等）引入国际宏观经济学中的货币政策溢出效应研究，拓展了TANK模型至开放经济三国产框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了差异化应对美国货币政策冲击的新视角：需根据本国不平等水平和经济发展阶段采取不同的宏观审慎或资本流动管理政策。

reference: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming
title: Procrastination in Personal Finance: Implications for Estate Planning and Retirement Satisfaction
affiliations: University of Wisconsin-Madison and Wisconsin School of Business

detail.title: Procrastination in Personal Finance: Implications for Estate Planning and Retirement Satisfaction

publicationDetails.detailsText: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: TIAA Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Despite concerns that many older adults delay essential financial decisions, there is limited population-level evidence linking measured procrastination to late-life behavior. Using the first nationwide procrastination module in the Health and Retirement Study, we show that individuals with higher procrastination scores are significantly less likely to engage in core estate-planning tasks. Procrastinators are about nine percentage points less likely to have a will or trust and report lower retirement satisfaction, controlling for demographics, income, and region. We validate the behavioral measure by showing that procrastinators report worse health and exhibit some riskier behaviors, consistent with theoretical predictions. Together, these results highlight procrastination as a meaningful behavioral constraint that shapes financial and health outcomes at older ages.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国健康与退休研究中的首个全国性拖延模块数据，发现拖延程度较高的老年人显著更少进行遗产规划（如立遗嘱或信托），且退休满意度较低。研究验证了拖延作为行为约束对老年财务与健康结果的影响。
AI.research_question: 拖延这一行为特质如何影响老年人关键的财务决策（如遗产规划）及退休满意度？
AI.motivation: 尽管人们担忧许多老年人会延迟重要的财务决策，但缺乏全国性的人口层面证据来将测量到的拖延行为与老年人的实际行为联系起来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拖延行为理论：拖延作为一种行为约束，预测个体会推迟重要的决策任务，导致不良后果。
AI.method: 利用健康与退休研究（HRS）中首个全国性拖延模块数据，通过回归分析控制人口统计学、收入和地区等变量，检验拖延得分与遗产规划、退休满意度等结果变量的关系，并通过健康与风险行为验证该行为测量的有效性。
AI.findings: 拖延得分较高的老年人立遗嘱或设立信托的可能性低约9个百分点；退休满意度更低；拖延者自评健康更差，且表现出更多风险行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了首个全国性人口层面证据，将测量的拖延行为与老年人的实际财务决策联系起来，拓展了拖延行为理论在老年财务决策领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者和财务顾问应关注拖延作为影响老年人财务健康的行为约束，设计干预措施帮助老年人及时完成遗产规划等关键财务决策。

title: Accurate Estimation of Small Effects: Illustration Through Air Pollution and Health

detail.title: Accurate Estimation of Small Effects: Illustration Through Air Pollution and Health
detail.abstract: This paper identifies design parameters that can lead to inaccurate estimates of small effects. Low statistical power not only makes such effects difficult to detect but resulting significant estimates necessarily exaggerate true effect sizes on average. Through the literature on short-term health effects of air pollution, I explore this issue and its policy implications. Exaggeration can be substantial and power low even with large sample sizes. Real-data simulations highlight key additional drivers: the number of exogenous shocks, instrument strength, and outcome count. I propose a workflow to evaluate and mitigate exaggeration risk in non-experimental studies.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了导致小效应估计不准确的设计参数，指出低统计效力不仅使小效应难以检测，还会导致显著估计夸大真实效应大小。通过空气污染短期健康效应文献，探讨了该问题及政策含义。研究发现即使在样本量大的情况下，夸大也可能很严重且统计效力低。真实数据模拟强调了几个关键驱动因素：外生冲击数量、工具变量强度和结果数量。本文提出了一个在非实验研究中评估和减轻夸大风险的工作流程。
AI.research_question: 在非实验研究中，哪些设计参数会导致小效应估计不准确？低统计效力如何导致对真实效应大小的夸大？
AI.motivation: 低统计效力使小效应难以检测，且显著估计必然在平均上夸大真实效应大小，这可能导致错误政策结论。通过空气污染短期健康效应文献，探讨该问题及政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计效力理论、效应夸大机制、非实验研究设计参数（外生冲击数量、工具变量强度、结果数量）对估计准确性的影响。
AI.method: 文献综述结合真实数据模拟，分析不同设计参数（样本量、外生冲击数量、工具变量强度、结果数量）如何影响效应估计的准确性和统计效力。
AI.findings: 即使样本量很大，夸大效应的问题也可能很严重且统计效力低。效应夸大的关键驱动因素包括：外生冲击数量、工具变量强度和结果数量。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统识别了非实验研究中小效应估计不准确的设计参数，揭示了低统计效力与效应夸大之间的机制关系，拓展了对统计效力问题的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一个在非实验研究中评估和减轻效应夸大风险的工作流程，为空气污染健康效应等政策相关领域的研究设计提供了实践指南。

title: Housing Prices, Monetary Policy and Banking Crises: Nonlinear Dynamics, State Dependence and Policy Trade-offs

detail.title: Housing Prices, Monetary Policy and Banking Crises: Nonlinear Dynamics, State Dependence and Policy Trade-offs
detail.abstract: This study examines the joint effects of housing market dynamics and monetary policy on systemic banking crises using annual panel data for 26 advanced and emerging economies over 1990-2023. Applying fixed effects binary logit, multinomial logit and local projection methods, we find consistent evidence of non-linear relationship between growth rate of housing price and crisis probability. Moderate price appreciations are stabilizing while excessive growth becomes destabilizing beyond indicative range of 17-22 percent, which declines to 8-14 percent under contractionary monetary conditions. Monetary tightening is consistently associated with higher crisis risk. Notably, housing prices act as contemporaneous amplifiers rather than early warning indicators having stronger effects during crisis periods. The findings highlight state dependent risks and underscore the need for coordinated monetary and macroprudential policies to mitigate housing driven financial vulnerabilities.

AI.tldr: 利用1990-2023年26个发达和新兴经济体的面板数据，研究住房市场动态与货币政策对系统性银行危机的联合影响，发现房价增速与危机概率存在非线性关系，货币政策紧缩增加危机风险，且房价在危机期间起放大作用而非预警信号。
AI.research_question: 住房市场动态与货币政策如何共同影响系统性银行危机？
AI.motivation: 既有研究多单独考察房价或货币政策与金融危机的关系，但两者交互作用及其非线性、状态依赖特征尚不明确，且缺乏跨国面板数据的系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房市场-货币政策-银行危机非线性关系理论；状态依赖风险理论；金融加速器理论。
AI.method: 采用固定效应二元Logit模型、多项Logit模型和局部投影方法，基于26个发达和新兴经济体1990-2023年的年度面板数据。
AI.findings: （1）房价增速与危机概率呈非线性关系：适度上涨（17-22%以内）具有稳定效应，过快增长则会显著增加危机风险；（2）在紧缩性货币政策下，这一阈值降至8-14%；（3）货币紧缩始终与更高危机风险相关；（4）房价在危机期间起同期放大器作用，而非早期预警指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了房价-危机关系的非线性与状态依赖性特征，明确了货币政策对房价阈值的调节作用，以及房价作为危机放大器而非预警指标的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策和宏观审慎政策的协调配合提供了实证依据，建议政策制定者关注房价增速的阈值区间并考虑货币环境的状态差异。

title: Transition Pain or Structural Decline? Causal Evidence on Renewable Energy and Employment in U.S. Legacy Regions

detail.title: Transition Pain or Structural Decline? Causal Evidence on Renewable Energy and Employment in U.S. Legacy Regions
detail.abstract: The green penalty hypothesis holds that expanding renewable energy capacity destroys employment in legacy fossil fuel and manufacturing regions by raising compliance costs and accelerating industrial decline. We provide a methodologically rigorous test of this hypothesis at the U.S. state level, applying a Double Machine Learning (DML) architecture to a balanced annual panel of all fifty states over 1997-2023. A Random Forest algorithm partials out a highdimensional vector of macroeconomic, demographic, and political confounders in the first stage, while two-way demeaning eliminates unobserved state fixed effects and common time shocks prior to estimation. Identification is robust to repeated cross-fitting across one hundred random partitions. We find no statistically or economically significant effect of renewable energy penetration on state unemployment rates in either Rust Belt manufacturing states or coaldependent extraction states. This null result survives substitution of alternative first-stage estimators, restriction to the pre-pandemic period, lagged treatment specifications of up to two years, block cross-validation, and systematic jackknife sensitivity analysis of the cluster definitions. A mechanism test further rules out that the presence of a large extractive sector conditions the transition-employment relationship. Comparing Random Forest and Ridge Regression first stages, we show that inflated green penalty estimates in prior work are attributable, at least in part, to functional form misspecification in the nuisance function rather than genuine causal effects. The structural unemployment observed in legacy regions is consistent with market forces (routine-biased technological change, secular manufacturing decline, and broader energy market disruptions) that are independent of renewable energy policy. Effective intervention requires active labour market policies calibrated to the occupational and geographic distance between declining fossil fuel roles and growing sectors, embedded within a well-resourced Just Transition framework.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国五十州1997-2023年的面板数据，采用双机器学习方法检验"绿色惩罚假说"，发现可再生能源扩张对州失业率无显著影响，驳斥了可再生能源导致传统能源和制造业地区就业破坏的观点。
AI.research_question: 可再生能源发电容量扩张是否显著破坏了化石燃料和制造业遗留地区的就业？
AI.motivation: "绿色惩罚假说"在政策辩论中颇具影响力，认为可再生能源扩张通过提高合规成本加速传统工业衰退，但缺乏严格的方法论检验，现有估计可能存在函数形式误设问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色惩罚假说、双机器学习因果推断框架、随机森林非参数估计、职业与地理距离理论、公正转型框架
AI.method: 双机器学习（Double Machine Learning）架构，第一阶段用随机森林拟合高维混淆变量，采用双向去均值处理固定效应，进行100次随机分区的交叉拟合。稳健性检验包括替代第一阶段估计器、限制疫情前时期、滞后处理、分块交叉验证和Jackknife敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 可再生能源渗透率对州失业率无统计显著或经济显著的影响，即使在铁锈地带制造业州和煤炭依赖州。这种效应缺失在大量稳健性检验下依然成立。机制检验表明，大型采掘业的存在不会调节转型-就业关系。早期研究中发现的"绿色惩罚"效应可归因于函数形式误设，而非真实因果效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过严格因果推断方法驳斥绿色惩罚假说；揭示传统遗留地区的结构性失业源于市场力量（常规偏向技术变革、制造业长期衰退、能源市场整体动荡），而非可再生能源政策；指出函数形式误设是早期研究产生虚假结论的原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者提供证据：可再生能源扩张不会加剧失业，无需因就业担忧减缓能源转型；建议将政策资源集中于针对性的积极劳动力市场政策，而非延缓清洁能源部署；强调公正转型框架应关注职业与地理距离，帮助化石燃料从业者向增长部门过渡。

title: Funding Public Health: Information Mis-(alignment) and Willingness to Pay
affiliations: , Indiana University Bloomington and

detail.title: Funding Public Health: Information Mis-(alignment) and Willingness to Pay
detail.abstract: The study examines whether exposure to public health-aligned information interacts with relative trust in the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) versus President Donald Trump to shape pandemic policy preferences. Using a survey experiment, we find that information increases prioritization of public health over economic reopening-but only among respondents who trust the CDC more than Trump. However, this conditional effect does not extend to support for increased public health spending or new taxation. These results identify a boundary condition in trust-based persuasion: informational effects shift symbolic priorities but do not translate into willingness to bear fiscal costs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调查实验发现，公共卫生信息只有在受访者更信任CDC而非特朗普时，才能提升其对公共卫生相对于经济重启的优先级排序，但这种效应并未延伸到支持增加公共卫生支出或新税负上，揭示了信任说服的边界条件。
AI.research_question: 接触公共卫生信息如何与对CDC和特朗普的相对信任共同影响公众的防疫政策偏好？
AI.motivation: 在新冠疫情中，公共卫生信息与政治信任存在交互效应，但此前研究未充分探讨信息对政策偏好（尤其是象征性优先级与实质性财政支持之间）的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任说服理论、信息处理的动机推理模型、象征性政治与实质性政策的区分
AI.method: 调查实验
AI.findings: （1）公共卫生信息提升了更信任CDC而非特朗普的受访者对公共卫生相对于经济重启的优先级；（2）该条件效应未扩展到对增加公共卫生支出或新税负的支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了信任说服的边界条件——信息能够改变象征性政策优先级，但无法转化为对财政成本的承担意愿，细化了信任-说服关系的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生传播策略提供了重要启示：即使公众在象征性层面接受科学信息，在涉及实质性财政成本时仍可能缺乏支持，需要针对性地设计沟通与政策方案。

title: Pretend or Amend? On Evergreening in CRE
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Pretend or Amend? On Evergreening in CRE

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 025, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.025]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Loan modifications can either amplify or mitigate credit losses depending on the strategy lenders employ.  Using detailed supervisory data and a model accounting for competing extension motivations (temporary repayment difficulties, foreclosure costs, and loss recognition costs), I assess why banks extend CRE loans.  I find that extensions predominantly address temporary payment frictions, both in normal times and following the Spring 2023 bank stress episode. Contrary to banks "extending-and-pretending" during that episode, banks increased income and principal paydown requirements for extensions, contributing to strong ex-post performance for extended loans.

AI.tldr: 本文研究银行在正常时期和2023年春季银行压力事件后延长商业房地产（CRE）贷款的原因，发现贷款展期主要是为了解决临时性偿付摩擦，而非掩盖不良贷款，银行在压力期间通过提高收入和本金偿还要求，使展期贷款表现良好。
AI.research_question: 银行延长商业房地产（CRE）贷款的主要动机是什么？贷款展期在不同时期（正常时期与银行压力时期）对信贷损失有何影响？
AI.motivation: 贷款修改（展期）可能放大或减轻信贷损失，取决于贷款机构采用的策略。理解银行延长CRE贷款的真实动机对评估金融体系风险至关重要，特别是在2023年春季银行压力事件之后，存在关于银行是否“展期并假装”（extending-and-pretending）掩盖不良贷款的争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争性展期动机框架：考虑三种动机——临时偿付困难、止赎成本、损失确认成本，用以解释银行延长贷款的行为。
AI.method: 使用详细的监管数据，构建一个考虑竞争性展期动机的模型，分析银行延长CRE贷款的原因。
AI.findings: 1. 贷款展期主要用于解决临时性偿付摩擦，在正常时期和2023年春季银行压力事件后均如此。2. 与“展期并假装”的说法相反，银行在压力期间提高了展期贷款的收入和本金偿还要求。3. 展期贷款的后续表现良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个包含三种竞争性展期动机（临时偿付困难、止赎成本、损失确认成本）的分析框架，为理解银行延长贷款行为提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估银行在压力时期贷款展期的真实风险提供了实证依据，反驳了“展期并假装”的担忧，表明银行的展期策略实际上是审慎的。

title: Beyond First-year Payouts: Actuarial Value and Real-income Retention in an NPS Joint-life Annuity
affiliations: Invespar Pte Ltd and

detail.title: Beyond First-year Payouts: Actuarial Value and Real-income Retention in an NPS Joint-life Annuity
detail.abstract: India's National Pension System (NPS) converts part of accumulated defined-contribution wealth into annuity income, making decumulation design a question of both predictability and adequacy. This paper studies one product-specific case: a nominal joint-life annuity without return of purchase price, with 60 per cent spouse continuation, for an age-60 annuitant and age-57 spouse, over May 2013 to March 2025. Using contemporaneous 10-year Government of India yields and the common Indian Individual Annuitant's Mortality (IIAM) 2012-15 schedule, the paper converts the constructed payout series into a purchase-time money's-worth ratio (MWR) and measures realised Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers (CPI-IW) purchasing-power retention after purchase. The joint-life payout ranges from 7.19 to 8.30 per cent; the MWR ranges from 0.783 to 1.031 and averages 0.890. Mean real retention is 0.95 after one year, 0.86 after three years, 0.78 after five years, and 0.61 after ten years. Quoted payout rates, actuarial value, and realised real-income retention therefore measure distinct aspects of decumulation. A supplementary 10-year exercise reports residual liquidportfolio burden under fixed spending assumptions. The contribution is a product-specific measurement framework for NPS decumulation design, not a welfare ranking or full market evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度国家养老金计划（NPS）中一款特定年金产品（名义联合生存年金，无保费返还，配偶续领60%）在2013-2023年间的货币价值比率（MWR）与实际购买力留存情况，发现名义年金虽提供可预测的给付率，但实际购买力随时间显著侵蚀。
AI.research_question: 印度NPS中一款特定的名义联合生存年金产品，其购买时的货币价值比率（MWR）如何？以及购买后实际购买力留存随时间如何变化？
AI.motivation: NPS将累积的确定缴费财富转化为年金收入，使得“去累积化”设计同时面临可预测性和充足性的权衡。现有研究缺乏针对印度NPS具体年金产品的测量框架，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币价值比率（Money's Worth Ratio, MWR）、实际购买力留存（Real Purchasing-Power Retention）、年金定价中的死亡率表（IIAM 2012-15）与利率（10年期印度政府债券收益率）。
AI.method: 选取特定产品（名义联合生存年金，60%配偶续领，60岁年金领取人及57岁配偶），使用2013年5月至2025年3月的同期10年期印度政府国债收益率与IIAM 2012-15死亡率表，构建给付序列并计算购买时点的MWR，同时用CPI-IW衡量购买后的实际购买力留存。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对NPS去累积化设计的产品特定测量框架，区分了名义给付率、精算价值与实际收入留存三者之间的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度NPS政策制定者和参与者提供了具体的年金产品绩效测量工具，揭示了名义年金在通胀环境下实际购买力快速下降的风险，并对固定支出假设下的剩余流动组合负担进行了补充分析。

title: The Rise of Agentic AI in Banking

detail.title: The Rise of Agentic AI in Banking

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or sensitive data and does not require ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of Agentic AI on operational performance in commercial banks across the United States and the United Kingdom between 2022 and 2026. It investigates whether autonomous systems function as net value creators or as amplifiers of systemic risk. Using a systematic review of secondary sources, including industry reports, regulatory publications, and institutional disclosures, the study identifies a consistent but underexplored pattern: performance outcomes vary significantly by task type. To explain this variation, the paper proposes the Ambiguity Threshold Hypothesis (ATH), which suggests that Agentic AI delivers reliable gains in low-ambiguity, rule-based tasks, while producing unstable or adverse outcomes in high-ambiguity, judgment-intensive environments. The paper further introduces a temporal dimension to performance evaluation, arguing that reported benefits are typically front-loaded, whereas associated risks emerge over longer time horizons, leading to a systematic distortion in perceived net value. While the findings are based on secondary data and should be interpreted as directional rather than conclusive, the study highlights the limitations of current industry reporting and suggests the need for task-level evaluation frameworks in both the deployment and regulation of Agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析2022-2026年美英商业银行数据，提出"模糊阈值假说"来解释Agentic AI在不同任务类型中的差异化绩效表现，并揭示了绩效评估中的时间偏差问题。
AI.research_question: Agentic AI在商业银行中是净价值创造者，还是系统性风险的放大器？其绩效表现如何随任务类型和时间维度变化？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对Agentic AI的绩效评估存在不一致结论，缺乏对任务类型差异性和时间维度的系统考量，导致对其净价值的认知可能存在系统性偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模糊阈值假说（Ambiguity Threshold Hypothesis, ATH）：Agentic AI在低模糊性、规则型任务中产生可靠增益，而在高模糊性、判断密集型环境中产生不稳定或不利结果。同时引入绩效评估的时间维度理论。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述法，对行业报告、监管出版物和机构披露等二手资料进行系统梳理和分析。
AI.findings: （1）Agentic AI的绩效表现因任务类型而异，低模糊性任务表现稳定，高模糊性任务表现不稳定；（2）报告收益通常表现为"前载"（短期显著），而风险在更长时间跨度内逐渐显现，导致净价值被系统性高估。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"模糊阈值假说"（ATH），为理解Agentic AI在不同任务中的差异化表现提供了理论解释；提出了绩效评估的时间维度偏差理论，丰富了AI价值评估的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议行业和监管机构建立任务级评估框架，而非整体性评估Agentic AI系统，以更准确地衡量其净价值并防范系统性风险。

title: Implications of Policy Interventions on Eliminating Gender Gaps *
affiliations: Central Bank of Chile and European University Institute - Economics Department (ECO)

detail.title: Implications of Policy Interventions on Eliminating Gender Gaps *
detail.abstract: This paper studies policy interventions intended to eliminate gender differences in labor market outcomes, principally wages, through an equilibrium model of statistical discrimination with dynamic choices of education and labor market participation. The estimated model succeeds in matching observed gender gaps in wages, college attainment rates, the college premium and labor market participation rates. We quantify both the intended and unintended consequences of the policies through simulated interventions based upon the estimated model. In the short run the policy that requires gender free applications in the market for skilled labor eliminates wage gaps but once education choices respond the effects are attenuated. A more comprehensive policy that enforces gender free compensation reverses the wage gap in skilled markets and eliminates it in unskilled labor markets, even once education adjusts. These interventions impact college rates, the college premium gap and participation rates as well. The final section studies these interventions using a difference-indifferences (DID) approach to analyze the simulated data. With education fixed, the DID method recovers the policy effects but this is not the case once education adjusts, reflecting the effects of the intervention on both treated and control groups.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建包含统计性歧视的动态均衡模型，模拟评估了消除劳动力市场性别差异的政策干预，发现消除性别偏好的政策短期有效但长期因教育选择调整而效果减弱，而综合性薪酬平等政策则能更持久地消除性别工资差距。
AI.research_question: 旨在消除劳动力市场性别差异（主要是工资差异）的政策干预效果如何？特别是在考虑个体教育选择动态调整的情况下。
AI.motivation: 性别工资差距是劳动力市场的长期顽疾，但以往研究多关注政策直接效应，忽视了政策可能通过改变个体教育决策和劳动参与行为产生的间接（非预期）影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计性歧视理论；动态人力资本投资模型；均衡劳动力市场模型。
AI.method: 构建并估计包含统计性歧视、教育选择和劳动参与动态决策的均衡模型；基于估计模型进行政策模拟；使用双重差分（DID）方法分析模拟数据。
AI.findings: （1）短期內性别无差别申请政策可消除工资差距，但一旦教育选择做出调整，效果被削弱；（2）综合性性别薪酬平等政策可逆转技能型市场的工资差距，并消除非技能型市场的工资差距；（3）这些干预同时影响大学入学率、大学溢价差距和劳动参与率；（4）当教育固定时，DID能恢复政策效果，但教育调整后DID失效，因为干预同时对处理组和对照组产生影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将统计性歧视理论与个体教育选择的动态决策相结合，揭示了政策干预的短期直接效应与长期间接效应之间的张力，丰富了歧视经济学和人力资本理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于消除性别工资差距政策的量化评估，指出单一的无差别申请政策效果有限，需要综合性薪酬平等措施；同时提醒政策评估中应注意教育选择调整带来的内生性问题，DID方法在此类情境下可能失效。

title: Optimal Index-Linked Rebalancing with Anticipatory Trading
affiliations: University of Notre Dame - Department of Finance, Harvard Business School and University of Notre Dame - Mendoza College of Business

detail.title: Optimal Index-Linked Rebalancing with Anticipatory Trading
detail.abstract: We develop a model of index-linked rebalancing around reconstitution events. Index trackers trade off execution costs against tracking-error concerns, while speculators maximize profits given expected index-linked demand. The model shows speculators effectively act as liquidity providers at index reconstitution, and trading costs decline as speculator competition increases. With enough competition, even loose index trackers optimally rebalance at index reconstitution. The model rationalizes concentrated reconstitution-day trading with little contemporaneous price impact: speculators' pre-positioning shifts price pressure away from the reconstitution date. We estimate that avoidable rebalancing costs borne by index-linked investors are small relative to more general price impact estimates from the literature. We argue that apparent front-running reflects competitive liquidity provision and benefits index investors.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了指数关联型再平衡模型，揭示了指数重构期间交易集中但价格冲击小的现象，归因于投机者提前布仓提供的流动性。研究发现，投机者竞争降低了交易成本，可避免的再平衡成本远小于文献估计，看似抢跑的行为实为竞争性做市，惠及指数投资者。
AI.research_question: 指数重构事件中，指数跟踪者与投机者的交易行为如何影响再平衡成本、价格冲击及市场效率？
AI.motivation: 实证观察发现指数重构日交易量高度集中但价格冲击极小，现有理论无法解释这一现象；同时需澄清"抢跑"行为是否损害投资者利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建交易成本-跟踪误差权衡模型（指数跟踪者）与预期需求驱动利润最大化模型（投机者），博弈主体包括指数跟踪者（松/紧两类）和竞争性投机者。
AI.method: 理论建模与博弈分析，推导不同竞争程度下均衡交易策略，并进行数值估计。
AI.findings: （1）投机者充当流动性提供者，其竞争降低交易成本；（2）竞争充分时，即使松指数跟踪者也应在重构日再平衡；（3）投机者提前布仓将价格压力转移至重构日之前，解释集中交易但低价格冲击；（4）可避免再平衡成本远小于文献估计；（5）看似抢跑实为竞争性做市，对指数投资者有利。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论层面系统解释指数重构中"高交易量-低价格冲击"的悖论，重新定义"抢跑"行为的经济功能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为指数基金管理者提供再平衡策略优化建议（何时交易、如何利用投机者流动性），为监管者评估指数投资相关交易成本提供更准确的基准。

reference: Alkhatab Al Shuaili (2026), "Economic Efficiency and Regulation in Oman’s Water Sector: A Microeconomic Analysis of Nama Water Services", Zenodo, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20155992
title: Economic Efficiency and Regulation in Oman’s Water Sector: A Microeconomic Analysis of Nama Water Services
affiliations: and

detail.title: Economic Efficiency and Regulation in Oman’s Water Sector: A Microeconomic Analysis of Nama Water Services

publicationDetails.detailsText: Alkhatab Al Shuaili (2026), "Economic Efficiency and Regulation in Oman’s Water Sector: A Microeconomic Analysis of Nama Water Services", Zenodo, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20155992
Al Shuaili, A. I. (2026). Economic Efficiency and Regulation in Oman’s Water Sector: A Microeconomic Analysis of Nama Water Services. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20155992

detail.abstract: This study analyzes Oman’s water sector through a microeconomic examination of Nama Water Services as a regulated natural monopoly. The study evaluates market structure, supply and demand conditions, pricing efficiency, and resource allocation using secondary data from the Nama Water Services Annual Report 2024 and other institutional sources. The findings indicate that water demand in Oman continues to increase due to population growth and economic expansion, while supply remains relatively inelastic because of infrastructure constraints and dependence on desalination. Despite improvements in operational performance, non-revenue water losses remained relatively high at 37.1% in 2024, reflecting productive inefficiency. In addition, treated wastewater reuse remained below potential levels, indicating inefficient resource allocation. The study also confirms that water demand is highly price inelastic, limiting the effectiveness of pricing policies alone in reducing consumption. The study concludes that improving operational efficiency, reducing water losses, expanding wastewater reuse, and supporting sustainable infrastructure investment are essential for strengthening long-term water security in Oman.

AI.tldr: 本研究以阿曼Nama水务公司为案例，从微观经济学视角分析其作为受监管自然垄断企业的水行业市场结构、供需条件、定价效率与资源配置，发现需求因人口增长上升、供给因基础设施和海水淡化限制缺乏弹性、非收益水损失高达37.1%以及废水回用不足等问题，并据此提出改进建议。
AI.research_question: 在阿曼受监管的自然垄断水务市场结构下，供需条件、定价效率与资源配置存在哪些问题？
AI.motivation: 阿曼水资源日益紧张，水务部门面临人口增长与经济扩张带来的需求压力，亟需从微观经济学角度系统评估市场结构与运营效率，以提出改善水安全的政策建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然垄断理论、微观经济学中的供需分析、定价效率（边际成本定价、平均成本定价）、资源配置效率、需求价格弹性理论。
AI.method: 基于Nama Water Services 2024年年报等二手数据的微观经济分析，对市场结构、供需条件、定价效率与资源分配进行定性定量评估。
AI.findings: （1）水需求因人口增长和经济扩张持续上升；（2）供给受基础设施约束和对海水淡化的依赖而相对缺乏弹性；（3）非收益水损失高达37.1%，反映生产性效率低下；（4）处理后的废水回用低于潜在水平，说明资源配置效率不足；（5）水需求价格弹性极低，仅靠定价政策难以有效抑制消费。
AI.theory_contributions: 为受监管的自然垄断水务行业提供了来自新兴市场国家（阿曼）的实证证据，验证了在基础设施约束和低价格弹性条件下自然垄断理论在供水领域的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿曼及类似水资源短缺国家的水务政策制定者提供了具体建议：提高运营效率、减少水损失、扩大废水回用、支持可持续基础设施投资，以增强长期水安全。

title: The Wisdom of the Few: Skilled Traders and Prediction Market Accuracy
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Wisdom of the Few: Skilled Traders and Prediction Market Accuracy
detail.abstract: We study how participant composition affects pricing accuracy in prediction markets using transaction-level data from Polymarket. We classify participants by execution behavior across markets. Makers post liquidity and bear adverse selection costs. Takers cross the spread. Switchers do both. A model where signal-holders choose their execution role rationalizes cross-market role-mixing as a behavioral signature of private information. Most switchers are indistinguishable from takers. A small subset, identified by a skill screen, drives the result. A one-standard-deviation increase in their volume share is associated with 19% lower pricing error at close. A Brier decomposition attributes the effect to price calibration, not to how well markets distinguish outcomes. These skilled switchers carry permanent price impact and earn improving returns with experience. Takers persist despite losses. Market accuracy traces to a thin layer of informed participants.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Polymarket的交易级数据，发现预测市场的定价准确性源于一小部分熟练的“切换者”（既挂单又吃单的交易者），他们携带私人信息，其交易行为能显著降低定价误差。
AI.research_question: 参与者构成如何影响预测市场的定价准确性？
AI.motivation: 预测市场的准确性至关重要，但参与者异质性（知情交易者与噪声交易者的混合）如何影响市场效率尚不清晰；现有文献缺乏对交易者微观行为角色与信息含量之间关系的深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号持有者选择交易执行角色（做市、吃单或两者兼做）的理论模型，将跨市场的角色混合行为（switching）解释为私人信息的信号特征。
AI.method: 使用Polymarket交易级数据，按执行行为将参与者分为做市商（Makers）、吃单者（Takers）和切换者（Switchers）；通过技能筛选识别核心知情交易者；采用回归分析和Brier分解进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 大多数切换者与吃单者无异，但一小部分经过技能筛选的切换者显著提升定价准确性：其交易量份额每增加一个标准差，收盘定价误差降低19%；这些熟练切换者具有永久性价格冲击，且随经验增长回报提升；吃单者尽管亏损仍持续交易。定价准确性源于这薄薄一层知情参与者。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了交易角色混合（switching）作为私人信息的行为标识，丰富了市场微观结构理论中关于知情交易者策略选择的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测市场平台设计激励机制（如吸引并保留熟练切换者）提供了依据；对市场参与者识别信息交易者、优化交易策略具有参考价值。

reference: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1195; https://doi.org/10.59576/sr.1195
title: Micro and Macro Cost-Price Dynamics in Normal Times and During Inflation Surges
affiliations: , New York University - Leonard N. Stern School of Business - Department of Economics,  and National Bank of Belgium

detail.title: Micro and Macro Cost-Price Dynamics in Normal Times and During Inflation Surges

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1195
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We develop a unified approach to studying cost-price dynamics in the cross-section of firms in order to jointly explain the time series of aggregate inflation and the frequency of price changes, both during normal times and inflation surges. A key novelty is the use of microdata on firms' prices and production costs to construct an empirical measure of price gaps-the deviation between a firm's listed and optimal price.
