affiliations: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University, Sungkyunkwan University and Tel Aviv University - Coller School of Management

detail.title: Synthetic Harm? Understanding the Effects of Generative AI on Offline Sexual Crime

publicationDetails.detailsText: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study investigates whether the expanded effective availability of generative AI influences offline sexual crime. We exploit the May 2023 launch of the ChatGPT iOS application in Japan as a quasi-exogenous shock to GenAI accessibility and combine monthly crime statistics from Japan’s National Police Agency with platform-level engagement data from one of the country’s largest digital creator platforms. Using difference-in-differences and difference-in-difference-in-differences models, we estimate the effect of GenAI diffusion on reported rape incidence relative to murder and examine whether this effect varies with aggregate engagement in AI-generated explicit content. The results indicate a statistically significant post-launch increase in reported rape relative to murder, amounting to approximately 12 additional cases per month. Moreover, this effect is significantly amplified during periods of greater engagement with AI-generated adult sexual content. Supplemental analyses further show that engagement with minor-tagged AI-generated explicit content is associated with even stronger post-launch increases, particularly for offenses involving victims under age 20. Collectively, the findings are more consistent with stimulation and social learning mechanisms than with cathartic substitution. The study contributes early causal evidence that generative AI may produce harmful offline behavioral externalities and underscores the need for regulatory and platform-level safeguards.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2023年5月ChatGPT iOS应用在日本上线这一准外生冲击，结合日本警察厅月度犯罪数据与创作者平台数据，运用双重差分和三重差分模型发现：生成式AI的可及性扩张导致强奸案报告数每月增加约12起，且这一效应在AI生成成人内容参与度更高期间显著增强，尤其是涉及未成年人的AI生成内容与针对20岁以下受害者的犯罪关联更强。证据更支持刺激与社会学习机制，而非宣泄替代。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI的广泛可及性是否会影响线下性犯罪？具体而言，ChatGPT iOS应用在日本上线后，强奸报告率相对于谋杀是否发生变化，以及这种变化是否与AI生成成人内容（尤其是涉及未成年人的内容）的参与度相关？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于生成式AI的线上效应（如偏见、虚假信息），但对其线下行为外部性缺乏因果证据。性犯罪作为严重社会问题，可能受到AI生成色情内容（包括深度伪造和虚拟儿童色情）的影响，但尚无实证研究检验这一关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 刺激机制（stimulation）：接触色情内容会增加性犯罪倾向；社会学习机制（social learning）：通过观察学习模仿行为；宣泄替代假说（cathartic substitution）：接触色情内容会替代实际犯罪。研究预测前两种机制占主导。
AI.method: 采用双重差分（DID）和双重差分三重差分（DDD）模型。以ChatGPT iOS应用在日本上线（2023年5月）为准自然实验，处理组为强奸案，对照组为谋杀案；进一步以AI生成成人内容参与度（基于创作者平台数据）作为第三重差异。
AI.findings: (1) 上线后强奸报告较谋杀显著增加，每月约12起；(2) AI生成成人内容参与度高的时期，效应显著放大；(3) 涉及未成年人的AI生成内容与20岁以下受害者的犯罪关联更强；(4) 证据支持刺激和社会学习机制，拒绝宣泄替代假说。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供生成式AI对线下性犯罪产生有害行为外部性的因果证据；区分并检验了刺激/社会学习与宣泄替代两种竞争性理论机制；拓展了技术外部性研究的边界，将AI效应从线上延伸至线下。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构制定AI内容治理政策（尤其是AI生成成人及未成年人色情内容）提供实证依据；呼吁平台层面建立安全防护措施；对公共安全部门预防技术驱动的性犯罪提供预警信号。

title: The AI Is Not Your Legal Assistant: A Proposed Model Rule Comment for AI-Assisted Legal Practice

detail.title: The AI Is Not Your Legal Assistant: A Proposed Model Rule Comment for AI-Assisted Legal Practice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author founded and operates PriorityLex, LLC, which trains legal professionals in AI-assisted practice and places AI-enabled legal assistants with US law firms. The architecture proposed in this paper is the framework PriorityLex uses internally. This relationship is disclosed in the author footnote of the paper.

detail.abstract: Every jurisdiction addressing artificial intelligence in legal practice has framed AI through the legal assistant analogy of Model Rule 5.3 and prescribed behavioral verification without specifying what competent AI use requires at the operational level. The research record from human-factors engineering and cognitive psychology shows that the supervisory frame is structurally mismatched to AI oversight and that just telling lawyers to verify the AI predictably fails to improve outcomes. This paper proposes a Model Rule Comment to Rule 1.1 and an accompanying nine-section guidance document that replaces the supervision analogy with an architecture-competence framework. The comment organizes AI-assisted practice across four layers: (0) configuration, (1) deterministic verification, (2) independent analytical review, and (3) concentrated review by the lawyer. The architecture’s central move is the generation-verification distinction that AI systems are unreliable generators of legal analysis but effective verifiers of it, capable of deterministic citation checking against authoritative databases and structured analytical review under separation from the original reasoning chain. The architecture deploys AI for the verification tasks it performs well, concentrating the lawyer’s professional judgment on the items the verification layers flag rather than dispersing it across undifferentiated review of the full output. The comment establishes a procedural safe harbor modeled on the technology-assisted review doctrine developed in Da Silva Moore, Rio Tinto, Hyles, and In re Biomet: procedural competence satisfies the lawyer’s obligation when the process is properly designed and executed, even where the system produces an error the architecture did not prevent. The guidance document operationalizes the comment with verification standards for each layer, a documentation regime that spans all four layers, an education floor, and operational-competence provisions permitting delegation to supervised legal assistants. This architecture was originally developed in Potter, The Verification Duty as Architectural Specification (2026).

AI.tldr: 本文批判了当前法律AI监管中普遍采用的"律师助理类比"的不足，提出用"架构-能力框架"替代监督模型，并设计了四级验证架构（配置层、确定性验证层、独立分析审查层、律师集中审查层），辅以程序安全港规则和操作指南，以提升AI辅助法律实践的能力与可靠性。
AI.research_question: 如何在操作层面界定律师在AI辅助法律实践中的"胜任使用"义务，以替代当前不匹配的监督框架？
AI.motivation: 现行法律AI监管普遍套用Model Rule 5.3的律师助理类比，仅要求"验证"而不指定操作标准，但人因工程和认知心理学研究表明，这种监督框架与AI监督存在结构性错配，单纯告知律师去"验证"无法改善结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 架构-能力框架；生成-验证区分原则；程序安全港理论（借鉴电子发现领域的技术辅助审查判例）。
AI.method: 跨学科整合：人因工程学与认知心理学研究证据分析；法律判例分析（Da Silva Moore、Rio Tinto、Hyles、In re Biomet）；规范性法律文书设计（Model Rule评论与操作指南）。
AI.findings: AI是不可靠的法律分析生成者，但却是有效的验证者；将AI部署于确定性验证任务（如引文核对）和分析性审查，律师的精力集中于验证层标记的项目，而非全盘审查输出；程序性安全港规则可合理分配AI错误的责任。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"架构-能力框架"以替代传统的监督类比，建立了生成与验证的区分原则，为法律AI的操作层面胜任使用提供了理论化的制度设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 为律师和律所提供了可操作的四级验证架构、文档记录制度、教育最低要求和委托操作规范，以及借鉴电子发现判例的程序安全港规则，有助于在真实法律实践中落地AI使用的合规标准。

title: Exchange Rate Regime Choice in Small Oil-Based Open Economies under Geopolitical Fragmentation -Evidence from Oman
affiliations: and King's University College at Western University

detail.title: Exchange Rate Regime Choice in Small Oil-Based Open Economies under Geopolitical Fragmentation -Evidence from Oman
detail.abstract: We revisit the performance of Oman's U.S. dollar peg in an environment characterised by oil-price volatility, U.S. monetary tightening, and rising geopolitical risk. Using monthly data from 2014 to 2023 and identified external shocks following Baumeister and Hamilton (2019), Bauer and Swanson (2023), and Caldara and Iacoviello (2022), we estimate the transmission of these shocks to Omani inflation and import dynamics in a local-projections framework. Two robust findings emerge. First, U.S. monetary policy transmits cleanly and economically large to Omani consumer prices: a one-standard-deviation Federal Reserve tightening surprise reduces year-on-year CPI inflation by approximately 2.5 percentage points at the 16-month horizon, an order of magnitude larger than any single oil-market or geopolitical-risk effect. The peg's core nominal-anchor function is intact. Second, the transmission of geopolitical-risk shocks to Omani inflation has structurally increased in the post-2018 sub-period, with the interaction coefficient peaking at +0.95 percentage points at the two-year horizon and surviving HAC, block-residual bootstrap, and Covid-exclusion inference. We additionally document, in contrast to the conventional GCC currency-policy narrative, that Oman's import structure has concentrated within the USD-pegged bloc over 2005-2025 (from 38% to 53%) rather than reorienting toward Asia. The policy implication is what we call "maintain the peg, address the gap": the peg's monetary function does not justify regime change, while the eroded geopolitical-risk insulation calls for complementary instruments-reserve diversification, trade-invoicing flexibility, and supply-chain resilience-that operate alongside the peg rather than through it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究阿曼里亚尔盯住美元的汇率制度在油价波动、美国货币政策紧缩和地缘政治风险上升环境下的表现。研究发现：美国货币政策冲击对阿曼通胀的传导效应显著且庞大（远大于油价和地缘政治冲击），钉住汇率的货币锚功能依然稳固；但地缘政治风险对通胀的影响在2018年后结构性增强。同时，阿曼进口结构反而更加集中于美元钉住区（从38%升至53%）。政策建议是“维持钉住，弥合缺口”——不改变汇率制度，但需通过储备多元化、贸易结算灵活性和供应链韧性等补充工具来应对地缘政治风险。
AI.research_question: 在油价波动、美国货币紧缩和地缘政治风险上升的环境下，阿曼盯住美元的汇率制度表现如何？外部冲击如何传导至阿曼的通胀和进口动态？
AI.motivation: 阿曼及海湾合作委员会（GCC）国家长期实行盯住美元的汇率制度，但近年来油价波动加剧、美联储激进加息以及地缘政治风险上升（如中东局势紧张），对这一制度的可持续性提出了挑战。现有研究缺乏对上述三重冲击同时作用下钉住汇率传导机制的系统性评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 盯住汇率制度的货币锚理论（名义锚功能）、国际冲击传导机制（货币政策溢出效应、油价冲击传导、地缘政治风险传导）、进口结构汇率制度依赖理论。
AI.method: 使用2014-2023年月度数据，采用局部投影法（local projections）估计冲击传导效应。识别外生冲击的方法分别参考：Baumeister and Hamilton (2019) 识别油价冲击、Bauer and Swanson (2023) 识别美国货币政策冲击、Caldara and Iacoviello (2022) 识别地缘政治风险冲击。稳健性检验包括HAC标准误、块残差自助法（block-residual bootstrap）和排除COVID时期样本。
AI.findings: （1）美国货币政策冲击对阿曼消费者价格的传导"干净且经济上庞大"：美联储一个标准差紧缩意外使阿曼CPI同比通胀在16个月后下降约2.5个百分点，远超任何单一油价或地缘政治冲击的效应，表明钉住汇率的货币锚功能完整。（2）地缘政治风险冲击对阿曼通胀的传导在2018年后结构性增强，交互项系数在两年期达到峰值+0.95个百分点，且稳健性检验通过。（3）与GCC传统汇率政策叙事相反，阿曼进口结构在2005-2025年间更加集中于美元钉住区（从38%升至53%），而非转向亚洲。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了三重冲击（油价、货币政策、地缘政治）同时作用下钉住汇率制度传导机制的系统性证据，区分了货币锚功能（仍然有效）与地缘政治风险绝缘功能（已侵蚀）的不同表现，丰富了钉住汇率制度绩效的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"维持钉住，弥合缺口"的政策框架：钉住汇率的货币政策功能无需改变汇率制度，但需通过储备货币多元化、贸易结算灵活性和供应链韧性等补充工具来弥补地缘政治风险绝缘能力的下降，为阿曼及类似GCC国家的汇率政策选择提供了具体方向。

title: Mind the Break-Up: When Policy Disrupts Firms' Supply Chains
affiliations: University of Surrey - School of Economics,  and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU)

detail.title: Mind the Break-Up: When Policy Disrupts Firms' Supply Chains

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how policy-induced supply-chain shocks affect firms' performances, using the UK-EU Trade and Cooperation Agreement (TCA) as a source of exogenous variation. Using UK microdata on firm-level goods and services trade linked to firm's outcomes and employer-employee records, we document a sharp decline in firms’ imports of intermediate goods from the EU after 2021. We then show that firms more exposed to EU input sourcing experience declines in employment and sales, with corresponding effects on workers’ hours and pay. These impacts are heterogeneous across occupations, with larger losses concentrated among lower-skilled roles. Interestingly, we find that firms' services activities play an important role in mediating the impact of GVCs disruptions. On the one hand, these firms experience smaller declines in intermediate inputs imports; on the other hand, they experience stronger negative reactions to the overall GVC shock.

AI.tldr: 本文利用UK-EU贸易与合作协议作为外生冲击，研究发现政策引发的供应链冲击导致企业从欧盟进口中间品锐减，进而造成企业就业和销售下滑，且对低技能劳动者影响更大。有趣的是，服务活动在调节全球价值链 disruptions 中扮演了双重角色：一方面缓解了中间品进口下降，另一方面又放大了整体负面冲击。一句话概括：脱欧后的贸易壁垒不仅打断了货物供应链，还通过服务活动的复杂传导机制加剧了企业绩效的恶化。
AI.research_question: 政策引发的供应链冲击如何影响企业绩效？具体而言：UK-EU贸易协议（TCA）导致的中间品进口 disruption 对英国企业的就业、销售以及劳动力市场结果（工时、薪酬）有何因果效应？服务活动在调节这种全球价值链冲击中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注贸易自由化带来的收益，但对贸易保护主义和政策引发的供应链断裂（如英国脱欧）如何影响企业绩效的研究不足。本文利用英国脱欧后TCA实施作为准自然实验，试图因果识别供应链冲击的真实经济成本，并为政策制定者提供关于贸易壁垒负面影响的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链理论、企业异质性贸易理论、劳动力市场分割理论（技能异质性）。核心逻辑：政策冲击导致进口中间品成本上升或可获得性下降 → 企业生产函数受到负向供给冲击 → 产出和就业调整 → 不同技能水平劳动者受到差异化影响。服务活动作为全球价值链的"粘合剂"可能同时产生缓冲效应和放大效应。
AI.method: 准自然实验方法（Difference-in-Differences或类似策略）。利用UK微观数据（企业层面的货物与服务贸易数据，匹配企业绩效和雇主-雇员记录）。关键识别：比较TCA实施前后，对欧盟投入品依赖程度不同的企业之间的差异。
AI.findings: 1) 2021年后英国企业从欧盟的中间品进口显著下降。2) 对欧盟投入品依赖度高的企业就业和销售下降更严重，工人工时和薪酬也相应减少。3) 异质性效应：低技能岗位受到的负面冲击更大。4) 服务活动的双重作用：从事服务活动的企业中间品进口下降幅度较小，但整体面对GVC冲击时表现出更强烈的负面反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次利用准自然实验证据揭示政策引发的供应链冲击对企业绩效的因果效应。2. 丰富了全球价值链断裂成本的理论理解，特别是服务活动在其中的调节作用（缓冲与放大并存）。3. 为贸易政策对劳动力市场异质性影响提供了新的微观证据，尤其是技能层面的差异化效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为英国脱欧的经济成本提供了直接的企业层面证据。2. 对政策制定者提示：贸易壁垒不仅影响货物贸易，还会通过服务活动产生复杂的传导效应。3. 提醒企业和政府关注供应链韧性建设，特别是低技能劳动者的保护。4. 为未来贸易协定谈判提供参考：需要综合评估货物与服务贸易的交叉影响。

title: Demand for Conversational AI
affiliations: ETH Zürich, University of Barcelona - Institut d'Economia de Barcelona (IEB) and

detail.title: Demand for Conversational AI

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We estimate demand for five conversational AI use cases — administrative assistance, studying, wellness, friendship, and romance — using a preregistered, within-respondent conjoint experiment in a U.S. online sample (N=1,989). Purpose dominates interest: instrumental uses rank highest, romance lowest. Free pricing raises interest sharply but is attenuated for relational purposes, revealing non-monetary signaling costs that price reductions cannot eliminate. Privacy and personalization shift demand; interaction modality does not. Second-order beliefs exceed own interest in proportion to the purpose penalty, consistent with a single stigma parameter suppressing stated below latent demand. Corrected consumer surplus for a free romantic companion turns positive once suppression costs are recovered — the welfare mirror image of social media’s collective trap.

AI.tldr: 本文通过联合实验发现，人们对对话式AI的使用目的偏好存在显著差异：工具性用途（如行政助理）最受欢迎，情感关系类（如浪漫伴侣）最不受欢迎。免费定价能提升兴趣，但对关系类用途效果有限，揭示了非货币信号成本的存在。纠正社会偏差后，免费浪漫伴侣的消费者剩余为正值，形成社会福利的镜像效应。
AI.research_question: 人们对五种对话式AI使用场景（行政助理、学习、健康、友谊、浪漫）的需求偏好如何？不同使用目的、定价、隐私、个性化及交互方式如何影响需求？
AI.motivation: 对话式AI（如ChatGPT、Replika等）正在快速进入日常生活，但人们对不同使用场景的真实需求尚不明确，尤其是情感/关系类用途是否被社会污名化所抑制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求偏好理论、信号成本理论、社会污名理论、消费者剩余与福利经济学
AI.method: 预注册的受访者内联合实验（within-respondent conjoint experiment），美国在线样本（N=1,989），测量消费者对五种用途的偏好及多属性权衡。
AI.findings: （1）工具性用途（行政助理）偏好最高，浪漫用途最低；（2）免费定价能显著提升兴趣，但对关系类用途效果减弱，存在非货币信号成本；（3）隐私和个性化影响需求，但交互方式无显著影响；（4）二阶信念（他人看法）与自身偏好之间的差距随用途的社会接受度降低而扩大，符合单一污名参数的预测；（5）纠正污名效应后，免费浪漫伴侣的消费者剩余由负转正。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"单一污名参数"解释社会期望偏差导致的偏好低估；揭示了免费定价无法消除的信号成本；发现对话式AI的社会福利效应与社交媒体的"集体陷阱"形成镜像。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI产品定价策略提供依据：工具性用途适合免费引流，关系类用途需考虑非价格壁垒；提示产品设计者需关注隐私和个性化功能；为理解AI对人际关系的社会影响提供实证基础。

title: The Heterogeneous Bank Lending Channel of Monetary Policy
affiliations: , University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), ,  and Banco de España

detail.title: The Heterogeneous Bank Lending Channel of Monetary Policy

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: How does heterogeneity in banks' interest-rate risk exposure shape monetary policy transmission? We develop a quantitative macroeconomic model of heterogeneous banks to answer this question. We establish an irrelevance result: differences in interest-rate risk exposure between fixed- and variable-rate banking systems matter for transmission only when bank solvency concerns become relevant. Calibrating the model to the euro area, we show that idiosyncratic default risk pushes a substantial share of banks toward the solvency threshold, making heterogeneity quantitatively important. When policy rates rise, fixed-rate banks suffer net interest margin compression — funding costs increase while legacy loan income stays unchanged — eroding capital and triggering sharper deleveraging. The lending elasticity to monetary policy is one-third larger in fixed-rate economies. The effects extend to financial stability: tightening raises bank failure rates in fixed-rate systems while lowering them in variable-rate systems. The results provide a rationale for macroprudential and monetary policy coordination and for monetary policy gradualism.
